title: Account Development Representative, UK
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviors.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

  

Job Description

The Opportunity:

Cint delivers powerful answers, driven by the sentiments of real people. Everyone benefits from data-driven knowledge – whether you’re conducting market research, polling, or seeking to better understand advertising campaigns and brand lift. Lucid Media Measurement is a rapidly growing team built to solve the challenges in advertising research by bringing scale, speed, accuracy, flexibility, and quality to marketing studies. Cint seeks an experienced Account Development Representative to work closely with our sales team in supporting new and existing measurement customers, such as Netflix, Spotify, and Amazon.

This role is open to candidates living in London to work remotely or from our London HQ in Shoreditch.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with clients by advising them on pricing and feasibility for media measurement projects

  • Become familiar with CINT proprietary software and the research technology industry

  • Sell media measurement projects by being quick, accurate, and consultative

  • Effectively partner with clients to resolve their project needs via e-mail, phone, video, and in person meetings (if required)

  • Assist account managers and other business functions to achieve the determined revenue goals

  • Document interactions with clients in Salesforce

What we look for:

  • Independent thinkers and self-starters

  • Understanding and curiosity for how advertising is measured and optimized

  • Tech savvy and forward-thinking

  • Collaborative teammates that enjoy working with a diverse collection of colleagues and partners

  • Excitement for prospecting, outreach, and developing client-focused solutions

 

Qualifications

  • 1+ years of Account Management experience in sales/account development in the Media or Advertising space, including verticals such as Agencies, Publishers, Platforms, or Ad Tech brands

  • Thrives in a client-facing role and a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent communication, numerical, and interpersonal skills

  • Enjoys solving problems and prefers analytical methods

  • Attentive to detail and has the ability to multitask and prioritize

  • BA/BS Degree

 

Additional information

  • Collaboration is our superpower:

title: Account Executive Accounting - France 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as an Account Executive Accounting to help newly onboarded Qonto clients get their accounting right from day one. You'll be part of a strategic new positioning of Qonto, owning the full sales cycle yourself from first call to signed contract. Astrid Liska, our Sales Lead Accounting, will guide and mentor you closely every step of the way.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Engage clients right when it matters: You'll reach out to newly onboarded business creators within days of account creation and guide them to the right offer.

  • Stay on it when others give up: You’ll stay proactive with accounts that go quiet, following up thoughtfully and creating more opportunities to keep the conversation going.

  • Use a soft-selling approach: You'll diagnose each client's accounting needs and handle competitive and objection-based negotiation with confidence.

  • Close the deal: You’ll own the deal end to end, from the initial conversation through to the signed contract.

  • Use AI to work smarter: You'll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalize outreach, and speed up qualification.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • You've closed before: At least 1 year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with closing experience and ownership of at least one full sales cycle from end to end. A strong closing rate is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English : Both are mandatory languages to master, with a minimum proficiency of C2 in French and C1+ in English.

  • You're comfortable on the phone: You reach out with confidence and build trust fast and bring a consultative mindset to every call.

  • You thrive in an early-stage environment: You're comfortable with processes that are still being created, like to give feedback and you adapt fast when things change.

  • You don't quit: You keep going on unresponsive accounts without losing energy or tact.

  • You're AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep, and follow-up.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A brand-new team with real stakes: You'll help build one of Qonto's strategic priorities for 2027, from the ground up. You'll help shape a new path at Qonto and experience its early stages firsthand.

  • A space to try, learn and build: You'll have the autonomy to test ideas and help establish the ways of working that will set this new team up for success.

  • Growth you earn: Challenge yourself, grow through your achievements, and see your impact translate into real growth at Qonto.

  • Qonto's sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that open doors and are a real launchpad.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Astrid Liska, Sales Lead Accounting. Before Qonto, she built her sales career at Qobra and PayFit France, and she's the one who built Qonto's Regate SDR team from scratch. She's now taking on the same build-from-zero challenge with this new accounting team.

Having evolved from an SDR to an Account Executive and Key Account Manager before stepping into leadership, she has mastered every stage of the sales cycle and understands exactly what it takes to perform and grow in this environment.

Astrid is dedicated to building a collaborative and high-performing team. She uses her diverse experience to provide concrete mentorship, helping you sharpen your skills and navigate complex sales challenges to reach your full potential.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

title: Account Executive - Cross Industries
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

You will join our high-performing Swiss sales team. We help leading enterprise organizations in Switzerland optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.

The Role:

Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will build and grow relationships to drive sales cycles from discovery to value realization. You will be responsible for a portfolio of enterprise accounts headquartered in Switzerland, combining existing customers, where you will expand our footprint, with new / greenfield accounts, where you will win new logos for Celonis. Navigating complex organizations from operational leaders up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.

The work you'll do:

●    Manage a balanced portfolio of existing customers (land-and-expand) and new / greenfield accounts (new logo acquisition)
●    Build pipeline in greenfield accounts through targeted prospecting and account planning
●    Engage stakeholders across lines of business, from operational leaders up to C-level
●    Drive Celonis Process Intelligence sales motions across the core enterprise value chain, translating business challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases that deliver measurable execution capacity
●    Hold an individual revenue target for closing six-figure+ deals within your accounts
●    Engage closely with partners e.g., consulting firms and SaaS vendors
●    Drive sales cycles through orchestrating virtual teams including business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services, implementation partners...
●    Grow your skills through structured enablement, coaching and close collaboration with experienced Strategic Account Executives and your Sales Manager

The qualifications you need:

●    3+ years of relevant experience in either one - or ideally both - of the following domains:
○   SaaS Sales: Track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex B2B software solutions to enterprise accounts, ideally with experience in both expanding existing customers and winning new logos.
○    AI / Management Consulting: Experience in a (boutique) consultancy, delivering AI or digital transformation projects with exposure to account management, client relationships, and business development.
●    A track record of meeting or exceeding targets, commitment, and successful career progression with your previous companies
●    A hunter mentality: proven ability to prospect, open doors and build pipeline in new accounts
●    Strong business acumen and a solid understanding of core processes and KPIs across the enterprise value chain (e.g., Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain)
●    Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different industries and business models
●    Ability to build trusted relationships with Business and IT stakeholders and the confidence to engage up to the C-level
●    Grit, a hands-on mindset, strong discovery skills and a structured approach to running sales processes
●    Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (fluent) and English
●    Eagerness to learn and develop, open to feedback and coaching
●    Ability to adapt to a fast moving, ever changing, high growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking, and a growth mindset
●    Willingness to be collaborative, inclusive, to embrace diversity and to have strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter
●    Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins

Zurich area location preferred; candidates based elsewhere in Switzerland must be available for weekly in-person presence and customer visits (primarily in German-speaking Switzerland).

#LI-SS6

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Account Executive Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
Een strategische dealmaker die organisaties helpt grenzen te verleggen met Data en AI

Organisaties in het Corporate en Enterprise domein staan voor complexe digitale transformaties waarin Data en AI niet langer bijzaak zijn, maar de kern vormen van toekomstig concurrentievermogen. Als Account Executive (Data & AI) ben jij de commerciële en strategische sparringpartner die bij beslissers op CIO- en businessniveau de juiste deuren opent. Je doorgrondt zakelijke uitdagingen, ziet kansen waar anderen obstakels ervaren en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete IT-oplossingen.

De uitdaging: Vernieuwing en groei gedreven door Data & AI

In deze rol speel je een sleutelrol in het uitbreiden van ons klantennetwerk binnen de Nederlandse Corporate en Enterprise markt. Als Account Executive (Data & AI) focus je op het scherp positioneren van onze Data- en AI-proposities, aangevuld met onze expertise op het gebied van Business Automation, IT Modernization en Staffing Solutions. Je bent intern bij LINKIT verantwoordelijk voor het gehele traject van acquisitie tot deal-closing en werkt hierin nauw samen met onze expertiseteams en marketing (ABM). Je taken omvatten onder meer:

  • Initiëren van ingangen en genereren van hoogwaardige leads via gerichte acquisitie op named accounts.

  • Opbouwen en beheren van een solide salespijplijn door duurzame relaties te ontwikkelen op C-level en businessniveau.

  • Optreden als consultative selling partner die strategische vraagstukken vertaalt naar haalbare digitale oplossingen.

  • Regie voeren over het commerciële proces en het binnenhalen van nieuwe, toonaangevende opdrachtgevers.

  • Nauw samenwerken met onze Business Consultants, Project Office en expertiseteams om proposities naadloos aan te laten sluiten bij de klantbehoefte.

Je plek

Je maakt deel uit van het commerciële team binnen LINKIT en werkt intensief samen met de Data Engineering en Business Consultancy squads. Onze Explorers delen voortdurend kennis om elkaar én onze klanten naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Om de week op vrijdag komen we met het hele bedrijf samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een vaste dag die in het teken staat van kennisdeling, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en verbinding.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 3 jaar bewezen saleservaring binnen specifiek Data- en/of AI-proposities in IT of zakelijke dienstverlening.

  • Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met een sterk analytisch en commercieel denkniveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met consultative selling en zakendoen op C-level/CIO-niveau binnen het Corporate en Enterprise segment.

  • Zelfstartend, resultaatgericht en commercieel gedreven met sterke netwerkkwaliteiten.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • OTE tot €120k per jaar (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden dit noemen wij de ‘clubdag’).

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen het team en LINKIT.

  3. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Heb je vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Michiel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing.

Als Account Executive (Data & AI) geef je mede vorm aan de verdere commerciële groei en impact van onze organisatie.

Rethink it with LINKIT

title: Account Executive, France
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary

An Account Executive is responsible for driving new business growth within a defined territory. The role focuses on identifying, developing, and closing net-new customer opportunities, with a strategic emphasis on expanding OneStream’s footprint into untapped markets and organizations. The Account Executive takes full ownership of pipeline generation and progression, leveraging a consultative, value-based sales approach to demonstrate how OneStream’s SaaS platform addresses complex business needs. This individual is responsible for engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating enterprise sales cycles, and building strong, trust-based relationships with prospective clients.

Success in the role requires a strong hunter mentality with proven ability to build pipelines from scratch through outbound prospecting, partner collaboration, and disciplined follow-up. A self-starter with a deep understanding of the financial and operational challenges facing modern enterprises, and a passion for winning new business. The Account Executive collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Pre-Sales, Business Development, and Strategic Alliances to maximize market reach and accelerate deal velocity. While some collaboration with existing accounts may occur, the primary focus of this role remains new logo acquisition and revenue growth. This role focuses primarily on commercial and mid-market accounts, targeting organizations with significant finance transformation needs and strong executive sponsorship.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • New Business Development: Drive new logo acquisition through strategic prospecting, outbound outreach, marketing leads, and partner referrals.
  • Account Expansion: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and aligning them with OneStream’s solutions.
  • Pipeline Generation: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through self-sourced efforts and collaboration with Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Salesforce Hygiene: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date Salesforce records to support data-driven decision making, forecast accuracy, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Sales Execution: Prepare and present tailored business cases, proposals, and SaaS agreements that align customer objectives with OneStream’s value proposition.
  • Quota Achievement: Balance new business and existing account growth to meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Customer Partnership: Serve as a consultative partner, delivering insights and value that support long-term customer success and retention.
  • Value Communication: Clearly articulate OneStream’s differentiators through compelling written, virtual, and in-person presentations.
  • Opportunity Management: Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities while ensuring timely knowledge transfer across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Needs Assessment: Conduct discovery sessions, research, and demos to assess and align OneStream offerings with client challenges.
  • Proposal Development: Create high-impact proposals and responses to client requests, supporting revenue growth and strategic alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong focus on new business; high-potential candidates with less experience will also be considered.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quotas through net-new customer acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing complex deals.
  • Hunter mindset with ability to drive outbound efforts and convert leads from multiple channels.
  • Skilled at articulating solution value to senior stakeholders and navigating multi-threaded sales cycles.
  • Strong command of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Challenger to manage complex sales cycles.
  • Strategic thinker with business acumen to align solutions with customer pain points and goals.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities with speed, discipline, and strong execution across relatively short to mid-length sales cycles.
  • Strong team player who values collaboration and actively contributes to a high-performance team culture.
  • Comfortable operating independently in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Experienced in collaborating with Marketing, Product, Business Development, and Pre-Sales to accelerate deal velocity.
  • Values being regularly present in the office and recognizes the importance of face-to-face collaboration in building trust, alignment, and high performance.
  • Fluent in French and English is a must.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
  • Prior sales experience in the SaaS industry, especially within the CPM / EPM industry or financial software space.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrates a strategic mindset with a focus on long-term value creation.
  • Consistently driven by goals and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains a strong customer-centric approach across all initiatives.
  • Possesses strong commercial acumen and sound business acumen to drive sustainable growth.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level executives and key stakeholders.
  • Adept at identifying, understanding, and proactively responding to evolving customer needs.
  • Highly flexible and adaptable, with the ability to navigate complex and changing environments.

#LI-MS1

descriptionHtml:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Department Focus:

The Sales team at Deliverect— the pulsating heartbeat of our journey towards growth and the delivery of exceptional value to our customers. We're not just on the front lines; we are the front lines, simplifying order management and shaping the future of how businesses thrive.

For us, it's not merely about transactions; it's a transformative journey, fostering lasting connections and redefining the very essence of order management. Beyond selling, we are builders of consultative relationships, drivers of innovation, and creators of a landscape where our customers not only survive but thrive.

Meet our team—a force that doesn't just make deals; we make life easier for our customers, embodying a spirit that redefines order management. In our ranks, colleagues are not just colleagues; they're innovators, champions of excellence, and the driving force behind Deliverect's continued success. Welcome to a team where every interaction is a step towards not just closing a sale but opening a door to transformative relationships.

Your Impact:

As an Mid-Market Account Executive at Deliverect, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth by acquiring and managing small to mid-sized restaurant and hospitality businesses. Your focus will be on building strong relationships with business owners and key decision-makers, understanding their operational challenges, and offering tailored SaaS solutions that improve efficiency and drive results. This role is essential to expanding Deliverect’s footprint in local and regional markets.

*This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 4 days in London office and 1 day from the comfort of your home.


What You Will Do:
  • Identify and engage high-potential businesses through targeted research, online tools, and strategic networking within the hospitality and foodservice industry.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the operational challenges faced by Mid-Market businesses, allowing you to clearly articulate how Deliverect drives efficiency, improves ROI, and simplifies order management.
  • Deliver value-based product demonstrations that directly address each prospect's pain points, showcasing the tangible benefits of Deliverect’s platform.
  • Communicate complex topics—such as APIs, POS integrations, and third-party delivery platforms—in a simple, relatable way that resonates with business owners and operators.
  • Confidently manage objections and guide prospects through the decision-making process to successful deal closure.
  • Partner with onboarding, account management, and support teams to deliver a seamless, end-to-end customer journey — ensuring each client experiences the full value of Deliverect from day one.
  • Occasionally travel to attend customer meetings or industry conferences.

    • What You Will Bring:
  • Fluency in English and any other European languages is a plus.
  • 3+ years of sales experience, preferably in B2B SaaS or the restaurant technology space, ERP enterprise solutions, etc.
  • Consultative selling skills with the ability to understand customer needs and present tailored solutions that drive value.
  • Excellent negotiation skills and a creative approach to solving customer challenges.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to handle objections effectively.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline with accurate revenue forecasting and timely follow-ups on all opportunities.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building relationships.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to pivot strategies to achieve results.

title: AI Engineer - Simulation Environments
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As an AI Engineer for Simulation Environments, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the simulated worlds in which our humanoid robots learn and are evaluated. You design training and evaluation environments with state-of-the-art physics engines, build and curate the asset libraries that fill them, and own the large-scale benchmarks that tell us - quickly and reliably - whether a new policy is better. Your environments sit between research, hardware and product, so how well they match reality and how useful they are directly sets how fast and how safely we can bring new capabilities to our robots. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Training and Evaluation Environments: Design and build scalable simulation environments for humanoid robots with physics engines such as MjLab and Isaac Lab. Work with AI researchers to create challenging training tasks, curricula and evaluation scenarios.

  • Asset Management: Build and curate our database of robot, object and scene assets - including import, validation, collision and physics properties, metadata and versioning - so that environments can be assembled quickly and reproducibly.

  • Simulation Benchmarking: Own rigorous, large-scale simulation benchmarks and evaluation sweeps that enable fast policy evaluation cycles, with statistically sound metrics, regression tracking and clear reporting to research teams.

  • Sim-to-Real Alignment: Work with hardware and control engineers to align simulation with reality through robot modeling, actuator and sensor models, system identification and validation against real-world data.

  • Use-Case Driven Environments: Work with product teams to turn real customer use cases into simulated environments and benchmarks that measure what matters for deployment.

Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building simulation environments for robot learning with physics engines such as MuJoCo/MjLab, MuJoCo Warp/MJX, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or Newton.

  • Core Skills: Deep understanding of physics simulation and large-scale evaluation infrastructure. In detail:

    • Simulation Physics: Rigid-body dynamics and contact simulation, including solver parameters, numerical stability and the trade-offs between simulation speed and fidelity.

    • Assets & Formats: Robot and scene description formats and asset pipelines - URDF, MJCF, OpenUSD, mesh processing and convex decomposition (e.g. CoACD, V-HACD) - and asset validation at scale.

    • Benchmarking Infrastructure: GPU-parallel simulation, sweep orchestration, reproducibility and statistically sound metrics.

  • Core Stack: Python, C++, PyTorch and/or JAX, and GPU programming with CUDA or NVIDIA Warp.

  • A plus: Video game development (e.g. Unreal Engine, Unity or Godot), including level design, procedural content generation and real-time rendering; sim-to-real techniques (system identification, actuator modeling, domain randomization, sensor simulation for cameras, depth, IMU and tactile); photorealistic rendering and scene reconstruction (ray tracing, Gaussian splatting, NeRFs); 3D content tooling such as Blender or Houdini and large-scale asset sources such as Objaverse; familiarity with RL and imitation learning for humanoid locomotion and manipulation

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and a cross-functional collaborator who turns the different needs of research, hardware and product into environments and benchmarks everyone trusts.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. L'IA, c'est ce qui est en train de changer le métier.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ce poste ajoute une dimension : tu pilotes des produits dans lesquels l'IA devient une brique fonctionnelle à part entière, et tu t'en sers aussi pour accélérer ta propre pratique de PM.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent. Et tu sais reconnaître, parmi ces problèmes, ceux que l'IA résout vraiment de ceux qu'elle complique.

  • Tu qualifies les cas d'usage IA avant de les construire. Faisabilité, valeur, coût, données disponibles, risque d'erreur acceptable : tu instruis le sujet avec rigueur. Tu portes la décision de ne pas faire d'IA quand elle ne se justifie pas : c'est aussi ça, la maturité sur le sujet.

  • Tu embarques l'IA dans le produit, pas à côté. Tu travailles main dans la main avec les data scientists et les AI engineers : définition de ce qu'est un « bon » résultat, seuils de confiance, stratégies de repli quand le modèle se trompe, interfaces qui rendent l'incertitude lisible pour l'utilisateur, boucles de retour pour progresser dans le temps.

  • Tu pilotes des périmètres produit complexes et interdépendants. Règles métier, états et transitions, cohérence entre plusieurs surfaces (interface interne et parcours client en ligne), contrats d'intégration avec les produits adjacents : tu tiens la vue d'ensemble et tu stabilises ce qui doit l'être, dans des écosystèmes où ton produit n'est jamais seul.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur, et c'est le socle sans lequel aucun produit IA ne tient.

  • Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

Bonus : tu as déjà outillé ton propre quotidien de PM avec l'IA : rédaction et structuration de specs, dépouillement d'entretiens utilisateurs, exploration de données, prototypage rapide ? On aime les PM qui testent, qui gardent ce qui marche et qui savent dire ce qui ne marche pas.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 41.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. Ou tu es Product Owner avec une vraie volonté de progresser vers une posture de Product Manager complète (discovery, stratégie, pilotage d'impact).

  • Tu as travaillé sur un produit dont l'IA était une composante réelle (moteur de recommandation, modèle de classification, assistant ou agent, GenAI) et tu sais expliquer ce que le modèle faisait, ce qu'il ne faisait pas, et comment tu gérais ses erreurs côté produit. À défaut, tu as une appétence sérieuse et démontrable : formation spécialisée, side project, veille active que tu peux raconter concrètement.

  • Tu as une culture technique suffisante pour tenir la conversation avec des profils data et tech : tu situes ce qu'est un LLM, une approche RAG, une base de données, une API. On ne te demande pas de coder, on te demande de ne jamais être spectateur des choix techniques de ton produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec le pilotage de backlog, la roadmap et tu possèdes une culture data marquée. Ton orientation valeur est ton moteur au quotidien.

  • Tu sais évoluer dans des environnements produit complexes, où plusieurs équipes se coordonnent sur des périmètres qui se recouvrent, et où les règles métier ne tolèrent pas l'approximation.

  • Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est indispensable : nos clients lillois pilotent des produits déployés à l'international.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

title: Analytics Engineer – Client Reporting

Who you are

References

Paul Burkhardt

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

title: Associate Director, Medical Communications, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:
The Associate Director, Medical Communications, EMEA will play a key role in executing regional medical communications initiatives across mainly Europe in alignment with the global medical and scientific strategy. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will partner closely with EMEA Medical Affairs, country medical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to support the adaptation, localization, and implementation of global medical communications materials for healthcare professional (HCP) audiences. The role will support the phased expansion of our Medical Affairs Digital Resource Hub (MYO360) across Europe, beginning with Germany, execution of European congresses and medical symposia, and delivery of regionally relevant scientific communications that support the needs of EMEA Medical Affairs.
Position Responsibilities
  • Execute regional medical communications activities aligned with the Global Medical strategy, in collaboration with EMEA Medical Affairs, country medical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support the development and maintenance of global medical communications content, including core scientific resources that will cascade to EMEA and other regions, as business needs require.
  • Provide medical communications support for International Partner Market (IPM) initiatives, including the development, adaptation, and coordination of scientifically accurate materials aligned with global strategy and regional needs.
  • Support the adaptation and localization of existing global medical communications materials for EMEA and country-specific needs, partnering with local medical leads to ensure content is scientifically accurate, relevant, and compliant. This may include field medical resources, training materials, scientific slide decks, FAQs, and other medical content.
  • Support the European expansion of MYO360, including execution of regional and country-level adaptations, localization, stakeholder review, deployment readiness, and ongoing content updates in partnership with Global Medical Communications and local medical teams.
  • Coordinate and execute medical communications deliverables for European congresses, including encore abstract submissions, medical booth materials, scientific resources, congress-related communications, and post-congress materials, working across internal teams and external agencies.
  • Support the regional execution of Scholar Rock-sponsored medical symposia in Europe, including coordination of faculty materials, adaptation of scientific content, speaker preparation, review and approval processes, and other program deliverables.
  • Support medical training initiatives for EMEA and as needed, global audiences, including the adaptation and development of training materials, coordination of training sessions, and maintenance of onboarding and ongoing learning resources for Medical Affairs colleagues.
  • Serve as a medical communications partner to EMEA and country medical colleagues, helping identify regional and local content needs and facilitating the adaptation of existing global resources while maintaining consistency with the global scientific narrative.
  • Manage medical communications agencies and vendors supporting deliverables, including project scoping, timelines, budgets, quality review, and execution of multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate regional and local review and approval of medical materials, partnering with appropriate stakeholders to ensure alignment with applicable European regulations, industry codes, company policies, and medical review processes.
  • Track project progress, timelines, risks, budgets, and key performance indicators; communicate status clearly; and proactively address executional challenges to keep deliverables on track.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of the SMA and neuromuscular disease landscape, relevant clinical data, external scientific discourse, and regional medical education needs to support effective execution of EMEA medical communications activities.
  • Contribute to scientific excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and sharing of best practices across Global and EMEA Medical Affairs.

    • Candidate Requirements
    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree (e.g., Pharm.D., Ph.D., or equivalent) preferred; a relevant master's degree with substantial medical communications experience may be considered.
    • 5+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, medical communications, scientific communications, publications, or a related biopharmaceutical industry role; rare disease or neuromuscular experience is preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience developing medical content for healthcare professional audiences and translating complex scientific information into clear, concise, and scientifically accurate communications.
    • Experience supporting regional or global congresses, medical symposia, abstract submissions, publications, and/or medical education initiatives.
    • Experience working across European markets, including content adaptation or localization and collaboration with regional and country medical teams.
    • Knowledge of relevant European pharmaceutical regulations, industry codes, compliance requirements, and medical review processes.
    • Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, agencies, stakeholders, budgets, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European language capabilities are an advantage.
    • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a global matrix, influence without direct authority, work independently, and exercise sound scientific and business judgment.
    • Ability to travel approximately 20-30%, including occasional weekend travel based on congress and meeting schedules.
    Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services (Télétravail depuis Lille)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions multilingues à venir selon nos développements à l’étranger.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Un première entretien avec notre Simon, Senior Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Une étude de cas à préparer en amont avec Nathan et Vincent, Associate Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un échange avec une partie de l'équipe de Specialists Support FST (30 min)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

  

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Automation Engineer (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Operations Excellence team sits within the COO organization and serves as a strategic partner to managers, team leads, and colleagues across Stark. By delivering data-driven insights, leading critical projects, and driving continuous process improvement, we help the organization operate more efficiently, scale effectively, and achieve its goals faster. As an individual contributor, you will take end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives with significant business impact. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence key decisions, shape core operating processes, and contribute directly to the success of one of Europe’s fastest-growing unicorns.

YOUR MISSION

As Automation Engineer, you build and deploy automations that eliminate manual effort across operations and the back-office. You work across RPA, LLM-based tooling, and API integrations — and you are as likely to be automating an invoice approval chain as a production line data feed. You measure success in hours saved and errors eliminated.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Design and build RPA workflows for operational and back-office processes — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent
  • Develop LLM-based automation tools for document-heavy workflows: invoice extraction, quality certificates, order processing, email triage
  • Integrate automation solutions with ERP, MES, and business applications via APIs
  • Build agent-based workflows where multi-step reasoning or decision-making is required
  • Test, deploy, and maintain automations in production — including monitoring, alerting, and incident response
  • Document automation logic, dependencies, and maintenance procedures thoroughly
  • Work with operational and back-office teams to identify, scope, and prioritise new automation opportunities

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3–6 years building automations in an operational or business process context
  • Has shipped working automations into production — not just proof-of-concept or demo environments
  • RPA tools — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent (hands-on production experience)
  • Python scripting — for custom automation logic, API integration, and LLM tool use
  • API integration — REST APIs, webhooks, data exchange across ERP and business systems
  • Process analysis and QA mindset — automations must be reliable, not just functional
  • BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar

NICE TO HAVE

  • LLM-based tooling — prompt engineering, agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • ERP system familiarity (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar)
  • Manufacturing or back-office finance/ops experience

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.

The controller

Data Protection officer: heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin, www.heydata.eu, -----

Personal data collected as part of the application process

Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.

Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process

If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.

By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.

In particular, the following data is collected during this process:

  • name (first and last names)
  • e-mail address
  • phone number
  • LinkedIn profile (optional)
  • channel through which you found us

Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.

Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.

The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.

Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).

Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.

Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.

Disclosure of data to third parties

Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.

Rights of data subjects

If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.

To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).

Concluding provisions

We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. In this case, the new data privacy statement applies to any later visit of this recruitment website or any later job application.

title: Backend Engineer, AI Systems
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs for AI-powered applications

  • Develop inference orchestration systems that connect LLMs, application services and external tools

  • Design APIs for streaming responses, asynchronous processing and real-time interactions

  • Improve system performance through caching, batching, concurrency and database optimisation

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and error handling for production services

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues involving latency, service failures and high traffic

  • Work with ML, frontend and mobile engineers on API design, system integration and deployment

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of backend software engineering experience building production systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Node.js or similar backend technologies

  • Experience designing and maintaining REST or gRPC APIs, databases and distributed services

  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, concurrency, caching and message queues

  • Experience building scalable services and optimising latency, throughput and resource usage

  • Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Docker and cloud infrastructure

  • Ability to debug production issues using logs, metrics and distributed tracing

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, inference services or AI-powered applications

  • Experience with model serving, streaming inference or orchestration frameworks

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration

  • Familiarity with PyTorch, vLLM or open-source model deployment

  • Experience building real-time communication, messaging or high-traffic
