title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables.

L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.
Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. 

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Strategist, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.


Activités & Responsabilités

  • Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA

Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.

  • Analyses, business cases & prototypage

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

  • Delivery, livrables & collaboration

Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous produisez des sections de livrables de niveau C-suite, rédigez les storylines du stream, participez aux synthèses exécutives sur votre périmètre et construisez un narratif qui appuie la recommandation et emporte l’adhésion. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

  • Relation client & développement commercial

Vous construisez une relation de proximité avec votre interlocuteur direct, élargissez le réseau de parties prenantes aux équipes opérationnelles et au middle management, anticipez les résistances et animez des ateliers en autonomie. Vous identifiez des opportunités, soutenez le plan de compte avec le Manager et le Directeur et participez aux propositions et aux événements de networking.

  • Équipe & connaissances

Vous déléguez avec des instructions claires, donnez des feedbacks constructifs, animez des 1to1 avec les consultants juniors et participez aux rétrospectives et aux entretiens de candidats. Vous contribuez à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des sessions d’onboarding et des formations internes.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Première expérience de pilotage d’un stream ou d’une mission, avec coaching de consultants juniors.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.
  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers)
  • Aisance dans la construction de business cases et dans la restitution à des équipes opérationnelles et au middle management.
  • Première expérience d’analyse ou de refonte de processus métier, avec une appétence pour certains domaines métier.
  • Un état d’esprit de maker : aisance avec les outils technologiques actuels et capacité à prototyper des cas d’usage réalistes, alignés sur le besoin du client, et à itérer rapidement à partir des retours (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques).
  • Une affinité avec un secteur ou une fonction métier, et une vraie curiosité pour les impacts de l’IA.
  • Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement couvre l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : AI Strategy (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opératoires), Engineering (industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et AI Adoption (conduite du changement, montée en compétences, usage quotidien de l’IA).

Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • De la stratégie à la réalisation
    Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.
  • Une collaboration entre expertises
    Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).

Un rôle avec de l’autonomie et des perspectives
Piloter des streams, développer une expertise, faire grandir une équipe et contribuer au développement de l’activité.Un parcours clair de progression

Un accompagnement concret : counsellor, parcours de formation et programme de leadership.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (45') avec HR / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un business case AI-driven (60') avec un AI Strategist Manager ou Senior Manager
  3. Un business case de prototypage IA hands-on (60') avec un AI Strategist Manager
  4. Un entretien de fit final (30') avec un AI Strategist Partner

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
department: LIRIS - Laboratoire d'Informatique en Image et Systèmes d'Information
descriptionHtml:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

descriptionHtml:
Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

Come as you are

descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

The CTO will own technology strategy, architecture and engineering standards across the Group. This is a technical leadership role for someone who can operate across multiple businesses while remaining close to systems, architecture and engineering execution.

 

What you will be doing

  • Own architecture and major technical decisions across group products and platforms.

  • Review critical systems, architecture, infrastructure and code directly.

  • Set engineering standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.

  • Identify technical debt and architecture constraints and drive their resolution.

  • Improve engineering productivity, development speed and production reliability.

  • Decide where technology and infrastructure should be shared across Group businesses.

  • Recruit and assess senior engineers, technical leads and engineering leaders.

 

What you will need

  • Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.

  • Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

  • Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.

  • Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.

  • Capable of building world-class engineering teams.

  • Still technically hands-on - able to review code, architecture, incidents and difficult engineering problems directly.

title: Circular Construction Consultant (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hast du Lust die Baubranche radikal zu verändern? Dann werde Teil von Concular – der Marktführerin für zirkuläre Gebäude.

Wir sind das führende GreenTech Startup mit Fokus auf die Circular Economy in der Bauwirtschaft. Die Bauwirtschaft ist einer der größten Ressourcenverbraucher – doch das muss nicht so bleiben – mit unseren Lösungen werden Millionen Materialien wieder in einen Kreislauf gebracht und vor der Deponie gerettet. Dadurch werden Millionen Tonnen CO2 und Ressourcen eingespart. Sei Teil unserer Mission, die Kreislaufwirtschaft in der Baubranche als Standard zu etablieren.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Als Teil unseres Teams in Berlin berätst und begleitest du unsere Kunden, wie z.B. Projektentwickler:innen, Herstellende, Planende und Bauende bei der Umsetzung kreislaufgerechter Bau- und Rückbauprojekte. Auch unterstützt du bei F&E-Projekten. Mit deiner Expertise, exzellenten fachlichen Beratung und vorausschauender Planung bringst du jedes Projekt für alle Beteiligten zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Du erstellst die Planung und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung von komplexen Kundenprojekten

  • Du führst das Projektteam und unsere Projektpartner:innen durch den Prozess und sorgst für ein kooperatives Miteinander

  • Deine Projektpartner:innen können sich darauf verlassen, dass du sie proaktiv und lösungsorientiert zu fachlichen und prozessualen Themen berätst, z.B. zu Zertifizierungen wie DGNB oder BNB

  • Du überwachst verlässlich das Projekt-Controlling, den Budgeteinsatz und hast die Ressourcenplanung immer im Blick

  • Bei der Umsetzung von Projekten behältst du immer auch den operativen Mehrwert für das Unternehmen im Blick und erkennst Optionen für die Weiterverwertung (Entwicklung von innovativen Lösungen)

  • Du pflegst proaktiv den Kontakt zu Kund:innen als Basis für die Entwicklung neuer Projekte

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Du hast fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Projekten für Kund:innen aus der Bau- und Immobilienbranche

  • Du verfügst über einschlägige Zertifizierungserfahrungen oder bist idealerweise DGNB Consultant/Auditor oder BNB Koordinator:in

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängiger LCA-Software und Datenbanken (z.B. OneClick LCA, CAALA, eLCA oder ÖKOBAUDAT) sowie in der Bilanzierung nach DIN EN 15978

  • Du erstellst eigenverantwortlich überzeugende Kundenpräsentationen

  • Im Schreiben von Ergebnisveröffentlichungen, Berichten, Dokumentationen oder Handbüchern bist du sicher

  • Die Koordination von Stakeholdern und die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe ist für dich bekanntes Terrain

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch

Benefits

Wir bieten

  • Die Ausgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung deiner eigenen Rolle und ihrer Verantwortlichkeiten im Unternehmen

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich einzubringen und aktiv die Entwicklung von Concular und damit die Transformation der Baubranche mitzugestalten

  • Ein stetig wachsendes, ambitioniertes und internationales Team in herzlicher, professioneller Startup-Kultur

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option eines hybriden Arbeitsplatz (mobiles arbeiten + einen Arbeitsplatz in unserem Büro im Impact Hub Berlin)

  • bis zu 50€ monatlichem, steuerfreiem Sachbezug über die Concular Benefits Platform (u.a. Urban Sports, Netflix etc.) oder einen gleichwertigen Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket

Haben wir Dich neugierig gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung.

Als globaler Ticketinganbieter für Veranstalter, Sportclubs und Events verantwortet AXS u.a. das Ticketing für AEG Presents und weltweit bekannte Festivals wie das Coachella Festival oder das Hyde Park Festival. Client Service Manager (m/w/d) in VZ

Wir sind AXS, ein globaler Ticketinganbieter für Veranstalter, Sportclubs und Events.

AXS verantwortet unter anderem das Ticketing für AEG Presents, einen der weltweit führenden Veranstalter von Tourneen, Festivals und Konzerten. Fans der größten Künstler:innen wie Taylor Swift, Ed Sheeran, Kylie Minogue, Katy Perry und BLACKPINK vertrauen auf AXS, um Tickets für Konzerte und einzigartige Erlebnisse wie das Coachella Festival oder das Hyde Park Festival zu buchen.

AXS ist Teil des weltweit agierenden, unabhängigen Entertainment-Konzerns Anschutz Entertainment Group, Inc. (AEG). AEG betreibt zahlreiche Veranstaltungsstätten weltweit. In Deutschland zählen dazu unter anderem die Uber Arena und die Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin sowie die Barclays Arena in Hamburg.

Als Client Service Manager für Deutschland bist du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Veranstalter und Venue-Partner und sorgst für eine reibungslose Abwicklung ihrer Veranstaltungen im AXS-Ticketing-System. Du begleitest den gesamten Prozess von der Einrichtung der Veranstaltungen über die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Vorverkäufen bis hin zur laufenden Betreuung im Tagesgeschäft. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass unsere Kunden optimal unterstützt werden und ihre Veranstaltungen erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Du verbindest ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung mit technischem Verständnis und einer strukturierten, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account Management sowie unseren internationalen und internen Fachbereichen koordinierst du Kundenanforderungen, findest Lösungen für operative Herausforderungen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Ticketing-Prozesse und Servicequalität bei.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle bei AXS

  • Du richtest Veranstaltungen eigenständig in unserem AXS-Ticketing-System ein und übernimmst deren laufende Pflege und Konfiguration.

  • Du stellst einen reibungslosen Ablauf von Vorverkäufen und regulären Verkaufsstarts sicher.

  • Du betreust und berätst unsere Veranstalter und Venue-Kunden bei allen Fragen rund um Veranstaltungen, Vorverkäufe und Ticketing.

  • Du bist eine zuverlässige Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und unterstützt sie bei ihren individuellen Anforderungen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management bei der Betreuung unserer B2B-Kunden und der Umsetzung kundenspezifischer Anforderungen zusammen.

  • Du koordinierst Kundenanfragen und stimmst dich mit den relevanten internen Fachabteilungen ab.

  • Du überwachst, pflegst und dokumentierst Verkaufs-, Veranstaltungs- und Ticketing-Daten.

  • Wenn es operativ oder technisch kritisch wird, behältst du den Überblick, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und koordinierst geeignete Lösungsmaßnahmen.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Best Practices zur Optimierung der Event-Einrichtung und interner Ticketing-Prozesse.

  • Du bringst Ideen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Servicequalität und internen Arbeitsabläufe ein.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung im Client Service, Customer Service, Ticketing, Veranstaltungsmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Position

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Veranstaltern, Venues oder anderen B2B-Kunden

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für operative Abläufe im Ticketing- und Veranstaltungsbereich

  • Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern

  • Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Organisationstalent, auch in dynamischen Situationen

  • Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen und interdisziplinären Teams

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Ticketing oder Live Entertainment, Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Ticketing- oder CRM-Systemen sowie eine technische Affinität.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Erlebe Live-Emotionen hautnah: Gänsehautmomente mit den populärsten Bands und Künstler unserer Zeit – in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitanstellung mit transparenter Kommunikation in einem wachsenden Unternehmen sowie attraktiven Benefits.

  • Ein starkes Team, das auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitet, durch Hilfsbereitschaft überzeugt und eine offene Come-as-you-are-Kultur lebt – Vielfalt und Wertschätzung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlins – für echten Teamspirit und kurze Wege.

  • Nachhaltige Benefits wie Wellpass, E-Bike-Leasing und ÖPNV-Zuschuss zur Verbesserung deines ökologischen Fußabdrucks.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und kontinuierliches Feedback fördern Zusammenhalt und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Berlin

title: Client Success & Operations Manager (B2B Leadgenerierung)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für den Bereich Client Success & Operations, die uns bei der Betreuung unserer Kunden, der Steuerung laufender Leadgenerierungs-Kampagnen und der Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse unterstützen.

Wir helfen B2B-Unternehmen dabei, planbar neue Kundenanfragen über E-Mail, LinkedIn und datengetriebene Outbound-Prozesse zu gewinnen. Dabei arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen aus Bereichen wie B2B-Software, Beratung, IT, Personalberatung, Industrie, Dienstleistungen und weiteren B2B-Märkten zusammen.

Während deiner Einarbeitung lernst du alles über unsere Systeme, unsere Kampagnenprozesse, B2B-Leadgenerierung, Cold E-Mail, LinkedIn-Outreach, Kundenkommunikation und operative Projektsteuerung.

Vorkenntnisse im Bereich Leadgenerierung oder Online-Marketing sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend notwendig. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du strukturiert arbeitest, zuverlässig kommunizierst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest.

Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 1–3 Monate.

Nach der Einarbeitung bist du in der Lage, unsere Kunden professionell zu betreuen, interne Abläufe zu koordinieren und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Projekte sauber, zuverlässig und nach Plan umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Kundinnen und Kunden in unsere Leadgenerierungs-Prozesse
  • Regelmäßiger telefonischer und schriftlicher Kontakt mit unseren Kunden
  • Koordination laufender Kundenprojekte und Kampagnen
  • Sicherstellen, dass Kundinnen und Kunden jederzeit wissen, was der aktuelle Stand ist und welche nächsten Schritte anstehen
  • Vorbereitung von Kunden-Updates, Reportings und Statusübersichten
  • Interne Abstimmung mit Research, Kampagnenmanagement, Backoffice und Geschäftsführung
  • Nachhalten von Aufgaben, Deadlines und Kundenfeedback
  • Qualitätskontrolle von Listen, Kampagnen, Setups und Reportings
  • Pflege und Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse, Checklisten und SOPs
  • Unterstützung bei der Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Tools wie Smartlead, Google Sheets, CRM-Systemen, Zapier/n8n oder ähnlichen Systemen
  • Erkennen von Problemen, bevor sie beim Kunden zu Unzufriedenheit führen
  • Unterstützung bei der Verbesserung unserer Kundenbetreuung und Delivery-Struktur

Qualifikation

  • Sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten
  • Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten
  • Starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen und diese gleichzeitig sinnvoll zu verbessern
  • Freundliches, professionelles und verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Kunden
  • Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck und mehreren parallelen Projekten
  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Tabellen, E-Mail und Projektmanagement-Systemen
  • Interesse an B2B-Marketing, Leadgenerierung, Kundenbetreuung und Prozessen
  • Vorkenntnisse in Online-Marketing, Projektmanagement, Kundenbetreuung, Agenturarbeit oder Beratung sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend notwendig

Benefits

Strukturierte Einarbeitung

Du wirst Schritt für Schritt in unsere Prozesse, Tools und Kundenprojekte eingearbeitet. Du lernst, wie B2B-Leadgenerierung funktioniert, wie Kampagnen aufgebaut werden und wie wir unsere Kunden zum Erfolg führen.

Verantwortung ab Tag eins

Du wirst nicht nur einfache Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern nach und nach Verantwortung für Kundenkommunikation, Projektsteuerung und operative Abläufe übernehmen.

Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wenn du dich gut entwickelst, kannst du mittelfristig mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, zum Beispiel in Richtung Teamleitung, Operations Management oder Client Success Lead.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bekommst dadurch tiefe Einblicke in Strategie, Unternehmertum, B2B-Marketing und den Aufbau einer wachsenden Agentur.

Moderner B2B-Marketing-Ansatz

Du lernst moderne Methoden in den Bereichen Cold E-Mail, LinkedIn-Outreach, B2B-Datenrecherche, Automatisierung, CRM, KI-gestützte Prozesse und Kampagnenmanagement.

Kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre

Wir legen Wert auf klare Kommunikation, Zuverlässigkeit, hohe Standards und ein angenehmes Miteinander. Wir suchen Menschen, die mit uns an einem Strang ziehen.

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive

Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Unser Ziel ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit klaren Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wenn du Lust hast, Teil unseres Teams zu werden und unsere Kundenbetreuung sowie unsere operativen Prozesse auf das nächste Level zu bringen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Assets
descriptionHtml:
Optiver is building its Digital Assets trading capabilities and is looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer. This role sits in the Global Cloud Platforms team and will report to the Global Head of Cloud Platforms.

You will help build the foundations for a new trading tenancy on Optiver’s existing cloud platform. With a mature hybrid cloud infrastructure already in place, this role allows you to optimize it for the unique operational and performance needs of digital assets trading. Your focus in this role will be on extending our cloud platform to meet the performance demands of a latency-sensitive, always-on trading environment.

You’ll be accountable for delivering a secure, performant, and robust infrastructure that directly supports trading outcomes - stability, latency, resilience, and safe change in the digital assets space.

What you'll do 

  • Design low-latency infrastructure using cloud primitives and optimized configurations.

  • Own and enhance cloud infrastructure performance setups.

  • Build and run high-throughput, resilient connectivity patterns for exchange integrations.

  • Drive security hygiene both on and off cloud with secrets management, network segmentation and traffic isolation.

  • Implement governance and best practices for shared cloud platform ensuring safe multi-tenant operation.

  • Deliver infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terragrunt, following Optiver standards and workflows.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD and automated testing for changes minimizing risk in always-on markets.

  • Implement and enhance observability using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and similar tools.

  • Participate in operational ownership through incident response, post-incident improvement, and continuous hardening.

Who you are

  • Demonstrated expertise in owning production infrastructure as an engineer (Platform, SRE, or Infrastructure engineering background).

  • Deep cloud infrastructure knowledge, especially around VPC design, compute optimization, and performance networking features.

  • Proven ability to write and maintain Terraform modules and operate IaC safely through reviews, testing, and deployment pipelines.

  • Solid Linux fundamentals, including networking and systems performance tuning.

  • Ability to program in at least one language (e.g., Python or Go) for tooling, automation, and integration work.

  • Collaborative skills to work effectively with other team members and stakeholders. 

  • Ability to communicate technical information to both technical & non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to gauge business problems and prioritize tasks accordingly.

Strong preference will be given to candidates with:

  • Experience managing multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, AliCloud, etc) infrastructure.

  • Experience building & managing latency-sensitive systems in cloud (trading, real-time systems, market data, etc.).

  • Hands-on experience managing WebSocket infrastructure under burst load and unstable upstream conditions.

  • Solid understanding of exchange rate limits / quota models (including weight-based limits) and how to engineer systems to respect them without compromising trading performance.

  • Familiarity with high-performance networking concepts (e.g., SR-IOV, kernel/network tuning, exposure to RDMA/DPDK is a plus).

Who we are

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.

What you'll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool.
  • 27 paid vacation days plus all UK public holidays.
  • Daily breakfast and lunch, along with support on commuting expenses.
  • Private medical insurance, pension scheme, and ClassPass fitness membership.
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events.

title: Community Lead
descriptionHtml:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

At Accurx, we’ve supported thousands of healthcare organisations to deliver care for over 60 million patients. We’re used by 98% of GP practices and in 68% of NHS Trusts - that’s over 200,000 NHS staff each week.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that slow everything down and leave patients waiting. We're changing that. We’re transforming how NHS staff triage and prioritise patient demand, cut the admin that eats into clinical time, and work as one team across the system.

We've spent eight years proving care doesn't always need to happen in an appointment. In the best triage practices today, 40% of patient demand is resolved without one. Now we're taking that model system-wide – using AI to automate the work that slows healthcare down, connecting every part of the NHS and building the platform on which the future of healthcare work gets done.

About the role

You’ll support and scale one of the most engaged clinical communities in the UK. Our users already talk to each other every day. They share what works, solve problems together and advocate for better ways of working. But those conversations are spread across WhatsApp groups and Facebook channels, with no platform or structure behind them. Our ambassador programme is also ready to be taken further.

As our Community Lead reporting to the Head of Marketing, you’ll shape how healthcare professionals connect, learn from one another and drive change across the NHS. You’ll turn organic momentum into a scalable community that measurably drives product adoption, peer-to-peer learning and brand trust.

The challenges you’ll take on

  • Building strategic and large-scale communities: Shaping and delivering the long-term vision for our primary and secondary care communities, with community playing a clear role in driving product adoption and brand advocacy, not just engagement. You'll be actively running community initiatives, as well as setting the strategic direction.

  • Turning unstructured clinical conversations into scalable content: Creating repeatable ways to transform high-volume community conversations into user-led content, learning assets and programmes, using strong storytelling to make Accurx's value clear and compelling across the market.

  • Scaling advocacy through ambassadors and peer influence: Owning and evolving our ambassador programme that enable clinicians to influence their peers authentically, and aligning it closely with product and marketing priorities.

  • Owning our community platform and programmes: Choosing and implementing the right long-term platform to bring our community together, and deciding when existing tools are “good enough”. You’ll help Accurx invest in the right processes and operating models for a growing, multi-product, multi-care-setting community.

You should apply if...

  • You have proven experience building and growing communities in the thousands, ideally in SaaS, tech or healthcare. This is essential for the role.

  • You've used community as a core driver of commercial growth, product adoption or brand advocacy, rather than it being primarily focused on support, account management or research.

  • You have a strong track record of designing, running or scaling ambassador programmes and super-user initiatives that drive peer-to-peer learning and influence.

  • You can point to clear examples of turning unstructured community conversations into scalable, user-led content, with strong written communication and storytelling skills.

  • You bring a data-informed and tool-savvy mindset, using signals, feedback and AI to scale insight capture and content without losing authenticity.

  • You're a strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable partnering closely with Product, User Research, Implementation, Product Marketing and Events.

What's in it for you?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

title: Coördinator Regiosport PZC
descriptionHtml:
Middelburg- Zet jij de Zeeuwse sport elke dag op de kaart? Als Coördinator Regiosport bij de PZC geef je richting aan onze sportjournalistiek in Zeeland. Je combineert journalistieke ervaring met leiderschap en een sterke digitale visie. Je stuurt een team van sportjournalisten en freelancers aan én staat zelf met je voeten in de klei. Van het laatste nieuws over Zeeuwse voetbalclubs tot bijzondere verhalen over lokale sporters: jij weet wat er speelt, waar onze lezers op zitten te wachten en hoe je een verhaal digitaal tot leven brengt. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de PZC dé plek blijft voor regionaal sportnieuws!

Wat ga je doen?
Als Coördinator Regiosport ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en journalistieke koers van onze sportredactie. Je houdt overzicht, ziet kansen en zorgt ervoor dat goede ideeën daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf actief als journalist en mediamaker. Je werkt midden in het dynamische ritme van de sportjournalistiek. De ene dag stuur je de verslaggeving rond een belangrijke voetbalwedstrijd aan, de volgende dag werk je aan een verdiepend verhaal, een podcast of een nieuw digitaal format.

Dit ga je onder andere doen:

  • Je geeft leiding aan een sportredactie van drie collega’s en een groep freelancers en werkt zelf actief mee binnen het team;

  • Je bepaalt samen met de redactie de journalistieke koers voor regiosport in Zeeland en bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze sportverslaggeving;

  • Je zorgt voor actuele, onderscheidende en relevante sportcontent voor onze website, app en krant;

  • Je houdt scherp in de gaten welke onderwerpen leven onder Zeeuwse sportliefhebbers en weet die te vertalen naar sterke verhalen;

  • Je ontwikkelt nieuwe digitale formats, journalistieke producties en innovatieve ideeën waarmee we onze onlinepositie verder versterken;

  • Je volgt Zeeuwse sporters, clubs en ontwikkelingen binnen de regionale, nationale en internationale sportwereld op de voet;

  • Je maakt zelf interviews, achtergrondverhalen en analyses en levert waar mogelijk een bijdrage aan podcasts;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van de site, app en krant om grotere journalistieke producties van idee tot publicatie te realiseren;

  • Je coacht collega’s, geeft richting en stimuleert de redactie om zich journalistiek en digitaal voortdurend te ontwikkelen.

Wie zijn wij?
De PZC is hét nieuwsmedium van Zeeland en onderdeel van DPG Media. Iedere dag brengen we betrouwbaar nieuws, sterke regionale verhalen en actuele verslaggeving bij onze lezers. Dat doen we via onze krant, website en app en met verschillende digitale formats. Als Coördinator Regiosport kom je terecht op onze redactie in Middelburg. Een plek waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar volop ruimte is voor initiatief. We geloven in goede journalistiek, maar ook in de kracht van nieuwe ideeën. Heb jij een goed plan voor een nieuw format of een andere manier om sportverhalen bij onze lezers te brengen? Dan krijg je de ruimte om het uit te proberen.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
Je bent een ervaren en enthousiaste journalist die energie krijgt van sport, nieuws en het maken van verhalen. Je weet wat er speelt in de regio, maar kijkt ook verder dan de traditionele sportjournalistiek. Je ziet kansen in digitalisering en weet anderen daarin mee te nemen.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je ervaring in de sportjournalistiek en een sterke affiniteit met amateursport, met name voetbal;

  • Heb je een scherp journalistiek gevoel voor nieuws en weet je welke verhalen relevant en interessant zijn voor onze lezers;

  • Heb je ervaring met digitale journalistiek en weet je hoe je verhalen aantrekkelijk presenteert voor online doelgroepen;

  • Kun je een team inspireren, coachen en meenemen in nieuwe ideeën en ontwikkelingen;

  • Ben je communicatief sterk, overtuigend en in staat om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen binnen de kaders van de hoofdredactie;

  • Ben je creatief, nieuwsgierig en altijd op zoek naar manieren om onze sportjournalistiek beter en vernieuwender te maken;

  • Beschik je over een rijbewijs en ben je bereid om in Zeeland te wonen of op korte termijn naar de regio te verhuizen.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt.

Wat krijg je van ons?
Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

  • 💰Een salaris vanaf €4.000 tot € 6.100 per maand op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (fulltime);

  • 📝Een 38-urige werkweek (4 dagen in de week is bespreekbaar);

  • 💰8 % vakantiegeld en 4% persoonlijk keuzebudget;

  • 💰Jaarlijkse winstdeling op basis van de prestaties van DPG Media;

  • 💰Een interessante bonusregeling;

  • 🎓Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Academy/ DPG Campus;

  • 🏢Een dynamische redactie in Middelburg met flexibiliteit rondom thuiswerken.

Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquiz team of een sportteam is. Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op Instagram, LinkedIn en X.

Solliciteren, en dan?
Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct! Je ontvangt dan zo snel mogelijk een terugkoppeling. Zit je bij de eerste selectie, dan nemen we telefonisch contact met je op om een afspraak in te plannen. Meer weten? Neem dan contact op met Ronald van Geenen, hoofdredacteur, via

title: Copy Editor English
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

  • Outstanding communication skills, a passion for explaining language conventions, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs, ideally in an editorial process, and awareness of their limitations (hallucinations, biases, outdated sources) and of legal and ethical considerations around data use and copyright

  • Structured work approach to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing weekly priorities, plan around dependencies, and keep teams informed

You enjoy:

  • Working with people from all over the world

  • Learning about every aspect of a company, from engineering to user research

  • Exploring evolving technologies and tools

  • Keeping up with the latest developments in medical language

  • Sharing ideas about language with a close-knit team

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

  • 🧠 Learning & Development (Internal & external trainings, workshops & hackathons, AI cross-talks & seminars, Blinkist access, and more…)

  • ☀️ Work From Somewhere Sunny (Access to our offices in Cagliari and Cape Town, visit the HQs, Berlin in summer)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-remote

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

AMBOSS operates across multiple international markets and diverse verticals. If this specific role doesn’t feel like the perfect match, we encourage you to browse our other open positions in Editorial and beyond to find where you can make the biggest impact.

title: Creative Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Leads Power, c’est quoi ?

Une agence dont le cœur de métier est la lead gen, avec un pôle e-commerce en plein développement. On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses.

Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées.

Ton rôle

Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.

Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.

Ce que tu fais au quotidien

  • Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

  • Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

  • Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

  • Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

  • Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

  • Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

  • Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

  • Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

  • Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège

  • Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair

  • Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus)

  • Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées

  • Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe

  • Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback

  • Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats

Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si

  • Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même

  • Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher

title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk.

This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed.

It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time.

  • Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists.

  • Keep accurate records of every interaction.

  • Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved.

  • Spot issues that keep coming up and flag them to the team, rather than just closing your own ticket.

  • Help build out and improve our processes as the team grows.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience in a customer support or service role.

  • Excellent written English: clear, polite, accurate and free of typos, with the right tone for the situation.

  • A real eye for detail. You read carefully, check before you reply and notice when something doesn’t add up.

  • Calm under pressure, including with rude or unfair customers.

  • The ability to manage a busy queue and several priorities at once.

  • Ownership: you close loops, chase what’s stuck and ask when there’s no clear answer.

  • Openness to feedback and a willingness to learn.

  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Zendesk and Jira.

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training, mentorship and exposure to technical operations.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

  • Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm.

  • Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 (Negotiable)

  • Reports to: Customer Support Manager.

title: Data Center Warehouse Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

JDC Warehouse Specialist
Position Overview
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving & Dispatch
•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.
2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations
•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.
3. Inventory & Asset Control
•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.
4. Security, Safety & Compliance
•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).
5. Process & Continuous Improvement
•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.
6. Local Expertise
•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.
7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)
•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.
Expectations
Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit.

De rol

Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product.

Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning.

Wat je doet

  • Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten.

  • Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions.

  • Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar.

  • Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling.

  • Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt.

  • Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp.

  • Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels.


Wie je bent

Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitorde oplossing op.

Je bent proactief en signaleert zelf wat beter moet. Je bent op je plek in een scale-up: je kunt tegen wat chaos en je brengt structuur aan. Je legt trade-offs helder uit aan niet-technische collega’s.

Je maakt analytics engineers en analisten productief. Kunnen zij een tabel niet vinden, begrijpen of vertrouwen, of lopen ze vast op tooling of toegang, dan is het werk niet af.

Must-haves

  • Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure.

  • Diepgaande ervaring met dbt (Cloud) in productie: Jinja, geautomatiseerd testen, deployment pipelines en environments.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten en structureren van een Git-workflow: branchingstrategie, pull requests en code review.

  • Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code.

  • Snowflake of een vergelijkbaar warehouse.

  • Python en ingestie via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Data tests als standaard, oog voor cloudkosten.

  • Engels op professioneel niveau, schriftelijk en mondeling.

  • Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB).

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, Looker of data contracts, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen, B2B SaaS.

Stack

Snowflake (huidig warehouse), Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker.

Wat we bieden

  • Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data engineering bij Studytube neer te zetten.

  • Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag.

  • 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube.

  • € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek.

  • LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding.

  • Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest.

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden. De datalaag is nu de bottleneck. Wie die recht trekt, maakt de ambities op AI en klantwaarde mogelijk.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/
