title: Digitalisierungs-Lotse/-Lotsin
descriptionHtml:
Project Bay

Project Bay ist der erste Coworking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovationen im Norden. Die Themen Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden Büro- und Coworking-Flächen, Break-Out-Optionen sowie Fortbildungen, Freizeitangebote und Übernachtungen direkt am Meer auf Rügen.

Digitalisierungslotse/-lotsin für Rügen und Vorpommern

Menschen vernetzen. Ideen ermöglichen. Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten.

Standort: Project Bay, Rügen – Teil der sechs Digitalisierungszentren in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern

Deine Aufgaben

Als Digitalisierungslotse/-lotsin gestaltest du die digitale Entwicklung im ländlichen Raum aktiv mit. Dabei stehen nicht die Technologien, sondern die Menschen und ihre Ideen im Mittelpunkt.

  • Menschen vernetzen: Du bringst Unternehmen, Selbstständige, Vereine, Kommunen, Bildungseinrichtungen und kreative Köpfe zusammen und förderst neue Kooperationen.

  • Digitalisierung greifbar machen: Du vermittelst digitale Möglichkeiten verständlich, baust Berührungsängste ab und unterstützt Menschen dabei, eigene Lösungen zu finden – auf Augenhöhe statt durch klassische Beratung.

  • Eigene Projekte gestalten: Du entwickelst Workshops, Veranstaltungen, Netzwerkformate und Kooperationen und setzt eigene Schwerpunkte innerhalb des Projektrahmens.

  • KI aktiv nutzen und vermitteln: Du probierst KI-Anwendungen selbst aus, integrierst sie in deinen Arbeitsalltag, bildest dich weiter und gibst dein Wissen praxisnah weiter.

  • Regionale Potenziale stärken: Du erkennst Chancen, greifst Ideen auf und verbindest Menschen und Ressourcen, um die Digitalisierung auf Rügen und in Vorpommern voranzubringen.

Was diese Position besonders macht

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit und Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, Themen entdecken und Projekte weitgehend selbstbestimmt entwickeln.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten, das gelebt wird: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, unterschiedliche Arbeitsorte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsgestaltung gehören zur Unternehmenskultur. Vertrauen und Ergebnisse stehen im Vordergrund.

  • KI und Weiterbildung ausdrücklich erwünscht: Der Arbeitgeber unterstützt dich aktiv dabei, neue Technologien und insbesondere KI kennenzulernen, auszuprobieren und sinnvoll einzusetzen. Lernen und Experimentieren sind ausdrücklich Teil deiner Arbeit.

  • Ein vielfältiges regionales Netzwerk: Du arbeitest mit spannenden Menschen und Partnern aus Wirtschaft, Tourismus, Bildung, Kultur, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft zusammen – auf Rügen, in Vorpommern und darüber hinaus.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit Sinn: Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Du bist Impulsgeber:in, Netzwerker:in und Möglichmacher:in und kannst unmittelbar erleben, wie aus Begegnungen neue Ideen und Projekte entstehen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Neugier auf digitale Entwicklungen, Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen, Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und Lust, Neues auszuprobieren. Du musst nicht alles wissen – entscheidend ist die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam mit anderen zu lernen und Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Das Besondere

Du arbeitest nicht einfach Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du hast die Freiheit, Menschen, Ideen und Technologien miteinander zu verbinden und die digitale Zukunft einer ganzen Region aktiv mitzugestalten.

Neugierig? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Director, Global Partner Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

The Director of Global Partner Enablement is responsible for defining and scaling a global enablement strategy that drives partner preference, pipeline growth, and customer security outcomes across Sophos’ go-to-market model. This role ensures that partners—including VARs, MSPs, MSSPs, and distributors—are fully enabled to sell, deploy, manage, and expand Sophos solutions globally.

This leader combines deep channel expertise, practical AI fluency, modern learning approaches, and strong field execution. They will translate Sophos’ cybersecurity strategy into role-based, lifecycle-driven enablement that accelerates partner time-to-value and long-term commercial success.

The ability to use AI tools in a builder capacity will be critical to success in this role. This leader will use AI to scale partner curriculum and content production and establish repeatable processes for sourcing accurate technical content.

As part of the Global Go-to-Market Enablement team, this leader will partner closely with Global Channel, Regional Partner Leaders, Sales, and Marketing leadership to embed enablement into field execution. The role will also be accountable for delivering against specific AI-related OKRs established for the position.


What You Will Do

  • Execute a Partner-First GTM Enablement Strategy

  • Define and execute a global partner enablement strategy aligned to Sophos’ GTM model, partner program tiers, and regional growth priorities.

  • Ensure enablement supports key Sophos motions, including MSP/MSSP managed security services, solution selling, renewals, and expansion.

  • Lead change management initiatives that evolve partner behaviors in support of new GTM motions, platform adoption, and services-led selling.

  • Deliver Role-Based Partner Learning and Readiness Programs

  • Design and scale role-specific partner learning journeys across sales, technical pre-sales, implementation, managed services, customer success, and renewals.

  • Guide partners from onboarding through advanced competency and specialization, aligned to Sophos certifications, accreditations, and partner program requirements.

  • Apply adult learning principles, instructional design best practices, and skills-based frameworks to ensure learning drives behavior change and performance.

  • Maintain content lifecycle governance to ensure enablement stays current with product releases, platform evolution, and threat landscape changes.

  • Support MSP / MSSP Enablement and Field Execution

  • Ensure enablement directly supports MSP and MSSP business models, including recurring revenue motions, operational efficiency, and service differentiation.

  • Establish global enablement standards, frameworks, and governance while enabling regional flexibility based on market needs.

  • Collaborate with Regional Enablement and Field teams to support GTM launches, sales plays, campaigns, and priority partners.

  • Coordinate delivery of enablement such as workshops, simulations, solution playbooks, and technical labs that reinforce real-world execution.

  • Act as an executive escalation point for strategic partner enablement needs.

  • Define and Track Enablement Success Metrics

  • Ensure success metrics are tied to Sophos business outcomes, including partner ramp time, certification attainment, pipeline contribution, deal velocity, adoption, renewal rates, and expansion.

  • Leverage CRM, partner performance data, and field insights to identify skill gaps and optimize enablement investments.

  • Provide executive-ready reporting that demonstrates enablement impact on partner success and revenue growth.

  • Drive Content Strategy with Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Oversee the global partner enablement content strategy, including onboarding programs, solution and security playbooks, labs, partner toolkits, and just-in-time resources.

  • Serve as a cross-functional leader working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Partner Programs, Sales, and Channel to ensure alignment and consistency.

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global partner enablement team (direct and/or dotted-line), operating effectively in a matrixed environment.

  • Lead AI-Powered Partner Enablement

  • Use generative AI and prompt-driven workflows to scale partner curriculum, technical content, playbooks, labs, and self-service resources while maintaining appropriate human review.

  • Establish repeatable processes for sourcing, reviewing, governing, and publishing accurate technical content from Sales Engineers, Product, Product Marketing, and other SMEs.

  • Use platform data and partner feedback to improve content quality, production speed, adoption, and partner readiness.

What You Will Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in partner enablement, channel sales, customer success enablement, or learning and development within cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.

  • Deep hands-on experience enabling global channel partners across Americas, EMEA, and APJ, with strong understanding of MSP, MSSP, VAR, and distributor models.

  • Proven success designing and executing role-based, GTM-aligned learning programs that drive measurable partner performance.

  • Experience working closely with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success leaders in a partner-first organization.

  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define KPIs, analyze performance, and demonstrate enablement ROI.

  • Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence skills.

  • Practical AI fluency, including generative AI, prompt design, content transformation, and quality-review workflows.

  • Experience building AI-assisted enablement and technical content processes that balance speed, accuracy, governance, source traceability, and human judgment.

  • Experience supporting or scaling MSP/MSSP-centric GTM motions.

  • Familiarity with Sophos-style partner programs, certifications, and security solutions.

  • Experience with enablement platforms, LMS/LXP systems, partner portals, CRM (e.g., Salesforce), and content authoring tools.

  • Experience applying AI-driven learning and enablement tools to accelerate partner readiness, adoption & performance at scale.

  • Foundational understanding of instructional design, adult learning theory, and skills-based enablement frameworks.

  • Advanced degree in business, learning, or a related field.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

title: Director of Demand Generation
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role:

We’re looking for a proven B2B Demand Generation leader to own and scale our demand generation engine, reporting directly to the CMO. As Director of Demand Generation, you'll be responsible for driving predictable, scalable pipeline across self-serve and sales-led motions. This role sits at the heart of marketing and growth, integrating brand, product, content, lifecycle, and performance into a single demand strategy that fuels revenue across segments.

You’ll lead a high-performing team across all channels including paid media, SEO, ABM, Field Marketing and funnel conversion, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and RevOps to drive outcomes.

What you'll own:

  • Own and drive the demand strategy: Lead the global demand generation function across PLG and sales-led motions, aligning to our GTM strategy, ICPs, and revenue goals.

  • Deliver full-funnel pipeline growth: Drive consistent, scalable pipeline across channels (paid, SEO, ABM, lifecycle, web), tailored by segment, persona, and motion.

  • Build and scale repeatable programs: Design and execute high-impact, segment-specific campaigns that convert across startup, scale-up, and mid-market/enterprise tiers.

  • Develop our ABM motion: Create and optimise 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs to engage and accelerate high-value accounts in our upmarket GTM.

  • Partner cross-functionally to win: Align tightly with Sales, Growth, Product Marketing, Brand, and Web to deliver connected campaigns and shared pipeline outcomes.

  • Fuel pipeline with takedown campaigns: Activate targeted compete, product, and vertical plays in partnership with Rev Marketing and PMM.

  • Drive performance and experimentation: Own the reporting, optimisation, and attribution across the funnel, from signups and PQLs to revenue, using data to drive constant iteration.

  • Leverage AI to gain execution edge: Use AI to accelerate testing, targeting, personalisation, and workflow automation at scale.

  • Build the systems to scale: Ensure the right martech, data infrastructure, and operating cadence is in place to support repeatable, insight-led growth.

  • Lead a high-performing team: Hire, coach, and inspire a team of channel owners, strategists, and ops leads, driving clear accountability and shared outcomes.

Where You’ll Collaborate

  • Revenue Marketing: Partner to execute multi-channel campaigns aligned to sales-led GTM; provide reach, targeting, and conversion power to sales campaigns.

  • Growth: Coordinate on activation, onboarding, and expansion programs in PLG. Ensure alignment across product and marketing acquisition paths.

  • Product Marketing: Sync on ICPs, messaging, and conversion hooks to sharpen campaign precision and relevance.

  • Sales & BDMs: Inform outbound strategy through ABM insights and lead data; support campaign-level outbound acceleration.

  • Brand & Content: Ensure creative consistency and conversion alignment across all digital channels and surfaces.

  • RevOps & Marketing Ops: Partner on scoring, routing, attribution, funnel health, and reporting accuracy.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experienced B2B SaaS leader with 8+ years in marketing and 3+ years owning pipeline at Director or equivalent level, across both PLG and sales-led motions.

  • Proven demand driver you've built and scaled high-performing demand engines that deliver signups, PQLs, SQLs, and revenue at pace.

  • Full-stack channel expertise across paid media, SEO, ABM, lifecycle, web, and know how to integrate them into a cohesive, data-led system.

  • Commercially fluent you track CAC, velocity, LTV, and attribution with rigor, and use insight to guide prioritisation and budget allocation.

  • Segment-savvy and motion-aware you know how to tailor strategy by GTM motion (PLG vs sales-led) and segment (startup, scale-up, mid-market).

  • AI-literate and experimentation-led you constantly seek edge through automation, personalisation, and fast-cycle testing.

  • Strong cross-functional operator you partner tightly with Sales, Growth, Product Marketing, and Web to drive shared pipeline outcomes.

  • People-first leader you hire and scale high-performing teams with clarity, accountability, and a bias for impact over activity.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. title: Director of Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

The Team Mission

Strategic Partnerships is GetYourGuide's partner distribution channel. It generates a significant share of the company's revenue, with a team of 30 people across EMEA, the Americas and APAC. A dedicated partnership tech team sits in Product and Engineering; the Partnerships Director sets its product strategy.

Partners include online travel platforms, banks and loyalty programs, affiliate networks, travel agents and more. The ambition is to triple the channel within three years. That means changing how the channel operates, not optimizing the current momentum.

Your Mission

We are hiring a director-level leader to run the Partnerships function. You will set the strategy for growing the partner channel, set the product direction for the partner platform, and directly lead teams across sales, account management, and strategy and operations. The function was brought together in 2026 from two teams and is being rebuilt around partner segments. You get to shape it from close to the ground up, with the COO as your sponsor, and you run it end to end from day one.

This is a highly visible role based in Berlin, working in a hybrid model. We offer a competitive relocation package to support your move—successful candidates will be expected to be based in Berlin or happy to relocate.

What you will own

  • A high-revenue channel and its P&L. You set targets, own the forecast and partner economics, and run execution across EMEA, the Americas and APAC.

  • The strategy for how GetYourGuide wins through partners. You decide where we play and how we win in each segment, from global OTAs and loyalty programs to affiliate and travel-agent programs, and you make the calls on what we will not do.

  • The largest partnerships in travel. You personally lead negotiations with our largest partners and set terms that hold as volume scales.

  • The supply story. GetYourGuide has one of the largest experiences inventories in the market. You decide how we use it commercially with partners: what we offer exclusively, where, and on what terms.

  • The product direction for the partner platform. Partner technology is built in Product, but you set what it builds: the segment problems worth solving, the research behind them, and the roadmap they add up to.

  • A team of about 30, and its next shape. Regional leads, segment owners and a central RevOps team. You design the org, decide your leadership bench and raise the bar.

  • The operating rhythm. QBRs, metrics and prioritization that turn strategy into quarters of growth.

Must-haves

  • 15+ years of experience, ideally at VP or Director level, within a B2B SaaS or marketplace environment. Experience in Business Development and/or Revenue Operations (RevOps) is a plus

  • Business unit leadership, not only sales leadership. You have run a commercial P&L that combined several go-to-market motions (enterprise business development, account management, programmatic long-tail programs) and a team of 20 or more.

  • Strategy authorship. You have written a channel or segment strategy with clear choices and trade-offs, and then executed it.

  • Dealmaking. You have personally negotiated complex commercial agreements with large partners and can point to the terms.

  • People leadership. A track record of recruiting, developing and retaining strong commercial talent, including managing managers.

  • Product fluency. You can translate partner needs into problem statements a product team can prioritize, and you have worked closely with product and engineering leaders before.

  • Analytical rigor. You read the data yourself, challenge inconsistencies, and diagnose funnel and unit-economics problems.

  • Execution discipline. A high say-do ratio, sustained through an operating cadence rather than heroics.

  • Communication. You negotiate, influence and build relationships at C-level with partners and internally.

Nice-to-haves

title: Director of Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Job Title: Director of Product Management 

Location: Remote 

Company: PlayStation Studios 

As the Director of Product Management, you will work as part of the central Live Services team, reporting to the Head of Product Management for Live Service games at PlayStation Studios. Your primary responsibility is to work as a subject matter expert, leading a small central team collaborating with European game studios and other partners (analytics, marketing, etc.) to help build, launch, and manage successful live service games, while helping studios to build out top-notch embedded capabilities. 

Responsibilities

  • Work across multiple live and upcoming titles from PlayStation Studios, partnering closely with game studios and other partners to build capabilities and successfully launch and manage live service titles. 
  • Engage with game teams on everything from high-level product and commercial strategy to evaluating design specs and mockups, with a focus on product prioritization and roadmaps. 
  • Identify opportunities for product performance growth for various titles, influence key stakeholders, and drive initiatives to a successful outcome through strong relationships. 
  • Develop and share best practices to help game studios stand up and evolve their processes and capabilities. 
  • Define product strategy frameworks and standards for live service titles, tailoring approaches to the needs of individual games and studios. 
  • Define and evolve core KPIs in partnership with other publishing resources (analytics, research, marketing, etc), ensuring consistent measurement and actionable insights across titles. 
  • Establish and evolve live service operating rhythms (goal setting, performance reviews, experimentation, roadmap planning, decision trees) across titles. 
  • Partner with finance and forecasting teams to refine revenue models, ensuring assumptions align with product strategy and core KPIs. 
  • Manage, develop, and grow a small team of product management and live service design talent, leading and inspiring a highly skilled team. 
  • Connect development teams across PlayStation studios to the latest competitive research, analyze industry trends, and define best practices. 
  • Function as a conduit between multiple studios to foster knowledge sharing and deeper collaboration. 
  • Help define the processes and methodologies used centrally to level up our product management craft and improve the way we build and operate live service games. 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong experience in product management and/or live service design focused on feature development and live operations. 
  • Proven track record working in complex, matrixed development/publishing organizations to deliver outsized results on successful live games. 
  • Seasoned people leader with an ability to manage, lead and inspire a highly skilled team. 
  • Demonstrated track record of success driving initiatives that positively impact core KPIs. 
  • Expert data fluency and track record of partnering with analytics, research, and insights groups. 
  • Experience with game economy and/or monetization modeling and experience with analytical tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.). 
  • Diverse development experience spanning different types of games, genres, and business models (F2P, paid, cosmetic economy, etc.). 
  • Expert ability to connect creative vision, analytics, and business goals – turning data into actionable product and design decisions. 
  • Deep understanding of industry trends and the competitive landscape, including player motivations and audience segments across genres. 
  • Ability to understand, conceptualize, and improve the design of game systems, features, and mechanics, providing recommendations to shape the direction of the product. 
  • Experience working across products at different development stages (incubation, live operations, etc.). 
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with experience driving revenue forecasting and KPI frameworks for live service products. 
  • Experience working with publishing partners (marketing, release management, store, etc.). 
  • Experience partnering with leadership/executives at a studio and publishing level.

title: Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager - Semiconductor Metrology
descriptionHtml:
Lead Electrical & Electronics Engineering for Next-Generation Semiconductor Metrology

£65,000 - £83,000 + EMI Share Options + Private Healthcare + 3x Death in Service + Hybrid Working

Would you enjoy leading the electrical and electronics engineering capability behind technology that is helping semiconductor manufacturers push the limits of what is physically possible?

Infinitesima develops world-leading metrology solutions used by some of the most advanced semiconductor organisations in the world. Supported by Applied Ventures and backed by a growing global customer base, we're scaling rapidly and investing heavily in our engineering capability.

We're looking for an experienced Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the electrical systems, power distribution, electronics and signal acquisition at the heart of our products, along with the electrical safety and compliance of our platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to combine:

  • Technical leadership
  • People leadership
  • Semiconductor technology
  • Electrical and electronics engineering
  • Hands-on engineering

You'll influence both engineering strategy and product direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve complex technical challenges when needed.

Why Join Infinitesima?

You'll be working on technology that matters

Our products enable the development of next-generation semiconductor devices, supporting advances in computing, communications, AI and high-performance electronics.

You'll have genuine influence

This is not a maintenance management role. You'll help shape the future direction of our electrical and electronics platforms, engineering standards and technical roadmap.

You'll lead talented engineers

You'll support, mentor and develop a highly capable electrical and electronics team, building their ability to work through hard problems themselves rather than solving everything yourself, whilst helping attract the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll grow with us

We're already over 150 employees and continuing to scale as demand for our technology increases globally.

You'll split your time between the bench and the business

Expect a genuine mix: time in the office and, when your team needs it, hands-on at the lab bench working through difficult PCB, wiring or EMC problems alongside them. Equally, you'll spend time away from the bench in meetings, planning and shaping where the team goes next.

What You'll Be Doing

Leading and developing a high-performing electrical and electronics team

  • Coaching, mentoring and supporting engineers through regular development discussions
  • Building technical capability and encouraging engineering excellence
  • Creating an environment where people can do their best work
  • Providing supervisory oversight of the controls engineering function, ensuring close alignment with electrical and electronics priorities

Providing deep technical leadership on the hardest problems

  • Acting as the team's escalation point for complex PCB, electrical wiring and EMC issues, working through root cause and resolution with authority
  • Coaching engineers to build their own problem-solving capability, rather than solving every issue yourself
  • Bringing low-level design expertise to bear on system-level and architectural decisions

Driving electrical and electronics engineering strategy

  • Defining electrical system architecture, power distribution and electronics capability
  • Influencing future product development and technology roadmaps
  • Establishing engineering standards and best practice
  • Assessing the scope of new and unfamiliar projects and proposing solutions at an architectural level
  • Championing new ways of working, including the practical adoption of AI and other emerging engineering tools
  • Engaging with the competence management framework and advocating for improvements that strengthen the team's capability

Owning electrical safety and compliance

  • Taking responsibility for electrical cabinet design and power distribution across our platforms
  • Ensuring electrical safety and compliance throughout the product lifecycle, including CE marking and SEMI safety standards (e.g. SEMI S2)
  • Leading electrical risk assessments and supporting certification activities

Delivering robust electronics and measurement performance

  • Designing and reviewing electronics and power systems, with instrumentation and precision measurement forming part of the wider remit
  • Ensuring signal integrity across complex electrical and electronics platforms
  • Optimising power delivery, grounding and noise performance

Collaborating across engineering disciplines

  • Working closely with optics, controls, software, systems and mechanical engineering teams
  • Supporting successful project delivery from concept through to production
  • Driving technical decision-making across multidisciplinary programmes

What We're Looking For

You'll likely have gained experience in environments such as:

  • Semiconductor equipment
  • Semiconductor metrology
  • Electrical and electronics capital equipment
  • Precision measurement systems
  • Test and measurement
  • Advanced manufacturing equipment
  • Capital equipment development

Essential Experience

Candidates new to a formal people management role are welcome to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong track record of delivering complex electronics designs.

  • Leadership of electrical or electronics engineering teams
  • Analogue and mixed-signal electronics design
  • PCB design and signal integrity
  • Hands-on, low-level troubleshooting of complex PCB, wiring and EMC issues, with the credibility to guide others through them
  • Electrical cabinet design and power distribution within complex systems
  • Electrical safety and compliance, including CE marking and SEMI standards
  • Low-noise amplifier design and selection
  • ADC and DAC architecture and implementation
  • Signal generation, conditioning and acquisition
  • Power distribution and grounding within sensitive systems
  • Product lifecycle management and engineering change control
  • Cross-functional engineering leadership

Highly Desirable

  • Semiconductor metrology systems
  • Semiconductor capital equipment
  • Precision positioning systems
  • Piezo drive systems
  • EMC and environmental considerations
  • Instrumentation and precision measurement system experience
  • Frequency domain analysis
  • Electrical/electronics simulation and PCB design tools
  • NPI and manufacturing support
  • Experience applying AI or other emerging tools to engineering workflows
  • Experience with competence management frameworks or structured engineering development programmes

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st stage: (45 minute) Remote meeting to evaluate your experience and technical ability

2nd stage: (2.5 hours) Face to face onsite evaluating technical, presentation and communication skills along with your ways of working and your opportunity to to know more about us

If you're not comfortable with eye contact, let us know at the start of your interview and if REMOTE, once we've said hello, feel free to turn your camera off until the end.

Informal dress is absolutely fine for onsite interviews, we want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know. 

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

Location and working pattern:
We recognise the value of flexibility and offer a hybrid working model wherever possible. Most employees work onsite three days per week, although some positions require a greater onsite presence due to the nature of the work and business need

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. Please do not submit candidate details in response to this advert or solicit any Infinitesima Ltd employees. Infinitesima Ltd is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

title: Elektroplaner Smart Home als Content Creator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Remote · 4-Tage-Woche möglich · 50.000–80.000 € p. a. (Vollzeit)

„Smart Home oder konventionell?“ Die Frage landet immer bei dir, weil du dich sehr gut auskennst und auch gut erklären kannst? Dann komm zu uns und mach genau das zu deinem Job!

JETPLAN entwickelt die Zukunft der Elektroplanung – für Elektrohandwerk, Planer und Bauwirtschaft.

Wir suchen eine Person, die echte Planungspraxis aus dem Wohnbau mitbringt und daraus Videos, Musterplanungen und How-tos für YouTube und Social Media macht. Du bist das Gesicht, das zeigt, wie moderne und zunehmend KI-gestützte Elektroplanung mit JETPLAN funktioniert.

Dein Fachwissen ist dabei der Kern: Nur wer selbst plant, kann komplexe Themen so erklären, dass Elektriker und Bauherren wirklich etwas davon haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst How-to-Videos, Tutorials und Kurzformate für YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram & Co. Dabei erklärst du, wie typische Kundenwünsche in JETPLAN planerisch dargestellt werden.

  • Du erstellst normkonforme Musterplanungen für typische Wohnbauprojekte – vom Einfamilienhaus bis zur Wohnung, konventionell und Smart Home.

  • Du zeigst Systeme wie KNX, Loxone und DALI im Planungsalltag: Wann passt was, worauf kommt es an?

  • Du entwickelst Themen- und Formatideen mit und greifst Fragen aus der Community auf.

  • Mit deiner Planungserfahrung bringst du wertvolle Impulse in die Produktentwicklung ein.

Dein Publikum: Elektriker, Planer und planungsinteressierte Bauherren.

Wohin die Rolle wachsen kann

Im Kern geht es ums Planen, Erklären und Beraten vor der Kamera. Wenn du Lust und Erfahrung mitbringst, kann die Rolle deutlich strategischer werden: Du gestaltest die Content-Ausrichtung mit – welche Zielgruppen, welche Themen, wo Longform, wo Shortform –, spielst Inhalte gezielt über YouTube, Suche und Social Ads aus und wertest aus, welche Inhalte wirklich Anfragen bringen. Wie weit das geht, entscheiden wir gemeinsam – je nachdem, was du mitbringst.

Das bringst du mit

Du musst nicht aus einem Planungsbüro kommen: Quereinsteiger mit elektrotechnischer Ausbildung sind herzlich willkommen, vor allem aus dem Elektrohandwerk.

Das ist uns wichtig

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung von Elektroinstallationen, konventionell und Smart Home, mit Schwerpunkt Wohnbau (komplexe Anlagen, Zweckbau oder Industrie musst du nicht beherrschen)

  • Sichere Kenntnisse gängiger Systeme wie KNX, Loxone, DALI etc.

  • Du kannst gut beraten und Zusammenhänge einfach erklären

  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera, nimmst dich ohne Scheu beim Planen auf und hast eine natürliche Präsenz

  • Echte Freude an Elektroplanung und Smart Home

  • Fließendes Deutsch (zwingend)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Kenntnisse in der Lichtplanung

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt

  • Eigene Kanäle oder erste Content-Erfahrung auf YouTube oder Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit Content-Strategie, SEO oder Performance-Marketing

Das bieten wir

  • 100 % remote: Du arbeitest von dort, wo du am besten planst und aufnimmst.

  • 4-Tage-Woche möglich: Mehr Zeit für dich – bei gleichem Anspruch an deine Arbeit.

  • Gehalt: 50.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr bei 100 %, je nach Qualifikation

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Formate und Inhalte von Anfang an mit – und wenn du willst, auch die gesamte Content-Ausrichtung.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, Entscheidungen fallen schnell – ohne Politik, allein danach, was unseren Kunden wirklich hilft.

  • KI-Planung von Anfang an: Du arbeitest mit den neuesten Planungswerkzeugen und prägst, wie sie im Alltag funktionieren.

Bewirb dich – gern mit Video

Du brennst für Elektroplanung? Wir freuen uns auf dich! Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühesten Starttermin zu senden.

Statt eines Anschreibens freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Video (freiwillig, 1–3 Minuten, Handy reicht): Stell dich vor und erklär uns ein Smart-Home-Thema deiner Wahl – zum Beispiel, wann du KNX und wann Loxone empfiehlst. Falls vorhanden, verlinke gern Arbeitsproben oder eigene Kanäle.

title: Enablement Lead, Government
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact.

We work alongside public servants to move from initial exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI. Our work combines hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, community, content, and practical transformation tailored to government missions and operating environments.

By translating the potential of OpenAI’s technology into better individual workflows, stronger teams, and improved public services, we help government customers deepen adoption, build lasting organizational capability, and spend more time on mission.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Government is a specialist role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering experiences that support repeatable adoption frameworks, drive sustained activation, expand the breadth and depth of usage, and produce measurable value for government organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, education, adoption, community, content, and customer experience. It blends strong product fluency, instructional design, customer advisory, and a deep understanding of public service. You will lead live workshops, deliver enablement programs, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from front-line public servants and technical practitioners to senior government leaders.

You will be a trusted guide to government customers, helping them learn, share, teach, celebrate successes, and use AI confidently in their day-to-day work. You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective patterns for responsible adoption across government organizations.

  • Lead government customers through the full enablement lifecycle, from initial onboarding and activation through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

  • Define and manage structured enablement and deployment programs with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures of success.

  • Design and deliver high-impact engagements—including onboarding sessions, advanced capability training, executive briefings, academies, hackathons, listening sessions, and hands-on mission or workflow labs—for audiences ranging from senior leaders to front-line staff.

  • Guide government leaders, champions, technical teams, and working teams through organizational change by building confidence, establishing effective habits, and translating product capabilities into practical workflows and mission outcomes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for designated products, roles, or government mission areas, building deep expertise and identifying emerging public-sector use cases for new product capabilities.

  • Develop government-specific learning journeys, training materials, playbooks, FAQs, demonstrations, use cases, customer impact stories, and communications that enable high-quality adoption programs to scale.

  • Provide timely education for product launches, new features, and capability rollouts, translating product updates into clear and practical relevance for government users.

  • Advise government customers on workforce communications and engagement strategies that build awareness, confidence, participation, and sustained use.

  • Build trusted relationships with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, champions, and front-line public servants, creating experiences that reflect an understanding of their constraints, motivations, and responsibilities to the public.

  • Support government customer communities, events, and peer-learning experiences by keeping resources, discussions, updates, and thought leadership useful and current.

  • Identify and amplify government champions, creative use cases, and meaningful customer outcomes that encourage responsible experimentation, recognize public servants’ contributions, and help other organizations learn.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Product, Global Affairs, Communications, Marketing, Readiness, and other teams to deliver cohesive experiences for public-sector customers.

  • Gather and synthesize government customer feedback, adoption signals, participation data, and engagement outcomes to improve enablement programs and bring the voice of public servants back to Product and other internal stakeholders.

  • Identify patterns across government customers and translate them into scalable programs, content, playbooks, and best practices without losing the human connection required to support public servants effectively.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer-facing, enablement, instructional, adoption, or transformation roles, engaging executive, business, and technical audiences in government or similarly complex enterprise environments.

  • Understand and value public service and can build credibility with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, and front-line public servants.

  • Possess exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, particularly when translating complex AI capabilities into clear, accurate, and practical value for audiences with different levels of technical fluency.

  • Have experience designing learning journeys and leading workshops, training programs, executive engagements, customer events, or scaled adoption initiatives.

  • Bring strong practical fluency and enthusiasm across ChatGPT, Agents, and the broader OpenAI product ecosystem, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to real-world government workflows.

  • Are a versatile writer and storyteller who can turn complex information into useful and compelling training materials, presentations, demonstrations, communications, and customer stories.

  • Can connect product capabilities and enablement activities to measurable outcomes such as activation, sustained usage, improved quality, faster delivery, reduced administrative burden, better decision-making, risk reduction, customer satisfaction, or mission impact.

  • Can identify patterns across government customers and convert them into scalable systems, programs, content, and best practices.

  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, adapting in live customer environments, and bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.

  • Bring humility, empathy, curiosity, and a genuine desire to help public servants and colleagues succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and responsible evolution of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

 

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

     

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

 

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

 

Job details

  • Permanent Position

  • Full time

  • Location: Levallois or Berlin or Nantes

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

  • Remote Policy: Hybrid

 

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles!

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it!

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin. If you have a disability, let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process smoother for you!

title: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence

  

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

   

About the Role

 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform.

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT.

You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams.

At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office.

  

What You'll Do

 

Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the core processes of an energy provider, including timeseries data management, invoicing, and billing

  • Lead the design and operation of critical data pipelines, data quality standards, and observability practices

  • Run scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure on AWS for our mission-critical services

  • Drive great developer experience through CI/CD, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

  • Own IT operations and security: the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa’s systems and data safe

Our tech stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Postgres, ClickHouse, dbt, Metabase

  • Python (pandas, polars), TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, incident.io

  • Primo

   

Your First 90 Days

 

First 6 weeks (onboarding)

  • Build strong relationships with your direct reports, peers, and stakeholders

  • Understand each team’s current OKRs and how they impact the company

  • Get a solid understanding of our data architecture, infrastructure, and security posture

By month 3 (ramp-up)

  • Review operational health and tech debt across both teams, and present a prioritized plan for improvements in observability, data health, and scalability

  • Define and share a clear vision and roadmap for Data Intelligence and Platform, including how we improve developer experience

  • Assess our IT operations and security practices, and plan how they scale with trawa’s growth

  • Align next quarter’s roadmap with stakeholders and company OKRs, and communicate it broadly

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup. You’ve led across multiple teams and know how to balance competing priorities.

  • Deep hands-on background in data platform/data engineering or platform engineering/SRE/DevOps, and solid working knowledge of the other

  • Strong AWS experience: infrastructure as code, cloud-native patterns, containerized systems, with a good grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

  • Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

  • Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds can thrive

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

   

Why Join Us

 

🌍 Real impact - At trawa, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We value creativity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives.

 

🚀 Early ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

🤝 Mentorship that matters - Regular leadership sessions, cross-functional exposure, and engineers who are genuinely invested in your growth.

 

📚 Learning culture - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

 

🌐 Inclusive by design - We’re an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

🎁 Solid benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Enterprise Delivery Lead
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith
Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role
Delivery Lead’s run our most complex customer engagements, from kickoff to go-live and beyond. Some deployments are larger than others. They involve multiple legal teams across regions, several integrations, demanding IT and security requirements, and senior stakeholders with different priorities. On these engagements, you'll own the plan and the outcome. That means scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance and communication, so that our Legal Engineers and Deployment Engineers can focus on the build.

You'll work side by side with both. Legal Engineers configure the platform around how the legal team works, and Deployment Engineers connect it to the customer's systems. You'll make sure the two work streams move together, that the customer is ready for each one, and that everyone, on our side and theirs, knows what happens next and who owns it. It's part delivery lead, part stakeholder manager, and part problem solver.

You don't need to be a lawyer or an engineer. We're looking for experienced project managers who have run complex enterprise technology rollouts, who are comfortable with senior stakeholders, and who keep a programme moving when it gets difficult.

What you'll do

  1. Own the Engagement

  • Run our most complex customer engagements end to end, from kickoff through go-live to handover

  • Build and own the project plan, including scope, milestones,dependencies, owners and timelines, and hold everyone to it

  • Be the customer's main point of contact for delivery, and the person accountable for getting them live

  1. Lead the Delivery Team

  • Coordinate Legal Engineers and Deployment Engineers so configuration and integration workstreams move in step

  • Sequence the work so dependencies are resolved before they block progress

  • Bring in Legal Intelligence, Support Engineering, Product and Engineering when the engagement needs them

  1. Stakeholders & Governance

  • Run kickoffs, steering committees and status reporting with General Counsel, Legal Ops, IT and procurement

  • Align stakeholders with competing priorities, and keep decisions, actions and changes documented

  • Manage scope carefully, agreeing changes explicitly rather than letting them drift

  1. Risk & Change

  • Identify delivery risk early, including resourcing, dependencies, customer readiness and timelines, and act on it

  • Escalate to the VP of Transformation with clear options when an engagement needs intervention

  • Help customers prepare their teams for change, working with Enablement on rollout and training

  1. Improve How We Deliver

  • Turn what you learn into delivery templates, governance models and planning standards for complex engagements

  • Share patterns and recurring blockers with the wider Transformation team and Product

What we're looking for

  • Experience running complex enterprise technology implementations or programmes, ideally SaaS and ideally legal tech

  • A track record of delivering multi-workstream projects on time, with many stakeholders and dependencies

  • Confident with senior stakeholders, including General Counsel, CIOs and procurement, and able to hold a room

  • Technical enough to understand integrations, SSO and configuration well enough to plan them and spot risk

  • Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work, or the curiosity to learn it quickly

  • Disciplined about scope, governance and documentation without being bureaucratic

  • Calm under pressure, with the judgement to escalate at the right moment

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication

Typical Backgrounds Include

  • Project or programme managers in enterprise SaaS

  • Delivery leads from technology consultancies

  • Legal Operations Professionals who have led a major technology rollout

  • Implementation managers in CLM or legal tech

How we work

We're an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you'll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You'll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work closely with our Legal Engineers and Deployment Engineers, alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support

Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. Our largest customers are some of the most complex legal functions anywhere, and how well we deliver for them shapes adoption, renewal and expansion. Project Managers are the people who make those engagements succeed.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a highly organised & proactive Executive Assistant for our Executives. You will be the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, ensuring efficiency and seamless operations. Your focus will be on managing key personal & professional priorities, and providing administrative and strategic support—allowing our execs to focus on scaling the business through the next phase of growth!

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time as we’re scaling fast and building the category-defining agentic operating system for procurement. And we are looking for the best Executive Assistant out there to help us turn procurement into a true competitive advantage!

What Can You Expect?

As the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, you’ll proactively coordinate, manage and keep track of your assigned Exec's schedules, projects and commitments. You will work closely with the Omnea leadership team and act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders on all matters related to our execs. You are someone who acts like an owner, can craft at speed and loves working in a fast-paced environment with significant impact.

You’ll provide strategic and executive support, by managing our executives' complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling across multiple time zones. You’ll own email and communication filtering as well as prioritising, drafting, and responding as necessary.

You’ll act as a gatekeeper, ensuring our executives’ time is spent on high-impact activities. You will manage conflicting priorities and prioritise different demands, you’ll focus on solutions, and are comfortable navigating change and removing blockers.

You’ll plan, schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure agendas are well prepped, action items tracked, minutes taken and follow-ups done in a timely manner. You’ll also assist with board materials, investor updates, and briefing notes.

You’ll organise and book all travel, including flights, hotels, transfers and visas. You’ll prepare detailed travel itineraries and handle last-minute changes seamlessly.

You’ll own all operational and administrative tasks, such as expenses, invoices, and budget tracking related to our executives' activities.

You’ll act as the first point of contact for all key stakeholders, including prospects and customers on behalf of our executives. You’ll manage confidential information with the highest level of discretion. You’ll also proactively solve problems and anticipate potential issues before they arise.

You’ll own systems & processes that improve productivity, such as identifying and implementing tools or processes that reduce admin workload and help outsource and delegate non-essential tasks effectively.

En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances.

Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique.

Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données

· Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites.

· Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée.

Porter la migration vers Databricks

· Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données.

· Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code).

· Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences.

Prendre en charge la dimension géographique

· Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels.

· Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions.

Assumer un rôle de leadership technique

· Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe.

· Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions.

· Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming).

Stack technique

· Environnement : Databricks

· Langages : Python, SQL

· Framework : Spark

· Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres

· DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker

· Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus

  • La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vos compétences :

  • L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

  • Clarté et transparence dans la communication

  • Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe.

Expérience :

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production.

  • Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL.

  • Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark).

  • Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks

  • Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance.

title: Head of Global Operations
descriptionHtml:
Benetics AI helps construction teams spend more time building and less time on documentation. Our voice assistant works in 100+ languages. Over 500 companies across 10+ countries already use it. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive, and growing in triple digits.

Our next phase takes us further across Europe and into the US. We are looking for a hands-on operations leader to build how the company runs: turn strategy into operating and financial plans, give teams clear priorities, and make sure we deliver as we grow internationally.

We run a human-augmented company where details are key. Once we identify and understand problems, we automate and steer. Work with a world-class team to become a global player.

Tasks

Reporting to the CEO, you own how Benetics plans, operates, and executes. You connect the founders and team leads, turn priorities into funded plans with clear responsibilities, and stay close to the work. You build the processes, team, and financial visibility we need to make decisions and follow through.

Build the way we run the company

  • Turn company strategy into an annual operating plan with clear priorities, targets, owners, and quarterly milestones.

  • Run weekly execution reviews and monthly business reviews. Track performance, resolve cross-team bottlenecks, and follow through until decisions turn into results.

  • Own the annual budget and rolling forecasts for revenue, costs, and cash. Connect the financial plan to hiring, capacity, and international expansion.

  • Build and lead the operations function. Set clear responsibilities, hire and develop people, and decide where specialist partners can help us scale.

  • Get into the work yourself: fix broken things, improve internal processes, and automate repetitive tasks. Build systems the team can use without relying on the founders for every decision.

Internationalisation

  • Turn market-entry decisions into launch plans with owners, milestones, budgets and clear criteria for readiness.

  • Get on the ground in priority markets. Meet customers and partners, understand local workflows and resolve the practical barriers to adoption.

  • Coordinate local hiring, service providers, operating arrangements such as reseller contracts and entity setup. Make sure each market can deliver what we sell.

  • Build repeatable operational GTM playbooks while adapting to how customers actually work in each country.

Business foundations

  • Manage operating spend, purchasing and provider performance against the agreed plan. Make sure external partners deliver and spending decisions have clear owners.

  • Coordinate the fiduciary, payroll providers and legal counsel so financial reporting, employment administration and compliance keep pace with expansion.

  • Ensure finance and legal work has clear owners and deadlines. Accounting, tax filings and complex legal advice sit with qualified specialists; your responsibility is to make the overall operation work.

Requirements

  • Experience owning an operations function or substantial business unit as Head of Operations, Director of Operations, General Manager or in a comparable role.

  • A track record of turning strategy into operating plans, building practical processes and improving execution as a business grows, ideally across countries.

  • A record of leading people and cross-functional execution, with personal accountability for results.

  • Comfort switching between a market expansion plan and the practical work needed to deliver it: visiting a customer, fixing a handover, selecting a provider or coaching a new hire.

  • Experience owning budgets, financial forecasts and business performance reviews. You can connect operational choices to cash and unit economics, and use the numbers to guide hiring, spending and growth.

  • Fluent in German and English, and willing to travel regularly across Europe and to the US as the business requires.

  • Experience with building

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B software, frontline workforces, or construction.

  • A Chief of Staff, consulting or founder background with direct responsibility for implementation, teams and measurable operating outcomes.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You build the plan, work through the numbers, and solve operational problems yourself. You also develop the people and systems that let the company run well across markets as it grows.

Benefits

  • A direct partnership with the CEO and responsibility for how Benetics runs, allocates resources, and scales internationally.

  • The scope to build a global operations function and see the effect of your work with customers and colleagues.

  • Freedom to choose practical tools, providers and ways of working.

  • A Zürich base, on site Monday to Thursday when not traveling, with flexible hours and holiday planning.

  • Salary plus a meaningful piece of the company.

How we hire

  1. Introduction, 15-minute video call

  2. Conversation with one of the founders, 30 minutes, about the company, the numbers and the role

  3. A practical case with the team, remote or in Zürich. We work through our real model and one open question together. There is no homework to hand in.

  4. Final conversation and decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

We're looking for a Finance Data Engineer to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the technical transformation of Finance by building the data foundations, pipelines, and internal tools that enable Finance teams to operate more efficiently and make better decisions.

Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with Finance stakeholders and Voodoo's central Data team, combining data engineering, business understanding, and product thinking to turn complex Finance needs into reliable and maintainable solutions.

  • Identify AI and automation opportunities, take them from prototype to production, and measure the value they create

  • Help Finance teams adopt data and AI tools effectively through documentation, training, and day-to-day support

 

Profile

  • Significant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including ownership of production-grade data solutions

  • Proven track record of building or substantially improving a modern data platform or analytics stack

  • Highly proficient in SQL and comfortable building production systems in Python

  • Strong software-engineering practices applied to data work: testing, version control, code review, documentation, and monitoring

  • Solid understanding of core corporate Finance and accounting concepts; familiarity with French accounting principles is a strong advantage
