title: Online Dozent (m/w/d) für IT-Administration und Cyber Security
descriptionHtml:
Über Bildung für Morgen

Die Bildung für Morgen GmbH mit Sitz in München ist ein AZAV-zertifizierter Bildungsträger, der aus der Tomorrow Education Group hervorgegangen ist. Das Unternehmen qualifiziert Erwachsene durch Weiterbildungen, Umschulungen und Quereinstiegsprogramme in den Bereichen Technologie, Wirtschaft und Handwerk und unterstützt sie bei der nachhaltigen Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du bringst Erfahrung in IT-Administration und Cyber Security mit und möchtest dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung weitergeben? Dann teile dein Know-how als Senior Dozent*in bei Bildung für Morgen! Als Dozent*in gestaltest du die Lernerfahrung unserer Teilnehmenden und verantwortest ihren Erfolg. Du entwickelst praxisnahe sowie spannende Lehrinhalte und schaffst als Mentor*in eine fehlerfreundliche, wertschätzende und motivierende Lernatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe. Dein Ziel ist es, die Teilnehmenden zum Abschluss zu begleiten und das Fundament für eine erfolgreiche Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt zu legen. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrungen ins Team ein und teilst sie mit deinen Kolleg*innen, um auch gemeinsam voneinander zu lernen und die Qualität unserer Lehre weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Durchführung von Kursen: Du führst täglich Online-Unterricht (e-Lectures, Live-Demonstrationen) am Vormittag durch und betreust die Kursteilnehmenden beim Selbststudium, bei Praxisaufgaben, in Intensivgruppen und in Sprechstunden (unterstützt durch einen Teaching Assistant).

  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Lehrmaterialien: Du erstellst praxisnahe Lernmaterialien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam. Weiterhin bist du verantwortlich für die fachliche und didaktische Qualität und dafür, die Lehrinhalte und Aufgaben zum Selbststudium kontinuierlich zu verbessern und zu aktualisieren.

  • Teilnehmerbetreuung und Kursmanagement: Du unterstützt die Teilnehmenden aktiv beim erfolgreichen Abschluss des Moduls, koordinierst die Aufgabenbearbeitung sowie deren Beurteilung und Reporting. Dabei bringst du dich aktiv in die tägliche Betreuung der Teilnehmenden ein, entwickelst gezielte Initiativen für leistungsschwächere Teilnehmende und arbeitest eng mit unserem Student Success Team zusammen.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Kenntnisse in IT-Administration und Cyber Security: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachinformatiker, abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbaren Abschluss. Neben deinen mindestens fünf Jahren praktischer Erfahrung hast du auch Erfahrung in der Lehre gesammelt. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik (OSI-Modell, Routing, VLANs) und Systemadministration (Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux) mit. Du arbeitest sicher mit Virtualisierungslösungen wie Hyper-V und verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in der Netzwerksicherheit (Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN). Die Automatisierung von Aufgaben über Skriptsprachen wie PowerShell und Bash ist dir ebenfalls vertraut.
    Darüber hinaus verfügst du über Kenntnisse in Blue- und Red-Team-Konzepten und hast praktische Erfahrung mit gängigen Security-Tools und -Plattformen, z. B. Snort, Suricata oder Wazuh. Ein fundiertes Verständnis etablierter Security-Standards, Frameworks und Referenzmodelle (z. B. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK und OWASP Top 10) rundet dein Profil ab.

  • Analytisch und teamorientiert: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst strukturiert und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Dabei begeistert es dich, anderen dein Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen.

  • Proaktivität: Du hast ein Auge für Potenziale und arbeitest kontinuierlich an der Verbesserung der Inhalte mit.

  • Sprache und Kommunikation: Deine fließenden Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau) und deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen es dir, Lerninhalte klar und motivierend zu vermitteln.

  • Freude am Lehren und Lernen: Dich begeistert es, anderen Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Du bringst eine Affinität zur (Online-)Lehre / E-Learning und web-basierten Lernprogrammen mit.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.).

  • Tolles Team: Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Team-Events in Berlin und remote, damit auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt.

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Online Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own online marketing at Agent F from the first click to live revenue. Ad spend per channel, the funnels behind it, the landing pages, the email sequences, the tracking: all of it is yours to build, measure and improve. You will produce funnel content yourself, brief agencies and freelancers for the rest, and run experiments until the numbers move.

The idea is simple and unusual for our category: sell business software the way consumer products are sold online. Our buyers are finance and operations leaders at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies, and they search, click, compare and book like everyone else. You will find the channels, messages and paths that bring them to a demo or a sign-up at a cost that works, and you will keep looking for the next growth hack when the last one stops working.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means pipeline and live ARR that trace back to marketing.

What you will build and own

  • Paid acquisition. Budget allocation across channels, campaign setup and optimisation, creative testing. Cut what does not convert; scale what does.

  • Funnels and conversion. Landing pages, sign-up and demo-booking flows, email nurture. Continuous experimentation, measured against one dashboard. Work with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path.

  • Search and discoverability. Organic and AI-search visibility: the content and pages that bring qualified traffic, with the technical basics handled with engineering.

  • Content for the funnel. Ads, landing copy, lead magnets and sequences produced in-house; agencies and freelancers briefed and managed for the rest.

  • Measurement. Attribution from spend to live ARR; cost per lead, cost per qualified opportunity, cost per signed and per live euro of ARR. Weekly reporting to sales and leadership.

  • Lead hand-over. Define what a qualified lead is together with the Head of Sales, hand it over cleanly and close the loop on what became pipeline.

For example, a paid campaign brings traffic but few demo bookings. You would look at the landing page, the audience and the offer, run two or three variants, move the budget to what converts, and report the change in cost per qualified opportunity the following week.

What you bring

You have four or more years in performance or growth marketing for B2B software, with full ownership of a budget and a conversion target. You have run paid channels, built landing pages and funnels, and you can show the numbers.

You can explain an experiment that worked and one that did not, what you measured and what you changed. You are comfortable with analytics tools, spreadsheets and tracking, and you use AI tools for content and analysis every day. You do not need to be loud; you need to be curious, rigorous and fast.

Core experience

  • Paid acquisition across search, social and display for B2B software, with owned budgets.

  • Landing pages, funnels and conversion optimisation, including A/B testing.

  • Search and AI-search visibility: content, structure, technical basics.

  • Email marketing and lead nurturing.

  • Analytics, tracking and attribution; working comfortably in spreadsheets and dashboards.

  • Producing funnel content in German and English with AI tools; briefing agencies and freelancers.

Useful additional experience

Marketing for ERP, accounting or finance software; product-led growth and self-serve funnels; marketing automation and CRM integration; programmatic or data-driven content.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set up the measurement, take over the existing channels and pages, and run the first experiments on the highest-volume path from ad to demo. You would agree the definition of a qualified lead with sales and start reporting weekly.

We would look for a falling cost per qualified opportunity, more qualified traffic, a funnel that converts better each month and pipeline that sales can confirm.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in numbers that are correct and campaigns that run clean. Campaigns and funnels are monitored daily; broken tracking, failing pages or runaway spend are fixed the same day.

You keep sales informed about what is coming into the funnel and close the loop on what happened to it. When a launch or a campaign needs attention outside normal hours, you are there.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the Head of Sales on lead quality, with the Social Media & External Communication Manager on content and amplification, and with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path. You will use AI tools for content, analysis and reporting and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

Start a conversation

Share a funnel or campaign you owned end to end. Tell us the budget, the numbers before and after, the experiments you ran and what you would do next. Screenshots of dashboards are welcome.

title: Opérateur CNC / Programmeur FAO - Usine de Paris
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Paris (usine)
Type de contrat : Temps plein
Salaire : Compétitif
Participation au capital : Alignée sur le marché

Description du poste :

Programmez, réglez et faites fonctionner des machines CNC de pointe afin de fournir des composants de haute précision à des clients des secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense, de l'énergie et de la robotique.

Vous serez responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vie de l'usinage — de la programmation FAO et de la validation du premier article à l'optimisation des temps de cycle et à la production en série — contribuant ainsi à la mise en place de l'usine la plus efficace du réseau.

Il s'agit d'un poste pratique, impliquant une grande autonomie, destiné à une personne fière de respecter des tolérances strictes, d'assurer des réglages précis et de s'engager dans une démarche d'amélioration continue.

Responsabilités principales :

  • Programmer, simuler et optimiser les parcours d'outils CNC (3 axes, 5 axes et fraisage-tournage le cas échéant)

  • Configurer, valider et exécuter les tâches conformément aux normes de l'aérospatiale et de la défense

  • Réduire les temps de cycle et améliorer l'utilisation des machines

  • Concevoir et améliorer les stratégies de fixation

  • Sélectionner l'outillage et les paramètres de coupe pour les matériaux difficiles (par exemple, l'aluminium, les aciers, le titane, l'Inconel)

  • Maintenir des normes de qualité élevées et garantir une fabrication sans défaut dès la première fois

  • Accompagner le lancement de nouvelles pièces (NPI) du dessin à la production

  • Contribuer aux retours d'information sur la conception pour la fabrication (DFM) destinés aux clients

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et les équipes du logiciel MasonOS pour améliorer la saisie des données, la planification et l'automatisation

  • Standardiser les approches de programmation sur l'ensemble des sites à mesure que nous nous développons

Compétences requises :

  • Solide expérience en programmation FAO (par exemple, Fusion, Hypermill, Mastercam ou équivalent)

  • Capacité avérée à usiner avec des tolérances serrées (±0,01 mm et moins si nécessaire)

  • Expérience dans le réglage et l'utilisation de machines CNC haut de gamme (par exemple Hermle, DMG Mori, Mazak ou similaire)

  • Connaissance approfondie des avances, des vitesses, des stratégies d'outillage et des systèmes de serrage

  • Une expérience dans l'aérospatiale, la défense ou d'autres secteurs hautement spécialisés est un atout

  • Capacité à lire et à interpréter des dessins techniques complexes et les cotes de tolérance géométrique (GD&T)

  • A l'aise pour travailler dans un environnement dynamique et responsabilisant

Atouts :

  • Expérience en usinage simultané 5 axes

  • Expérience en matière de palpage, d'automatisation ou de systèmes de palettes

  • Connaissance des systèmes qualité AS9100 / ISO9001

  • Intérêt pour la robotique, l'automatisation industrielle et la fabrication basée sur les données

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Travailler sur des composants critiques pour l'aérospatiale et la défense

  • Accès à des machines-outils de pointe et à des solutions d'automatisation en constante évolution

  • Participation au capital d'un réseau d'usines en pleine expansion

  • Possibilité d'influencer les normes de programmation sur l'ensemble des sites

  • Une culture de la performance axée sur l'amélioration continue

À propos d'Isembard :

Isembard s'est donné pour mission de stimuler l'accélération industrielle. Nous permettons la fabrication de produits plus rapides et moins coûteux pour les industries critiques en combinant des machines-outils de pointe, la robotique et notre logiciel propriétaire, MasonOS. Les composants que nous fabriquons sont utilisés dans l'aérospatiale, la défense, l'énergie et d'autres secteurs d'importance stratégique.

Nos valeurs :

  • Si ce n'est pas maintenant, alors quand ?

  • Suivre les cinq maximes

title: Operational Controls Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, working across all operations functions. This team is the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale.

The opportunity

We're looking for someone to become the person who tells us, with confidence, whether our operations are actually working the way we think they are. You'll build and run our first-line controls programme from the ground up, working across deeply technical specialists and senior stakeholders alike. As Griffin scales, our control framework has to scale with it. You'll be central to making that happen, turning quality controls and assurance into a genuine source of confidence for the business.

What success looks like

In your first year, you'll have built meaningful relationships across every corner of Griffin, from operations teams to second line risk and compliance. You'll have helped stand up our controls capabilities from scratch, and you'll have taken full ownership of the RCSA process for the Service guild. Along the way, you'll have developed the QA/QC testing frameworks and MI that help leadership see exactly where our controls are strong and where they need attention.

To do this you'll own

  • Quality assurance reviews and quality control testing across operations, ensuring processes are executed accurately and in line with approved procedures

  • Sample-based testing and control checks, identifying errors, control gaps, exceptions, and potential operational risks

  • Corrective action and remediation plans, working with operations teams to close out issues within agreed timelines

  • The Service guild controls attestation framework, and support risk owners in first-line RCSA exercises

  • QA/QC testing frameworks, control checklists, sampling methodologies, and quality standards

  • Regular QA/QC reporting and MI, feeding into Griffin-wide operational risk reporting

  • Coordination of internal audit, external audit, compliance, risk, and regulatory reviews, providing evidence of operational controls and remediation

We expect you to shape this role:

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves,that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

We're looking for people who have:

  • Strong experience in Operations QA/QC, control testing, transaction testing, or operational risk management within a bank or financial institution

  • Experience reviewing operational processes and identifying errors, exceptions, control weaknesses, and process gaps

  • Experience making recommendations to strengthen controls.

  • Strong analytical and MI/data analysis skills, with experience producing QA/QC reports, dashboards, and trend analysis

  • The ability to challenge Operations constructively and operate with an independent control mindset

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

What can we offer you?

  • Salary: £50-60k (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Operational Risk & Data Analist
descriptionHtml:
Operational Risk & Data Analist
Almere | 36–40 uur

Ben jij analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig van aard en krijg je energie van het onderzoeken van risico's? Vind je het leuk om grote hoeveelheden informatie te analyseren, verbanden te leggen en risico's om te zetten in concrete adviezen? Dan ligt hier misschien jouw volgende uitdaging.

Binnen MSPS Groep speelt de afdeling Legal & Risk een belangrijke rol bij het beheersen van operationele, financiële en integriteitsrisico's. Wij ondersteunen de organisatie met risicoanalyses, klantbeoordelingen en monitoring van onze portefeuille, zodat we verantwoord kunnen groeien en zorgverleners optimaal kunnen ondersteunen.

Wat ga je doen als Operational Risk & Data Analist?

Als Operational Risk & Data Analist ben jij de nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die risico's signaleert voordat ze problemen worden. Je analyseert klanten, processen en data, brengt risico's in kaart en adviseert collega's over passende beheersmaatregelen.

Daarnaast werk je samen met verschillende afdelingen zoals o.a. Finance, Legal en Klantexpert Teams aan vraagstukken op het gebied van klantacceptatie, fraude, portefeuillebeheer, integriteit- en risicomonitoring en het tegengaan van het financieren van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering (Wwft). Je analyseert klant-, declaratie- en financiële data, onderzoekt opvallende signalen en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen, rapportages, dashboards en risico-indicatoren.

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden?

  • Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses op nieuwe klanten, bestaande klanten en contractwijzigingen;

  • Beoordelen van bedrijfs-, financiële en klantinformatie en vertalen naar concrete risico- en acceptatieadviezen;

  • Signaleren van risico's, trends en afwijkingen binnen de klantenportefeuille;

  • Onderzoeken van opvallende transacties, declaraties, fraude-indicatoren en andere integriteitsvraagstukken;

  • Uitvoeren van data-analyses op grote hoeveelheden klant-, declaratie- en financiële data;

  • Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van risico-indicatoren, rapportages en dashboards in samenwerking met Business Intelligence;

  • Adviseren van management en interne stakeholders over risico's, beheersmaatregelen en verbetermogelijkheden;

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering en datagedreven ontwikkeling van Risk binnen MSPS Groep.

Wie ben je en wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je hebt enkele jaren relevante werkervaring binnen Risk, Compliance, Fraude, Financial Services of een vergelijkbare omgeving;

  • Je hebt ervaring met Power BI, data-analyse en dashboarding en weet grote hoeveelheden data om te zetten in bruikbare inzichten voor de business;

  • Je hebt uitstekende Excel-vaardigheden, waaronder het werken met complexe formules, draaitabellen en gegevensanalyses.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met Wwft-gerelateerde vraagstukken en klantintegriteit;

  • Je bent kritisch, nieuwsgierig en durft door te vragen;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en neemt eigenaarschap over je werkzaamheden;

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en werkt prettig samen met verschillende stakeholders.

Pré

  • Ervaring met SQL;

  • Ervaring met Power Query en/of Power Pivot;

  • Ervaring met KYC/CDD/Wwft;

  • Affiniteit met de zorgsector;

  • Ervaring met fraude- of declaratieanalyses.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur;

  • Een salaris tussen €4.000,- en €5.200,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van ervaring;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,25 per km) of een NS Business Card met volledige OV-vergoeding;

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage werknemersbijdrage;

  • Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, met de mogelijkheid om feestdagen flexibel in te zetten;

  • Diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals korting op sportabonnementen via Bedrijfsfitness NL, een fietsleaseplan en mantelzorgverlof;

  • De kans om onder werktijd vrijwilligerswerk te doen voor een goed doel;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving, een gezellig team en een dagelijkse verzorgde lunch.

Wie zijn wij?

Het verschil maken in de zorg, daar gaan we voor. Door slimme processen, technologie en data zorgen we ervoor dat zorgverleners meer tijd overhouden voor waar het écht om draait: goede zorg voor hun patiënten.

De Operational Risk & Data Analist maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Legal & Risk. Je voert met name werkzaamheden uit voor Infomedics, onderdeel van de MSPS Groep. Binnen Infomedics ondersteun je voornamelijk de factoring- en declaratiedienstverlening voor zorgverleners. Tegelijkertijd werk je regelmatig samen met collega's en stakeholders van andere onderdelen binnen de groep, zoals Clearing House Apothekers (CHA) en Vertimart Consultants.

MSPS Groep is een financieel gezonde en ambitieuze organisatie die volop investeert in innovatie, data en softwareontwikkeling. We stimuleren eigenaarschap, initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Daardoor krijg je veel ruimte om mee te denken over verbeteringen en daadwerkelijk impact te maken op de manier waarop risico's binnen de organisatie worden beheerst.


De sollicitatieprocedure

Het eerste gesprek is met de leidinggevende en/of directe collega van de afdeling, zie het als een kennismaking. Wie is MSPS Groep, wie ben jij, wat neem je mee aan ervaring en naar wat voor baan ben je op zoek? Daarna volgt een tweede ronde met een verdiepend gesprek. Mogelijk nodigen we je ook uit om een dagdeel mee te lopen zodat na afloop voor iedereen duidelijk is wat we van elkaar verwachten.

Daarnaast is het belangrijk om te weten dat het verkrijgen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) nodig is om de functie te kunnen vervullen.

Interesse?

Ben je enthousiast geworden en geïnteresseerd in deze baan? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog met jouw cv en motivatie.

Wil je eerst meer weten of heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met recruiter Chenara Vischer via .

About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

At HIVED, as an Operations Coordinator, you are the unique point of contact with drivers. Your role is integral to ensuring HIVED maintains drivers at the centre of our operation while maintaining high delivery performance and quality. This is an on-site role embedded in day-to-day operations. Your shift pattern will be 4 days on, 3 days off, which will require you to work one day on the weekend. Our Operations team is organised into roles at different levels: this is a level 2 role where you will report into the Operations Manager.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of an assigned driver team.

  • Champion initiatives that foster a positive driver experience and promote retention.

  • Overseeing of all aspects of assigned driver team, serving as the primary point of contact for driver inquiries and support at HIVED.

  • Ensure driver compliance with HIVED's requirements and expectations.

  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure driver excellence via check-ins and ride-alongs.

What you’ll be accountable for 🤝

  1. Achieving daily business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  2. Comprehensive driver support, including scheduling, process implementation, and addressing on-the-road queries.

What we’re looking for 🔎

We are seeking an engaging and approachable (Driver) Operations Coordinator who excels at building and maintaining positive relationships with drivers and stakeholders, with strong verbal and written communication skills and demonstrated stakeholder management abilities.

  • 1-3 years of related working experience with logistics/last-mile preference.

  • Possesses a hands-on approach to managing and developing team members.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

  • Capable of rapid decision-making and efficient problem resolution.

  • Ability to leverage available resources effectively and efficiently.

  • Experience leveraging data for effective decision-making.

  • Demonstrates exceptional resilience and professionalism when confronted with difficult situations, maintaining a positive and productive attitude.

  • Valid UK driving license required.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required.

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

  • Cycle to work scheme

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started.

  • 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

title: Payload Systems Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:

- MS/PhD in Engineering (Mechatronics, Microtechnology, Photonics, Electronics, Optoelectronics, Optomechanics, Automation, etc.)

- Experience in or interest for the following areas: - Satcom and payload architectures - Lasers and optomechanics - Mechatronics, HW, SW - Python - Test activities in cleanroom - Instrumentation and automation - Low-noise and low-vibration environments

- Swiss or EU (27) citizenship

title: People & Culture Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken.

  • Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt.

  • Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein.

  • Lieferanten & Muster: Du fragst Rohstoffe, Muster und Angebote bei Herstellern und Co-Packern an, vergleichst sie und behältst den Überblick über laufende Anfragen.

  • Produktdaten & Kennzeichnung: Du unterstützt beim Erstellen von Spezifikationen, Zutatenlisten und Etikettentexten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Qualitätsmanagement und Grafik zusammen.

  • Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzutaten und Vergleichsprodukte und sorgst dafür, dass bei Verkostungen alles bereitsteht.

  • Dokumentation: Du hältst Ergebnisse sauber fest und machst Fortschritte für das Team nachvollziehbar.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und musst im Rahmen deines Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 6 Monaten absolvieren.

  • Idealerweise studierst du Ökotrophologie, Ernährungswissenschaften, Ernährungsökonomie, Food Management oder etwas Vergleichbares.

  • Du brennst für Food, neue Produkte und Trends und probierst gern Neues aus.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und ein Auge fürs Detail.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst gern selbst mit an.

  • Du bist kommunikativ und trittst gegenüber externen Partnern professionell auf.

  • Du sprichst gut Deutsch und Englisch (unsere Partner sitzen teils im Ausland).

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit MS Office, vor allem Excel.

  • Führerschein Klasse B.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Praxis, die zählt: Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Du arbeitest an Produktentwicklungen, die wirklich in den Verkauf gehen, nicht an Übungsszenarien.

  • Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: An drei Tagen pro Woche kocht unsere Köchin frisch für das Team-Lunch, weil gutes Essen dazugehört.

  • Team & Kultur: Ein offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Team, regelmäßige Teamevents und viel Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Work-Life-Balance: 24 Urlaubstage und ein strukturiertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld.

title: Pharmacy Dispenser
descriptionHtml:
At Montu, every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

Our pharmacy is a fast-paced, high-volume environment where accuracy, attention to detail and teamwork are essential. You will be joining a dedicated team working together to ensure prescriptions are processed safely, accurately and efficiently, helping patients access their medication without unnecessary delays.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working at pace, takes real pride in getting the detail right and understands the importance of putting patients at the heart of every decision. No two days are the same, and you will need to be adaptable, calm under pressure and ready to play your part in a growing pharmacy that is helping to improve access to cannabis-based medicines across the UK.

Working alongside our Pharmacists, Pharmacy Technicians and wider pharmacy team, you will support the safe and effective dispensing of CBPMs within our specialist private pharmacy.

What is the job?

In our pharmacy, every day is about combining pace with precision, always keeping patients at the heart of everything we do. We work in a fast-moving, agile environment where accuracy is paramount, flexibility is essential, and no two days are the same. You will be part of a dedicated team that thrives under pressure, adapts quickly, and takes pride in making a genuine difference to patients’ lives

Working as a Pharmacy dispenser supporting the supply of CMBP in a specialist Private pharmacy. This is a niche role in a growing area. The successful candidate will be working alongside specialist Clinical Pharmacists to make CMBP more accessible for all patients.

What will you be doing?

  • Receiving and validating prescriptions ready for a clinical check.

  • Processing patient information appropriately.

  • Supporting the Responsible Pharmacist & Technicians in the daily operations of the Pharmacist.

  • Being the first point of contact for any queries to the Pharmacy.

  • Maintaining relevant records for the supply of CMBP.

  • Maintaining stock and security of any CMBP on site.

  • Maintaining communication of prescription to the Department of Health to meet Regulatory Requirements.

  • Supporting governance in the Pharmacy to ensure the pharmacy is operating as safely as possible.

What do you need?

  • A UK qualified Pharmacy dispenser

  • Ideally Undertaken CPD-accredited medical cannabis educational programme. Through this will be provided for the successful candidate

  • Self-motivated individual with high levels of attention to detail, able to work accurately, identifying errors quickly and easily

  • Experience in working in the pharmacy dispensary either primary and/or secondary environment

  • Has attention to detail, patience and the ability to remain calm during stressful situations

  • Excellence in communication skills with staff, patients and other healthcare professionals.

  • Professional, ethical and committed to providing excellent customer care

  • Excellent computer literacy with good working knowledge of office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £29.5K

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to improve the infrastructure, developer tooling, and delivery workflows used by more than 100 engineers.

The role combines infrastructure and software development, with an approximate 65/35 split. You’ll work on cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, and internal tooling. The goal is to make development and releases more reliable, efficient, and straightforward.

What you’ll do

  • Improve developer experience and engineering productivity by building tools and workflows that make it easier for engineers to develop, test, and ship software.

  • Maintain infrastructure automation with Ansible, Terraform, and Terragrunt.

  • Improve the reliability and performance of our CI/CD workflows.

  • Find the causes of slow builds, failed pipelines, and flaky tests.

  • Develop internal tools, improve test infrastructure, and occasionally work on product features.

  • Improve observability across our infrastructure and delivery workflows using OpenTelemetry, ELK.

  • Leverage AI to improve engineering workflows by building cloud-based agent tools and helping teams adopt effective practices.

Our tech stack

AWS, Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, ELK, ClickHouse, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Ruby-on-Rails.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience developing and maintaining complex CI/CD workflows.

  • Software development experience, such as building internal tools, APIs, backend services, or automation.

  • Experience with AWS or another cloud provider.

  • Telemetry and monitoring experience (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana).

  • Strong Computer Science and System Design fundamentals.

  • Willingness to learn and use Ruby and/or Go.

What we’d be particularly excited about

  • Experience optimizing CI build times, especially with Jenkins.

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Ruby, Python, or JavaScript.

  • Familiarity with build systems such as Webpack or Gradle.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack. We value strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to work on different types of engineering problems.

title: Principal Penetration Tester
descriptionHtml:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

Our Professional Services Team is seeking Associate Principal OT Penetration Tester who will provide technical leadership across vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and adversary emulation activities supporting customer services engagements. You will shape engagement strategy and uncover real‑world attack paths across ICS/OT networks through hands‑on exploitation and deep technical analysis, working closely with customers across critical infrastructure sectors such as oil and gas, electric, water treatment, and manufacturing. You will also translate findings into clear, actionable remediation guidance, influencing detection and platform development. You will mentor team members and be an advisor and representative of Dragos within the broader OT security community.

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as primary technical lead and trusted advisor for Dragos’s most complex, high-impact industrial penetration testing, purple teaming, and vulnerability assessment engagements, shaping engagement direction and aligning deep technical execution with client business goals.
  • Set the technical bar for OT penetration testing excellence by defining methodologies, assessment frameworks, and red team tactics informed by threat intelligence and adversary emulation. Design and lead offensive campaigns modeled on known and unknown TTPs to uncover complex attack paths across IT/OT boundaries and within industrial environments.
  • Translate hands-on findings into strategic R&D priorities, guiding the development of proprietary tools, behavioral analytics, and detection content by identifying gaps in visibility, response, and prevention in customer environments.
  • Evolve internal playbooks, runbooks, and operating procedures, applying field lessons, threat intelligence, and emerging adversary behaviors to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of the penetration testing practice.
  • Engage executive stakeholders, internally and externally, with strategic cybersecurity guidance, risk prioritization, and remediation recommendations tied to business objectives, delivering clear, authoritative presentations to C-suites, boards, and technical leadership.
  • Represent Dragos as an industry thought leader through original research, top-tier conference presentations, whitepapers, and public engagements that advance OT security with unique insights and innovation.
  • Mentor engineering, threat intelligence, and consulting teams across functions, cultivating future leaders and a culture of continuous learning, technical curiosity, and mission-driven execution.

Qualifications: 

  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or red teaming within the OT space, with in-depth knowledge of OT penetration testing methodologies in white, gray, and black-box contexts.
  • Deep understanding of OT-specific architectures and services, including DCS, historians, SCADA networks, transmission/distribution management, AMI, related communication protocols, and other control systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of OT cyber threats, attack paths, exploits, and adversary TTPs.
  • Hands-on experience with offensive security tooling such as Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, Cobalt Strike, Burp Suite, common LOTL toolsets, and C2 frameworks.
  • Advanced experience with networking components (routers, switches, load balancers, firewalls), plus the ability to analyze network traffic and host data in a cybersecurity context.
  • Proven experience using large language models (e.g., Claude) to support penetration testing execution and reporting, including reconnaissance, exploit development, and drafting findings, with sound judgment in validating AI-generated output and securely handling client data.
  • Strong report-writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate across distributed teams, with willingness to travel up to 30-40% (domestic and international) to support customer engagements.

Compensation: 

  • Salary: £105,000
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

title: Principal Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Principal Product Designer Avast
Location: London, Hybrid (3 days in office)
Portfolio: Please ensure your CV includes a link to your portfolio and a password.

About Gen:

We're not just a company; we're a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands, Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner, unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we've built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you're unstoppable. So, bring us your bold ideas and passion that refuses to quit. The digital world isn't some distant reality, it's the world we live in, and we're ready for it. If you're ready to push boundaries and be part of something bigger, join #TeamGen.

How We Work:

Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work.

About the Role

Help shape the future of Avast’s digital protection experience freemium experience. As a Principal Product Designer at Gen, you’ll design how people discover Avast, get value from our free products and choose to upgrade to paid protection—creating experiences that earn their trust and keep them coming back.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end product design role, combining strong UX thinking with excellent visual and UI craft. You’ll take work from discovery and research through to polished, shipped experiences across mobile, desktop and web, with a clear focus on acquisition, conversion and retention.

We’re looking for someone who has designed and shipped mobile-first consumer products at scale, with a portfolio showing what you personally owned, the decisions you made and the impact your work delivered.

You’ll also help shape AI-powered experiences that make digital protection simpler, more useful and more personal. Working closely with product, research and engineering, you’ll influence design direction while staying close to the detail of the work.

About the Team:

Gen's Global Product Design team is a diverse, distributed group working across London, Prague, Dublin and the US. The global team designs across cybersecurity, identity protection, privacy and financial wellness, with a strong focus on AI-enabled experiences and reimagining key user journeys. This role sits within the cyber safety pillar, working primarily on Avast and its freemium ecosystem, while staying closely connected to the wider design community across Gen's brands.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Shape strategy through design: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into elegant, usable solutions grounded in user needs and business goals

  • Design intelligent experiences: bring clarity and usability to AI-powered products by designing interactions that feel natural, transparent and trustworthy

  • Turn insights into impact: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into simple, usable and delightful solutions grounded in user needs and data

  • Prototype and test with AI: explore new possibilities through discovery, rapid prototyping and user testing, especially around how AI can simplify tasks or personalise experiences

  • Collaborate and influence: partner across disciplines to align design outcomes with user needs, business goals and AI capabilities

  • Champion design quality: ensure every touchpoint, whether powered by AI or not, is cohesive, accessible and human-centred

About You:

Education: degree in Design, HCI or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Experience:

  • A track record of designing and shipping mobile-first B2C products at scale, ideally in industries like security, fintech, health or adjacent spaces

  • Comfortable operating across time zones and cultures; experience with distributed teams is a plus

  • Experience designing for or alongside AI-driven features such as personalisation, recommendations or automation is a strong plus

  • Experience in cybersecurity or financial services is helpful, but curiosity and adaptability matter more

Skills:

  • Strategic mindset with a keen sense of how design drives user value and business growth

  • Mastery of end-to-end product design: UX research, interaction, visual design and systems thinking

  • Deep user empathy and a belief in data-informed design decisions

Personal Attributes:

  • Curious, adaptable and motivated by solving complex problems for real people at scale

  • A clear, compelling portfolio that demonstrates your design process and product impact

Compensation

The annual base salary for this position is expected to be in the range of base salary

GBP 80,000 - 100,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes annual bonus and new hire RSU's. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role.

Benefits:

At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees' well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes:

  • Health & Wellbeing: company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

  • Financial Security: a Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

  • Tuition Reimbursement: up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen

Your CV and portfolio will be reviewed by the recruiter and hiring manager to understand the scope of your work, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the role.

 

If your experience aligns with what we're looking for, our recruiter will be in touch to arrange a conversation about your background, what motivates you, your interest in Gen and our products, and what to expect from the interview process.

 

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

This role sits within the Production team at our NPI facility in Reading, Berkshire, reporting to the Senior Production Engineer.

As Production Assembly & Test Engineer, you will carry out hands-on assembly of XYZ's AR devices combined with in-process and final test and calibration. The role spans build and verification — assembling to SOP standards, then carrying out the calibration and test that releases product to customers.

You'll also contribute to documentation, quality processes and goods-in inspection, playing a key part in ensuring every Atom device that leaves our facility meets XYZ's exacting standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Assemble the full range of XYZ AR devices to SOP and specification, including robot calibration and configuration processes that set the accuracy of our AR devices.

• Perform in-process and final test to defined acceptance criteria, releasing product under the QMS; maintain calibration records and support the calibration register for production test equipment.

• Record test and calibration results accurately against serial numbers; support software and firmware installation and verification during assembly and test.

• Identify, record and escalate non-conforming product through the NCR process; support fault-finding, repair and rework on returned and failed units.

• Create and maintain SOPs and work instructions for assembly, test and calibration processes under the QMS, keeping documentation current as processes and engineering changes are made.

• Support goods-in inspection to acceptance criteria alongside the Logistics and Warehousing Coordinator.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

• Hands-on assembly experience on complex electro-mechanical products.

• Test, calibration and measurement experience — ideally including automated or robotic calibration equipment.

• Ability to write, follow and improve test procedures, SOPs and acceptance criteria.

• Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Fault-finding and debugging skills across both electronics and mechanical assemblies.

• Comfortable with command-line tools and with software and firmware installation.

• Understanding of calibration control and traceability requirements.

• Accurate record-keeping and genuine attention to detail — a high-quality output matters to you personally.

• Good IT skills including MS Office.

• Comfortable working to QMS standards in a structured, process-driven production environment.

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

💰 Employee referral scheme

🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. title: Consultant Finance and Digitalization (w/m/d) - Fintech SaaS Scale-Up
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: Consultant Pain Management PAYE
descriptionHtml:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

 

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

 

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

 

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

 

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

 

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

 

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.
