title: Remote Head of UX (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As the Head of UX at RoomPriceGenie, you'll lead our small but mighty design and research team of two product designers and one user researcher.

This isn't an IC role where you'll be pushing pixels or running sessions yourself. It's a leadership role focused on building the function, championing the team, and setting them up for success.

You'll set the strategic direction for how design and research operates, advocate for the team at leadership level, and create the conditions for your people to do their best work. You'll also play a key role in raising design and research maturity across the wider product organisation — guiding better decisions through clearer systems, guidelines, and shared insight.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Representation & Advocacy

  • Champion design and research as a strategic partner that shapes the roadmap.

  • Partner with Product Leadership to translate strategic business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap for Design & Research.

Strategic Direction & Vision

  • Set a clear vision for the design and research function — defining what success looks like, where it's heading, and how it contributes to the company's overall strategy.

  • Raise design and research maturity by providing constructive critique and quality oversight to support high-quality product outcomes.

  • Create the space for the team to work on foundational initiatives that scale team impact. For example: evolving the component library into a robust design system and establishing clear design and content playbooks to drive consistency, efficiency, and quality.

AI Operations & Enablement

  • Set the strategic direction for how AI fits into the design & research workflow — where it accelerates, where craft stays human, and set clear guardrails for how the wider org uses it.

  • Foster a culture where the team integrates AI into product work — evolving their craft and building fluency through practice.

  • Ensure designers and researchers play a key role in shaping product and AI direction, grounding decisions in user insight and design perspective.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Advocate for Design Thinking to be embedded throughout the product life cycle, shaping ideas and guiding decisions.

  • Proactively identify large, strategic UX opportunities that span across the product.

  • Navigate competing priorities between leadership direction and team capacity, ensuring the team stays focused on high-impact work.

Team Development & Coaching

  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and constructive feedback through regular one-to-ones — focused on the development and growth of your team.

  • Build clear career frameworks and progression paths for Design and Research.

  • Encourage continuous learning, adaptability, and development within the team.

Your Profile

  • A genuine understanding of both design and research disciplines, even if your background leans more toward one. You don't need to be an expert in both, but you need to value and support both equally.

  • Proven experience in a senior design leadership role is required — you've owned a function, led teams of designers and researchers, and have a track record of influencing product direction at the leadership level.

  • A track record of advocating for both disciplines at the leadership level and influencing product strategy, not just delivering on it.

  • Experience building or maturing a design function: establishing processes, systems, playbooks, or ways of working from the ground up.

  • Curiosity about AI and how it's changing the way design and research teams work — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be excited about figuring this out with the team.

Your Soft Skills

  • A compassionate, proactive leadership style that creates emotional safety for the people around you.

  • Confident navigating difficult stakeholder dynamics without losing your composure or your team's trust.

  • Strong communicator who can translate design value into language that resonates with leadership, product, and engineering.

  • Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback — you see it as a gift.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in or familiarity with the hotel or travel industry.

  • Familiarity with building or scaling teams.

  • Experience building and maintaining a design system.

  • Experience working in scale-ups or startups — you're comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in environments that are still finding their shape.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

title: Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Our Client

Our client is a global IT consulting and digital engineering company specializing in software development, cloud transformation, data and AI, and digital experience solutions.

With an international presence and extensive engineering capabilities, the company supports enterprise clients across multiple industries in designing, developing, and implementing technology-driven business solutions.

Our client is expanding its Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) practice in the DACH region and is looking for a consultant with deep e-commerce knowledge, technical understanding, and client-facing advisory experience.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce, you will help grow our client's Retail & CPG business by translating business challenges into technology solutions and consulting engagements.

This is a hands-on functional consulting role with a strong technical and pre-sales component. You will work closely with senior client stakeholders, sales teams, and technical specialists to shape digital commerce solutions, lead discovery workshops, and support new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate understands how different e-commerce platforms and customer-facing technologies work together, can advise clients on the right solutions, and is comfortable collaborating with commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise Retail & CPG clients on e-commerce, digital customer experience, personalization, customer data and technology transformation.
  • Translate business requirements into solution concepts, capability roadmaps and target architectures.
  • Lead discovery sessions and solution design workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
  • Advise on the integration of commerce platforms, CDPs, marketing technologies, PIM, OMS and other digital commerce systems.
  • Collaborate with sales and pre-sales teams to identify client opportunities, develop proposals and shape consulting engagements.
  • Stay informed about DACH retail trends, marketplace dynamics, emerging technologies and changing customer expectations.
  • Develop reusable consulting assets, including reference architectures, solution frameworks, demonstrations and go-to-market offerings.
  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CDOs, CMOs, CIOs, and Heads of E-commerce.
  • Collaborate with regional and global technology teams to support the growth of the Retail & CPG practice.
  • Represent the company at client meetings, industry conferences, and relevant networking events.

Key Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the broader digital commerce ecosystem and how its different technologies connect.

Relevant areas include:

  • E-commerce platforms: commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, headless and composable commerce.
  • Customer data and CDPs: Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Segment, mParticle, Tealium, Bloomreach, first-party data and consent management.
  • Marketing technology and personalization: Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, Emarsys, Dynamic Yield, Algolia, Optimizely and customer journey optimization.
  • Commerce architecture and integrations: OMS, PIM, DAM, APIs, system integrations, distributed order management and omnichannel fulfillment.
  • Marketplaces and retail media: Amazon, Zalando, Otto, Kaufland, retail media networks, marketplace integrations and D2C business models.
  • Emerging commerce technologies: AI-assisted shopping, conversational commerce, GenAI applications, loyalty solutions and digital customer engagement.

Expertise across every platform is not required. What matters most is understanding how these technologies work together and recommending solutions that match clients' business needs.

Your Profile

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or digital commerce, ideally within Retail & CPG.
  • Background in IT consulting, digital transformation, systems integration, technology services, or digital commerce consulting.
  • Technical-functional understanding of e-commerce platforms, system integrations, data flows, and digital customer-facing solutions.
  • Experience working directly with clients, gathering requirements, leading workshops, and developing solution recommendations.
  • Familiarity with pre-sales processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with sales teams.
  • Understanding of the DACH retail and CPG market, including major retailers, marketplace dynamics, digital commerce trends, and GDPR requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex technology concepts to both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in German and English.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% across the region.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience within an IT service provider or digital engineering consultancy.
  • Experience in technical pre-sales, proposal development, RFPs, or solution shaping.
  • Existing relationships within the DACH Retail & CPG ecosystem.
  • Experience developing consulting offerings, reference architectures, or reusable technology accelerators.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, data analytics, AI, and custom application development.
  • Knowledge of retail media, marketplace integrations, pricing and promotion technologies, or loyalty solutions.

What Our Client Offers

  • A role combining technology consulting, digital commerce strategy and business development.
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to expanding a Retail & CPG consulting practice in DACH.
  • Collaboration with international engineering, architecture, and technology teams.
  • Exposure to enterprise retail and CPG clients and complex digital transformation projects.
  • Opportunities to shape new consulting offerings and contribute to business growth.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

You will join a high-performing sales team within the DACH sales organization, responsible for driving growth within large global enterprises from the Manufacturing industry. Manufacturing is one of our strategic industries, where we help global leaders optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.

The Role:

Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will create and cultivate strategic relationships to drive sales cycles from deep discovery to value realization. You will be responsible for a selected portfolio of strategic accounts from the Manufacturing industry headquartered in Switzerland, generating new business opportunities with existing customers. Navigating complex organizations up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and systematically drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.

The Work you'll do:

  • You will primarily work and manage existing customers, land-and-expand is the typical model
  • Engage cross line-of-business at C-level and below
  • Drive Celonis Process Intelligence & Enterprise AI sales motions across the entire core enterprise value chain, translating core challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases that deliver measurable execution capacity against strategic customer pain points.
  • Hold an individual revenue target for closing seven-figure deals within your accounts
  • Engage closely with partners e.g, consulting firms and SaaS vendors
  • Drive complex sales cycles through orchestrating virtual teams including business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services, implementation partners...

The Qualifications you need:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in either one - or ideally both - of the following domains:

○ SaaS Sales: Proven track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex, strategic business solutions to large enterprise accounts with full account ownership

○ AI / Management Consulting: Experience in a (boutique) consultancy, driving AI projects with direct responsibility for account management, client relationships, business development / client acquisition and carrying your own net new revenue quota

  • A proven track record of commitment, long tenure, and successful career progression with your previous companies
  • Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of core processes and KPIs throughout the entire enterprise value chain in the Manufacturing industry, particularly within the domains of Production, Supply Chain, and Finance
  • Solid understanding of the Manufacturing industry
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior Business and IT stakeholders and engage effectively at the C-level (CFO, COO, CIO, VP Operations, Manufacturing Director, etc.)
  • Grit, a hands-on mindset and strong discovery and sales process leadership
  • Fluency in German and English, with exceptional communication and presentation skills to engage and excite stakeholders effectively at all levels
  • Ability to adapt to a fast moving, ever changing, high growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking, and a growth mindset
  • Willingness to be collaborative, inclusive, to embrace diversity and to have strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter
  • Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins

  • Zurich area location preferred; candidates based elsewhere in Switzerland must be available for weekly in-person presence and customer visits (primarily in German-speaking Switzerland).
    #LI-SS6

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

title: VP Global Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

UFORCE is looking for a VP Global Supply Chain to build and lead a resilient, compliant supply-chain function across the US, UK and Europe. You’ll connect global sourcing strategy with the realities of production: qualified suppliers, reliable material plans and the right parts arriving when they’re needed.

This is a strategic leadership role with hands-on ownership. You’ll set global sourcing direction, build the team and establish shared standards across sites. You’ll also work directly with engineering, production and suppliers to resolve shortages and keep programmes moving.

A key part of the role is establishing the US supply chain and connecting it to global planning. Your work will make supply risks visible earlier, strengthen supplier performance and help UFORCE scale without every site having to solve the same problems alone.

What you’ll do

  • Build category and supplier strategies that balance cost, quality, lead time and resilience across countries and programmes.

  • Establish the US supply chain: qualify suppliers, put sourcing and logistics arrangements in place, and build material plans aligned with programme and production milestones.

  • Create a cross-site view of material readiness, critical shortages and recovery plans, with clear owners and timely escalation.

  • Identify single-source, long-lead and capacity constraints, and put dual-sourcing, buffer-stock or supplier-development plans in place where needed.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, introduce supplier scorecards and hold partners accountable for delivery, quality and corrective actions.

  • Establish consistent supplier qualification, traceability and counterfeit-part avoidance controls, working with Quality, Legal and Export Compliance on applicable requirements and specialist decisions.

  • Connect demand, bills of materials, supplier lead times and production schedules through a practical sales and operations planning rhythm, supported by shared enterprise resource planning standards and reliable data.

  • Define the global team structure, hire and develop people, and establish clear responsibilities and ways of working with site supply-chain leads.

  • Use agreed baselines and targets to improve supplier delivery, material availability, lead times, inventory performance and landed cost.

Required Skills

  • Experience leading sourcing and supply-chain activity across multiple countries or manufacturing sites, with measurable delivery, cost or resilience improvements.

  • A strong understanding of complex hardware manufacturing and the connection between engineering changes, material availability and build schedules.

  • A track record of identifying supplier risk and implementing practical mitigations that protected production.

  • Experience translating demand and production priorities into credible material plans, including sales and operations planning or an equivalent cross-functional process.

  • Strong commercial judgement and negotiation skills, with the ability to resolve supplier quality, delivery or capacity issues while maintaining long-term relationships.

  • Experience building or significantly improving a supply-chain function in a growing organisation, rather than only operating an established system.

  • Experience building, developing and leading teams across locations, setting shared standards and delivering through site stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of supplier assurance, traceability and applicable export controls, including UK and EU military and dual-use requirements and ITAR/EAR awareness. You know how to implement supplier-side controls and when to seek specialist advice.

  • A hands-on approach, clear prioritisation and the judgement to act quickly when production is at risk.

  • Willingness to travel regularly across the US, UK and Europe.

  • Eligible for Security Clearance

Nice to have

  • Defence, aerospace, maritime, automotive, robotics or other complex hardware supply-chain experience.

  • Experience establishing a US supplier base or supply-chain operation and integrating it with UK or European operations.

  • Experience with Ukrainian or Eastern European suppliers and cross-border logistics.

  • Experience implementing or harmonising enterprise resource planning systems across sites.

  • CIPS, APICS/ASCM or an equivalent professional qualification.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

 

  • Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models.

  • Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models.

  • Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

 

  • Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

 

#LI-Remote

title: Research Engineer, Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners.

  • Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment.

The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

 

About the role
As a Research Engineer (ML), you will push the scale and efficiency of model training at Boltz, and work with researchers to decide where systems work will have the most research impact. You will be an active member of one of our ML research teams, bringing deep systems and scaling expertise to its models and experiments.
This role is ideal for an engineer with deep ML systems expertise who wants to work close to the research and help shape its direction.

What you’ll do

  • Identify the systems work with the highest research impact for your team, and own it end to end.

  • Scale model training: distributed and parallel training, larger models, and the problems that appear at scale.

  • Profile and optimize across the training stack, from data loading to kernels, communication and the cluster.

  • Build research tooling for our cluster, working with Infrastructure & Platform.

  • Make what you build reusable across teams, and use what you learn to inform model and experiment design.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training large deep learning models on multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Knowledge of the ML training stack end to end from the systems perspective, from data loading and model code through the framework, kernels, communication and the cluster, with depth in at least one layer.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, with a high bar for engineering quality.

  • Experience working closely with ML researchers on model and training code.

  • A track record of identifying and driving high-impact technical work independently.

Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of parallelization strategies for large models, including techniques popularized by LLM training such as FSDP or ZeRO, tensor parallelism and sequence parallelism.

  • Low-level GPU performance work, such as custom kernels (e.g. CUDA or Triton).

  • Experience building tools that others use to run work on a shared GPU cluster.

  • Exposure to structure prediction or molecular modeling, or experience using Boltz models.

 

What we offer

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

 

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Diagnosis interview: work through a degraded training run with us (no manual coding test)

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

 

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
descriptionHtml:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.
Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.

Pourquoi ce recrutement ?
Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas.
Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence.

Missions

Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes.

1. Enquêter

  • Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs.

  • Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A .

2. Dévoiler

  • Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an.

  • Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites.

  • Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média.

  • Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain :

  • Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat.

  • Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l'onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes.

3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel

  • Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier.

  • Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne.

  • Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances.

  • Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires, toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes.

  • Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen, Commission européenne, Représentation permanente de la France, Assemblée nationale, Sénat, ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés.

  • Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp.

  • Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG.

  • Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ».

Compétences recherchées

Indispensable

  • Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction.

  • Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer.

  • Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre.

  • Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets.

  • Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll.

  • De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits.

  • Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués…

Un vrai plus

  • Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances.

  • Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles).

  • Une expérience d'animation de coalitions.

Profil recherché

Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine.

  • Tu vas chercher toi-même.
    Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources.

  • Tu arrives avec un dossier.
    Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui.

  • Tu es crédible partout.
    Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram.

  • Tu tiens la distance.
    Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite.

  • Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment).
    Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part.

  • Tu es owner.
    Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou.

  • Tu veux un impact réel.
    Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler.

Le package

Lieu : Paris, avec des déplacements réguliers.

Contrat : CDI, statut cadre

Arrivée : ASAP

  • BSPCEs (equity)

  • RTTs

  • Mutuelle santé Alan

  • Déplacements à Bruxelles pris en charge

  • Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (Freelance / Contract) 100% Remote (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst (Freelance / Contract) to support the improvement of how we use data across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and billing.

The assignment focuses on understanding how our revenue processes perform, identifying the reasons behind changing results, and turning data into actionable insights. You will analyse performance, define meaningful metrics, combine data from different systems, investigate patterns, and validate assumptions.

Your work should contribute to measurable improvements. This may include supporting better business decisions, improving existing processes, or introducing automations that reduce manual effort and increase reliability.

Reporting and dashboards are part of the assignment, but they are not the end goal. Each analysis should address a relevant business question and provide a clear foundation for decision-making.

You will support the implementation of selected solutions, including data models, dashboards, automations, and process improvements. The primary focus remains on analysis and generating insights, with implementation following where the expected impact and measurement approach are clearly defined.

Relevant professional experience is preferred but not mandatory. We value strong analytical judgement, accuracy, technical understanding, independence, and the ability to quickly learn and deliver high-quality results.

Tasks

  • Analyse the customer journey across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue performance.
  • Define, refine, and maintain consistent metrics across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and finance.
  • Extract, combine, clean, and validate data from operational and analytical systems.
  • Investigate changes in customer behaviour, funnels, conversion rates, retention, costs, and revenue trends.
  • Identify the likely drivers behind performance changes rather than only describing outcomes.
  • Review existing reports and identify unreliable metrics, data gaps, and inconsistent definitions.
  • Develop hypotheses and validate them using available data and analytical methods.
  • Separate evidence-based insights from assumptions, correlations, and opinions.
  • Estimate the potential impact of proposed improvements and define suitable success metrics.
  • Prioritise opportunities based on expected impact, effort, and confidence in the underlying data.
  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear format that supports business decisions.
  • Support the development of selected dashboards, data models, automations, and process improvements.
  • Evaluate implemented changes and measure whether they achieved the expected impact.
  • Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate for research, data exploration, coding support, and documentation.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs against underlying data and original sources.
  • Document metric definitions, data logic, assumptions, analytical methods, and limitations.

Requirements

  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving complex problems.
  • A high standard for data quality and a focus on producing reliable results.General programming knowledge and the motivation to continuously develop technical skills.
  • Initial experience with tools and technologies such as SQL, Python, JavaScript, APIs, spreadsheets, data warehouses, or business intelligence platforms is beneficial.
  • A basic understanding of statistics, including the distinction between correlation and causation.The ability to analyse problems from multiple perspectives before drawing conclusions.
  • An interest in using AI-assisted tools as part of analytical and technical workflows.
  • The ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated results.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex findings in a clear and understandable way.
  • The curiosity and motivation to learn new tools, systems, and business areas.
  • The discipline to follow an analysis through to a sufficiently reliable and actionable conclusion.

Benefits

What We Offer:

Clear Responsibilities and Support:

You’ll always know what’s expected of you, and you’ll work in an environment where mistakes are seen as valuable opportunities to learn.

A Shared Commitment to Outstanding Results:

Our team is passionate about achieving excellence and values your contribution as an essential part of our success. Together, we accomplish great things.

Personal Growth and Ownership:

We encourage self-motivation and personal accountability, empowering you to deliver exceptional results.

Dynamic Feedback for Continuous Learning:

You’ll receive direct and timely feedback, enabling you to adapt quickly to change and continuously improve.

Open Communication and Professional Development:

We foster open communication and actively support your personal and professional growth.

A Results-Driven Mindset Focused on Company Success:

Our goal is to achieve results that move the company forward. Your commitment to our shared success is highly valued.

Team Days, Summer Parties, and Christmas Celebrations: Regular events that strengthen team spirit and make work more enjoyable.

Corporate Benefits: Enjoy a range of employee discounts and perks.

Dog-Friendly Workplace: Bring your four-legged friend to work.

Bike Leasing: Take advantage of our bike leasing program for a greener and healthier commute.

You will not be assigned a fixed list of reports to create. Instead, you are expected to question unclear results, challenge weak definitions, and develop your own perspective based on the available data.

Important business questions should be followed from the initial analysis through to a verified conclusion. Where improvements are identified, you will support their implementation and help measure their impact.

The assignment requires initiative, persistence, and ownership of outcomes. It does not require permanent availability. Work is evaluated based on quality, reliability, and business impact rather than time spent online.

You will receive support while independently managing your assigned areas of analysis. You will have the opportunity to improve existing methods, develop better approaches, and contribute your own ideas.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Selection decisions are based on skills, potential, and suitability for the assignment.

title: Robotics Software Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Prefiro

Spargel hat diese Saison bis zu 25 Euro pro Kilo gekostet! Das liegt daran, dass er wie ein Großteil des Gemüseregals ausschließlich in Handarbeit geerntet wird. Wir von Prefiro sind die Ersten, die diese Prozesse automatisieren! Seit unserer Gründung 2024 nutzen wir Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Computer Vision und Robotik, um die Anbaugeräte der nächsten Generation aufs Feld zu bringen.

Dich begeistert es, neue Technologien unter realen Bedingungen einzusetzen, interessante und abwechslungsreiche Probleme zu lösen und direkt zu sehen, welchen Einfluss deine Ideen haben?

Dann werde Teil unseres achtköpfigen Teams und lass uns gemeinsam echte Probleme lösen.

Aufgaben

In der Rolle wirst du ...

  • unsere Denso-Roboterarme programmieren und in Betrieb nehmen: Bewegungsabläufe, Ansteuerung und Fehlerbehandlung.

  • Roboter und Peripherie (IO, Sensorik, Greifer) in unseren ROS-2-Robotik-Stack integrieren, vom Hochfahren bis zum Servicebetrieb.

  • MPC-basierte Trajektorienplanung und Optimalsteuerung mitentwickeln, vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung in Echtzeit auf dem Roboter.

  • Taktzeiten im realen Einsatz analysieren und reduzieren.

  • den Stack von einem Robotermodul auf mehrere pro Maschine skalieren. Dazu gehören Vernetzung, Robotersetup und Kalibrierung.

  • die Roboterrechner für die Echtzeitsteuerung optimieren: Docker, CPU-Pinning, ROS-2-Scheduling und Multithreading.

  • Fernzugriff, Datenerfassung und Robotik-CI/CD (z.B. Tests mit rosbag-Playback) aufbauen, damit wir die Roboter mit echten Felddaten laufend verbessern können.

  • Code reviewen, Architekturentscheidungen mitgestalten und den Stack gemeinsam im Team debuggen.

  • die Roboter bei Feldtests vor der Saison und während der Spargelernte direkt auf dem Feld betreuen.

Qualifikation

Du passt perfekt, wenn du ...

  • ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Robotik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fach hast.

  • mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Robotik mitbringst, und zwar an echten Robotern, nicht nur in der Simulation.

  • schon selbst echte Roboterarme programmiert, in Betrieb genommen und im realen Einsatz zum Laufen gebracht hast.

  • sicher in modernem C++ (C++17) und Python 3 programmierst.

  • praktische Erfahrung mit ROS 2 hast, idealerweise mit Jazzy: Nodes, Lifecycle Nodes, Executors, QoS und Launch-Files.

  • dich fundiert mit Roboterkinematik und -dynamik auskennst (z. B. URDF, Pinocchio oder Vergleichbares).

  • idealerweise schon Erfahrung mit Trajektorienplanung in Echtzeit hast, etwa mit Optimalsteuerung oder modellprädiktiver Regelung (MPC). Reinforcement Learning ist ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung mit Echtzeit-Robotersteuerung hast und weißt, worauf es bei Soft-Real-Time unter Linux ankommt (Scheduling, Latenzen, Threading).

  • sicher mit CMake/colcon und Git unter Linux umgehst.

  • fließend Englisch sprichst, denn Englisch ist unsere Arbeitssprache.

Nice to Have

Extra-Pluspunkte gibt es, wenn du ...

  • mit Industrierobotern gearbeitet hast, vor allem mit Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) oder Universal Robots.

  • Optimal-Control-Frameworks wie acados oder CasADi kennst oder schon mit Control Barrier Functions gearbeitet hast.

  • Erfahrung mit MoveIt 2 oder Ruckig für die Bewegungsplanung hast.

  • dich mit Docker, GitLab CI und automatisierten Tests (GoogleTest, launch_testing) auskennst.

  • schon DDS oder Zenoh getunt oder Multi-Roboter-Setups aufgebaut hast.

  • mit Debugging-Tools wie RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler oder Nsight Systems vertraut bist.

  • unter Linux sicher mit systemd, tmux und Shell-Skripten umgehst.

  • Grundkenntnisse in Deutsch hast.

Das bieten wir

  • Echte Felder ab deiner ersten Saison. Dein Code läuft auf unseren Maschinen, und zwar auf landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben in Deutschland.

  • Kurze Wege vom Code zum Roboter. Neue Ideen laufen meist schon nach wenigen Tagen auf der echten Maschine.

  • Ein Problem, das sich zu lösen lohnt. Grünspargel wird bis heute komplett von Hand geerntet.

  • Ein kleines, motiviertes Team, das gemeinsam viel bewegt. Wenn du dazukommst, sind wir 8 Leute in Vollzeit, dazu 2 Praktikant:innen und ein:e Werkstudent:in.

  • Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien. Wir stehen noch am Anfang, deshalb zählt deine Meinung bei technischen Entscheidungen.

  • Gemeinsame Mittagspausen und Kaffee in der Küche unserer Halle.

  • Mitarbeiterbeteiligung über Stock Options.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns über den Button „Jetzt bewerben“ deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einem Robotikprojekt, das du auf echter Hardware umgesetzt hast. Links zum Code sind herzlich willkommen. Verrat uns außerdem deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und welches Gemüse du als Nächstes automatisieren würdest.

title: Rollout Manager Europe (gn) – KI-Anwendungen
descriptionHtml:
Du weißt, wie Software in vielen Ländern wirklich ankommt? Dann bring jetzt KI in den Alltag einer europäischen Gruppe.

Arbeitsort: Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 10 bis maximal 15 Prozent.

​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.

Die beste KI-Anwendung bringt allerdings wenig, solange sie nur in der Zentrale funktioniert. Ob die Transformation gelingt, entscheidet sich im Alltag der Landesgesellschaften, und genau dort setzt diese Rolle an.

​

Deine Aufgaben

Du berichtest direkt an den CTO, arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem Produktteam und bringst die eigene KI-Anwendung in die Länder.

  • Du machst Länder und Standorte startklar, planst die Rollouts, behältst Risiken im Blick und bereitest die Go/No-Go-Entscheidung vor.

  • Du klärst lokale Besonderheiten und nötige Anpassungen mit dem Produktteam.

  • Du gewinnst lokale Führungskräfte für die Veränderung, misst die Nutzung und räumst Hürden aus dem Weg.

  • Du organisierst Trainings gemeinsam mit Trainer:innen und Key Usern vor Ort.

  • In der Hypercare bist du erste Anlaufstelle und übergibst stabile Nutzung an die Länder.

  • Mit jedem Release bringst du weitere Features und Agenten in die Fläche und verbesserst dabei das Vorgehen.

​

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst rund 3 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit und hast mehrere Software-Einführungen in verschiedenen Ländern oder an vielen Standorten selbst gesteuert, etwa ERP, CRM, HCM oder SaaS, ob im Unternehmen, beim Softwareanbieter oder beim Implementierungspartner.

  • Du kennst Change, Training und die Arbeit mit Key Usern aus der Praxis.

  • Du verbesserst Adoption anhand von Nutzungsdaten und Feedback.

  • Du verstehst operative Geschäftsprozesse und kannst Menschen für Neues begeistern.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

  • Von Vorteil: erste Praxis mit KI-Anwendungen oder Agenten, Erfahrung in einem Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten, eine Sprache aus Mittel- oder Osteuropa.

Zur Einordnung: Du steuerst Rollouts selbst und hands-on. Wenn du heute vor allem als Programmdirektor:in große Teams und Budgets führst, ist die Rolle vermutlich nicht der passende Zuschnitt.

​

Wir bieten

  • Dein Einstieg ins KI-Thema: Deine Rollout-Erfahrung ist das Entscheidende, KI lernst du hier in der Praxis.

  • Viel Gestaltungsraum: Du entwickelst das Vorgehen für die ganze Gruppe mit.

  • International, aber planbar: Du arbeitest mit vielen Ländern, ohne ständig unterwegs zu sein.

  • Sichtbarkeit: direkter Draht zum CTO und zu den Führungskräften in den Ländern.

  • Eine Perspektive in Richtung Programmleitung.

  • Ein attraktives Paket aus Fixgehalt und variablem Anteil.

​

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Bitte lade vorher deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

title: Sales Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:

Supporting the Head of Sales Operations and the GTM Engineer, you will work across a global, multi-market and two-tier sales organisation, partnering with Sales Leads, Customer Service and the Data team to turn messy inputs into decisions people can trust. From your first month you take real ownership of the processes that keep user management, bonus calculations and reporting accurate.

PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to awnings and garden furniture, direct to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue and operations across our core markets, and Sales Operations sits at the centre of how that growth is planned, measured and paid.

What You'll Do

- Onboard and offboard sales users across HubSpot, Aircall and our messaging tools (seats, permissions, teams and task queues), keep the set-up aligned to the org chart, and run a monthly seat and licence check.

- Run recurring CRM hygiene programmes (duplicates, missing or wrong fields, wrong owners, stale deals and tasks, inactive workflows), track data quality per market, and follow up with Sales Leads where logging standards slip.

What You'll Bring

- Enrolled or recently graduated with Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, information systems, data or a related field.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (lookups, pivots, clean formulas) and an eye for numbers that do not add up.

- Structured and reliable: you finish recurring tasks on time, every time, and document what you do.

- Fluent English.

- Nice to have: first experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), basic SQL, German or another market language, and an interest in sales, operations and AI tools.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You get real ownership of recurring processes from the start with direct impact on how a multi-market sales organisation is run, you learn hands-on HubSpot administration, CRM data governance, Looker reporting and how incentive schemes are designed and tested, and you work alongside an international, collaborative team with fast-track opportunities to grow as PERGOLUX scales.

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role  

At Ogilvy Health, we work with ambitious healthcare brands to create work that makes a meaningful difference.

We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager to join us, working on an exciting global respiratory account. This is a brilliant opportunity for someone ready for real ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to run the account day to day, build a strong relationship with the client and play a leading role in where the partnership goes next.

You’ll be joining a supportive team, but there’s plenty of space to make the account your own. With a strong pipeline of work ahead and a growing client relationship, you’ll have genuine visibility and the opportunity to make an impact. 

You’ll gain further global experience, work across campaign launches and major congress activity, and have a senior team around you when you need it, while still being trusted to lead.

If you’re a Senior Account Manager looking for a role where you can step up, have a voice and genuinely make an account your own, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do 

You’ll take the lead on the day-to-day running of the account, working closely with the client and wider Ogilvy team to keep everything moving in the right direction.

There’s a great mix of work to get involved in, from taking an established US campaign and helping bring it to global markets, to developing market toolkits, promotional materials and supporting major congress activity.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading the day-to-day client relationship and becoming a trusted partner
  • Taking ownership of the account and keeping priorities, projects and teams moving
  • Leading global campaign work, including adapting and rolling out campaign materials across markets
  • Overseeing the development of promotional materials and communications
  • Working closely with strategy, creative, medical and project management teams
  • Playing a leading role in major congress activity
  • Spotting opportunities to strengthen and grow the client relationship
  • Supporting and developing more junior members of the account team
  • Bringing confidence, good judgement and a collaborative approach to everything you do

What You’ll Need  

You’ll already have good experience gained at the Account Manager level within a healthcare communications agency, ideally working with prescription pharmaceutical brands and global accounts.

We’d particularly love to hear from you if you have:

  • Strong Rx/pharmaceutical healthcare communications experience
  • Experience working on global campaigns and launches
  • Confidence managing senior day-to-day client relationships
  • A good understanding of promotional work and the pharmaceutical environment
  • Experience coordinating work across different markets and stakeholders
  • The confidence to lead an account and make decisions without needing lots of direction
  • Strong commercial instincts and an interest in helping an account grow
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to leadership

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

Benefits

  • Monthly contribution towards fitness and lifestyle
  • On-demand learning, development and professional coaching

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • Strong grasp of pipeline orchestration, testing frameworks and the practices that keep them healthy at scale.

  • Comfortable setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and working closely with finance, payments and audit stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off clearly and influence the decision that follows.

  • You use AI hands-on in your day-to-day technical work and can show specific examples of how it has changed the way you build, review or debug data models.

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.

What you'll do

  • Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
  • Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
  • Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks
  • Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation
  • Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
  • Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
  • Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
  • Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership

What we look for

  • Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
  • Ownership of the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
  • Hands-on evaluation design that ties model behaviour to real-world outcomes, used to catch regressions
  • Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Practical knowledge of handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable
  • Experience leading root-cause analysis on production AI or ML systems

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst& Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.
