title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live.

We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform.

You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns.

  • Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

  • Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements

  • At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

  • Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS.

  • Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them.

  • Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark

  • Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis)

  • Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory)

  • Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation)

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

title: Senior BI Analyst - THG Beauty
descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Senior BI Analyst at THG Beauty? 

As Senior BI Analyst for Beauty, you will own the reporting layer that enables the Beauty Data & Insight team and senior Beauty leadership to understand and act on business performance. You will build and maintain trusted dashboards and reports — covering customer, commercial and operational performance — ensuring that the metrics leadership relies on are accurate, consistent and drive decisions. You will work closely with the Beauty analytics team, the Reporting Lead and the Engineering team.  

What You'll Do:

Reporting & Dashboard Development 

  • Own and maintain the Beauty reporting suite — dashboards covering customer performance, trading, commercial analytics and operational KPIs 
  • Build new reports and dashboards to support evolving business requirements 
  • Ensure all Beauty reporting meets the metric standards set by the Reporting Lead — consistent definitions, clear labelling, reliable data 
  • Work with the Reporting Lead to rationalise and improve the reporting estate 

Data & Analytics 

  • Write and maintain SQL queries to support reporting and ad hoc analytical requests 
  • Validate data — working with engineering teams to identify and resolve discrepancies 
  • Support the Beauty analytics team with data and reporting needs 

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Work with Beauty stakeholders — including the Head of Beauty and analytics leads — to understand reporting requirements 
  • Communicate clearly about what the data shows, what it doesn't show, and why 
  • Manage requests effectively — setting expectations and delivering reliably 

 THG Career Framework — What Good Looks Like at This Level 

  • Deep expertise in BI and reporting — the go-to person for Beauty reporting and metric questions 
  • Interprets and explains data concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders 
  • Coaches junior analysts on BI best practice and data quality 
  • Accountable for own targets — delivers to a high standard with minimal supervision 
  • Understands how reporting quality links to business decision-making quality 
  • Makes pragmatic decisions on reporting priorities — balancing stakeholder requests with data quality 

What We're Looking For:

Essential 

  • Experience (typically 3+ years) in BI, reporting or analytics roles 
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tooling — able to build production-quality dashboards 
  • Strong SQL skills — comfortable building complex queries and validating data 
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer goods reporting 
  • Attention to detail — committed to the accuracy and consistency of what you produce 

Desirable 

  • Experience with GCP and BigQuery or equivalent cloud data platform 
  • Exposure to beauty, wellness or lifestyle brand data environments 
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts as applied to reporting 
  • Experience in customer, commercial or operational analytics domains 

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 
  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

title: (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)
descriptionHtml:

To strengthen our bioanalytical laboratory in the Ligand Binding Service Team in Fehraltorf / Zurich, we are looking for a

* This is a dual-level posting. The hiring team will determine the final level and title of the role based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required for the level offered.

Main responsibilities

Study Leadership & Scientific Oversight

  • Lead and oversee GLP/GxP-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.
  • Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.
  • Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.
  • Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

Client Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.
  • Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.
  • Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.
  • Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.

Additional Responsibilities for Senior-Level Candidates

  • Lead complex or strategic client programs.
  • Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for ligand-binding and cell-based assay technologies.
  • Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.

Our requirements

  • BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field
  • At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position
  • Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell-based), preferably in an industry setting
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail
  • Excellent computer and time management skills
  • Highly self-motivated, reliable, and flexible, with a commitment to providing excellent service to clients.
  • Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
  • Excellent English (written and spoken), good German skills are advantageous
  • Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role is required for the senior position
  • Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis
  • Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients is advantageous

Your chance

We provide an opportunity to assume work independently, secure long-term employment, and enjoy a competitive salary.

Your workplace will be located within our state-of-the-art equipped automated facilities in cantone Zurich as part of an international organization.

Additionally, you will experience the advantages of flexible working hours and experience the benefits of a medium-sized company with flat organizational structure within a dynamic and international team.

Our benefits: extra holidays, company-paid sickness and accident insurance, commuting allowance and access to Reka-Checks.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing DSA
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Evolve Our Marketing Measurement: Code, calibrate, and scale our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and ROI frameworks to unlock precise business insights.
  • Build and Deploy Core Models: Build and maintain sophisticated econometric and statistical models (MMM, GMV, engagement) to quantify marketing impact and guide multi-channel growth.
  • Automate Model Validation & Health Monitoring: Design automated frameworks and reliability metrics that continuously monitor model health and ensure long-term accuracy.
  • Build Next-Gen, Automated Capabilities: Drive the ambition toward intelligent data products [such as self-healing MMMs] using modern AI and automation to optimize model runtimes and scale our ecosystem as Vinted grows.
  • Partner with Decision Scientists & Marketing Leadership: Act as the core technical partner, translating complex mechanics into clear concepts and helping the team connect model outputs to robust business decisions.
  • Champion Modelling Excellence: Maintain a high bar for code quality, rigorous validation, and reproducibility to ensure our data science practices remain clean and trusted.

About you 

  • Proven Data Science Experience: Hands-on experience focused on advanced statistical, econometric, or time-series modelling (experience in marketing measurement/MMM is an advantage).
  • Deep Theoretical Knowledge: Strong foundation in advanced statistics, causal inference, and regression. Familiarity with probabilistic programming (e.g., PyMC) is a major plus.
  • Research-to-Application Mindset: Ability to read scientific papers, explore state-of-the-art techniques, and replicate or adapt advanced methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Highly proficient in Python, with a passion for building models as data products. You design your pipelines and code so they are modular, reproducible, and easily used or extended by other scientists.
  • Business-Minded Tech Partner: You care deeply about the why behind your code, naturally connecting technical model outputs to commercial metrics and business outcomes.
  • Educational Background: A Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative discipline (Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or similar).
  • Impactful storyteller: A charismatic and confident presenter who navigates any topic’s technicality, actively driving and facilitating strategic business conversations across both technical and leadership audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation Policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Engineer, High Performance Data Systems
descriptionHtml:
About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

 

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

The role

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

The timing is rare. A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 150 and still accelerating, driven by massive demand. We are building the team to unlock our next orders of magnitude of scale and capability.

What you'll do

  • Own significant projects in our data systems end to end: design, architecture, deployment, monitoring and measuring the impact you made

  • Build distributed systems that stay fast and correct under load, and reason carefully about every way they can fail

  • Shape performant protocols and APIs, that customers build directly on top of

  • Find simple solutions to complex domains at scale, and know when boring technology wins

  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through code reviews, pairing and sharing what you know

Why engineers join Foundations

  • Scale that's genuinely hard. Multimodal AI data is big, messy and growing fast. You'll solve problems most backend engineers only read about.

  • Real ownership. You'll own whole systems, not tickets, and the architectural calls are yours to make.

  • Work that ships. Your systems power 300+ AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

  • Long-term thinking. A team that plans 24 months out and gives you room to build things properly.

  • The right moment. A Series C company growing fast, early enough that your decisions shape the platform for years.

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You combine rigorous engineering with ruthless prioritisation to ship efficient and correct systems quickly.

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • Fluency in at least one high level (Python, Typescript), and one imperative statically typed (Rust, C++, Java, Go, or other)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching, consistency) and how they behave under load

  • Deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

 

Operating principles

 

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

 

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.


The Opportunity
As Senior Financial Analyst at Coda, you'll play a key role in shaping how we plan, forecast, and steer our financial performance. You'll coordinate our budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning cycles, bringing together our B2B and B2C businesses into one clear financial outlook. You'll also take ownership of our planning and reporting processes in Aleph and manage the group's non-personnel fixed operating expenses.

Reporting to the Director of FP&A, this is a hands-on role with high visibility and real impact. Your work will directly inform decisions made by our CFO, executive team, and Board, giving you the opportunity to influence how Coda plans for the future.


What You'll Do
  • Planning: Own the annual budget, regular forecasts and long-term financial planning process across the Group.
  • Consolidation: Integrate B2B and B2C forecasts into a comprehensive Group P&L, balance sheet and cash flow outlook.
  • Quality: Own key financial assumptions, challenge business drivers and ensure consistency, accuracy and reliability across forecasts.
  • Strategic Insights: Develop financial scenarios, sensitivity analyses and product profitability insights to support executive decision-making.
  • Ownership: Lead the development of our financial planning platform, streamlining forecasting, consolidations and reporting into one efficient process.
  • Automation and AI: Identify and implement smarter ways of working to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability across FP&A.
  • Budgeting: Own the budget for non-personnel operating expenses, set cost centre targets and oversee approvals for unbudgeted spending.
  • Reporting: Prepare and review high-quality financial analyses, Board materials, investor updates and lender reporting, including covenant calculations.
  • Partner: Work closely with the Director FP&A and step in to lead planning and reporting cycles when required.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Accounting, Treasury and Business Control teams across Amsterdam, Singapore and Jakarta to drive alignment and financial performance.

    • What You'll Bring
  • FP&A expertise: 6-8 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance or a related field, including at least 3 years leading budgeting and forecasting cycles.
  • Planning & consolidation: Proven experience managing and consolidating forecasts across multiple entities, markets or business units.
  • Financial modelling: Strong three-statement modelling skills and a solid understanding of cash flow and working capital.
  • Systems & analytical skills: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency and hands-on experience with planning tools such as Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment or similar.
  • Stakeholder management: Confidence to collaborate with, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business.
  • Communication & education: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a degree in finance, economics, econometrics or a related field.
  • Business environment: Experience in a high-growth, international or investor-backed organisation is a strong advantage.
  • Strategic finance exposure: Familiarity with Board, investor or lender reporting, including financial covenants. A background in Big 4, transaction services or investment banking is a plus.
  • Process improvement & innovation: A track record of building scalable finance processes, implementing or improving planning systems, or leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency is highly valued.
  • Mindset & ownership: Structured, pragmatic and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, the ability to deliver under pressure and confidence working across international teams and time zones.
    • We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

Reporting into a Team Leader (each team is circa 5-7) and up to the Director of Professional Services, you will be joining a market leading team of professionals to undertake risk assessments and advise on fire, health and safety matters at a variety of buildings including mid-high rise buildings, to our established portfolio of clients across a variety of segments, including, residential, commercial and retail.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

About the Team

The HR Business Partner team at OpenAI supports managers and employees as teams grow, perform and adapt. We work alongside managers at all levels to resolve day-to-day people challenges, build management capability and create the conditions for teams to do their best work.

We’re looking for a Senior HR Business Partner to support managers and teams across EMEA, with a primary focus on Go-to-Market and responsibility for selected other functions in the region. Your GTM partnership will span teams such as Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships and Marketing. Across your portfolio, you’ll build a deep understanding of business priorities and use that context to prioritise and deliver practical people support.

title: Senior Industrial Engineering (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

As our Senior Industrial Engineer, you turn that ambition into a production system. You set up and scale our assembly and test lines from first units to series volumes, design how material and work flow from workstation to shop floor, and build the lean standards that keep quality high and waste low. You work hands-on with Production, Engineering, Quality and Purchasing, and you own the outcome: a production line that delivers when it matters.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Production set-up & scale-up: You plan capacity and headcount and own the ramp-up of assembly and test processes to series volumes.

  • Linked production systems: You design and balance linked lines in electronics and electro-mechanical assembly, including transfer systems, workpiece carriers and buffers.

  • Lean standards: You introduce and sustain standard work, 5S, poka-yoke and shopfloor management.

  • Waste reduction & continuous improvement: You run value stream analyses, identify waste and implement improvements together with the shop floor team.

  • Routings & standard times: You create routings, standard times (MTM/REFA) and capacity models.

  • Equipment selection: You write user requirement specifications (URS) for production equipment and capital goods, evaluate quotes and run acceptance tests (FAT/SAT).

  • Layout & material flow: You plan layouts from workstation to shop floor, including sketches and technical drawings in CAD.

  • KPIs & business cases: You set up and monitor production KPIs (OEE, lead time, FPY, unit cost) and build business cases for investments and automation.


Must-have

  • Degree in industrial, mechanical or production engineering, or comparable

  • 5+ years in industrial engineering for series assembly, including owning a production ramp-up

  • Hands-on lean experience (standard work, 5S, poka-yoke, VSM) with measurable waste reduction

  • Experience in Line balancing, time studies (MTM/REFA) and layout and material flow planning

  • Fluency in German and English languages, including technical vocabulary are required

  • Proven experience setting up a production line and owning a production ramp-up

  • Proven track record of identifying and reducing waste with measurable result

Nice-to-have

  • Electronics manufacturing (SMT/THT, PCB assembly, box build) or linked production lines

  • URS writing, FAT/SAT and CAD drawings

  • Lean/Six Sigma certification, ERP (Odoo, SAP) or material flow simulation

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

title: Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager (f/m/d).
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

What you will do:

  • Drive industrialization from early product development: Work closely with R&D engineers from the beginning of the development process, integrating manufacturing expertise into design decisions and challenging concepts where necessary to improve manufacturability, cost and scalability.

  • Define manufacturing strategies and technologies: Evaluate, select and implement appropriate manufacturing technologies, processes and production methods for complex mechanical and electromechanical components.

  • Optimize product design for manufacturing: Identify opportunities to simplify designs, reduce component complexity, improve production feasibility and find more cost-effective manufacturing solutions without compromising product performance.

  • Drive design for manufacturing of electronics and sensorics hardware: Work with R&D on the hardware design of electronics and sensor systems (PCBs, sensor modules, cabling and assembly) with manufacturing and supply chain requirements in mind. Ensure designs are producible, testable, cost-efficient and robust in series production.

  • Develop external manufacturing partnerships: Identify and establish relationships with suitable manufacturing partners, particularly specialised SMEs. Work directly with company owners, technical experts and production teams to identify solutions and build reliable partnerships.

  • Build up the supply chain and procurement strategy: Define and implement the supply chain and procurement strategy together with SCHUNK SE and external partners. Leverage SCHUNK's established supplier network and purchasing expertise where it makes sense, and build additional sourcing channels, including second sources, for critical components.

  • Drive manufacturing readiness: Take ownership of manufacturing bottlenecks, technical feasibility, supplier lead times and production challenges, ensuring a smooth transition from prototypes to repeatable and scalable production.

  • Build industrialization capabilities: Establish manufacturing processes, methods and standards that support TACTILIA's future growth and increasing production requirements.

What you bring:

  • Several years (5 years) of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production engineering or a comparable technical role.

  • Broad knowledge of manufacturing technologies and processes, ideally involving complex mechanical, precision or electromechanical products.

  • Proven experience translating engineering designs into practical, cost-efficient and manufacturable products.

  • Experience with design for manufacturing of electronics and sensor hardware (PCB assembly, component selection, test strategies), ideally in an electromechanical or mechatronic product.

  • Experience identifying, evaluating and working with external manufacturing partners and suppliers.

  • Experience building or managing supply chains and procurement strategies, including working with a parent or group company's purchasing organization.

  • Comfortable engaging with different stakeholders, from R&D engineers and senior management to supplier owners, technicians and blue-collar production teams.

  • Entrepreneurial, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to take ownership and drive topics independently.

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge engineering decisions constructively.

  • Fluent in English; German is an advantage.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Intelligence Officer, Information & Cybersecurity
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

You are the founder of our Intelligence & Foresight unit. Knowing who is targeting Isar Aerospace, how and why, whether physically, in cyberspace or through our supply chain, is mission critical. You build our all-source intelligence capability from the ground up and run it: turning signals into decisions for leadership, running our sources and platforms, owning the tooling that feeds our defenders, and setting the tradecraft standards the unit grows on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

  • Build the practice: design the intelligence programme end to end, from Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) agreed with leadership through collection, analysis and dissemination, and document it so it scales. 
  • Protect launch operations: own the threat picture across every launch cycle, pre-launch to post-launch, across physical, cyber, insider and supply chain vectors, in liaison with Andøya Space, Norwegian authorities and our site security teams. 
  • Run collection and sources: task and operate our dark web and threat intelligence platforms, conduct or oversee lawful persona-based engagement in underground forums, manage external providers, grade every source for reliability, incentives and circularity, and apply the legal and operational security safeguards this work demands. 
  • Fuse and assess: bring physical, geopolitical, labour, supply chain and cyber developments into one threat picture, and track the actors, campaigns and vulnerabilities relevant to space, defence and manufacturing. 
  • Deliver and operationalise: produce strategic assessments for leadership, operational reporting for incident response and physical security, and curated indicators, detections and hunts for the SOC mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Own the threat intelligence platform and feeds; automate ingestion, enrichment and reporting in Python. 
  • Grow the capability: act as intelligence lead during incidents, maintain liaison with national authorities, police, ISACs and industry peers, and mentor the analysts who join the unit. 

Qualification Checklist 

We do not expect hands-on depth in every area; tell us where you are strong and where you would rely on partners or tooling. 

  • Experience: 7+ years in threat intelligence or adjacent fields, ideally government, military, law enforcement, security vendor or MSSP; a relevant degree or equivalent experience; a track record of building intelligence capabilities, not only consuming them. 
  • Source Handling: running or handling human sources, online or otherwise, including persona-based engagement in underground communities; assessing reliability, incentives and exposure to manipulation; operating lawfully, ethically and with discretion. 
  • Analytic Tradecraft: structured analytic techniques, Admiralty Code source evaluation, analysis of competing hypotheses, estimative language, Diamond Model and MITRE ATT&CK, applied to hybrid threats where state and non-state actors combine physical, cyber, influence and economic means against critical infrastructure and operational sites. 
  • Technical and Tooling: strong Python; hands-on with a threat intelligence platform (e.g. MISP, OpenCTI), STIX/TAXII, APIs and feed integration into SIEM, EDR and email security; able to pivot on indicators and validate cyber findings yourself. 
  • Communication: concise, bottom-line-first briefings for executive and technical audiences; trusted relationships with internal and external partners. Fluent English required; Norwegian or German strongly preferred. 
  • Security Clearance: due to the sensitive nature of this role, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain any security clearances required under applicable legal, regulatory, customer or contractual requirements. Continued employment in this role may be subject to maintaining such clearance.

Bonus Skills

title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

  • Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

  • Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

  • Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

  • Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

title: (Senior) IT Security Consultant – Vulnerability Management & Container Security (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest Sicherheitslücken nicht nur identifizieren, sondern deren Analyse, Bewertung und Behebung durch intelligente Prozesse und Automatisierung nachhaltig verbessern? Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit Security-Tools, APIs und Container-Technologien und möchtest auch KI gezielt für effizientere Security-Prozesse einsetzen?

Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig.

Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team.

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst, bewertest und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken anhand von CVE, CVSS, Exploitability und dem jeweiligen Risikokontext und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du implementierst, konfigurierst und entwickelst Vulnerability-Management-Plattformen wie DefectDojo weiter, um Schwachstellen zentral zu erfassen, zu bewerten und nachzuverfolgen.

  • Du integrierst unterschiedliche Security-Scanner und optimierst die Konsolidierung, Normalisierung und Deduplizierung von Security Findings.

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst Security-Workflows für die Bewertung, Zuordnung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen und setzt dafür APIs, Skripte und geeignete Schnittstellen ein.

  • Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Ansätze zur Analyse, Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Security Findings und integrierst diese in bestehende Security-Prozesse.

  • Du analysierst und sicherst Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Umgebungen ab, identifizierst Schwachstellen in Container-Infrastrukturen und setzt Maßnahmen für Container Hardening und sichere Konfigurationen um.

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung technischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihr Vulnerability Management nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Gemeinsam suchen wir nach Projekten, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen.

Qualifikation

Deine Fähigkeiten (wichtig für uns)

Für uns ist es wichtig, dass Du Spaß daran hast, Neues zu lernen und Dein Wissen weiterzugeben.

Das wünschen wir uns von Dir:

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und in der operativen IT Security und bist mit der technischen Analyse, Bewertung und Bearbeitung von Sicherheitslücken vertraut.

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in DefectDojo oder vergleichbaren Vulnerability-Management-Lösungen und Erfahrung mit der Integration von Security-Scannern sowie der Verarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Findings.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CVE, CVSS und risikobasierter Schwachstellenbewertung und kannst technische Risiken unter Berücksichtigung von Exploitability und Sicherheitskontext fundiert priorisieren.

  • Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, OpenShift und Container Security mit und hast Erfahrung in der Analyse und Absicherung containerbasierter Umgebungen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit API-Integrationen, Skripting und der Automatisierung von Security-Prozessen. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und hands-on und setzt technische Lösungen eigenständig um.

Deine Fähigkeiten (nice to have)

Über folgenden Fähigkeiten von Dir freuen wir uns, ansonsten erlernst Du die Aspekte im Rahmen der Einarbeitung:

  • Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI- und LLM-Technologien und hast diese bereits zur Security-Analyse, Klassifizierung von Findings oder Automatisierung von Workflows eingesetzt.

  • Du besitzt gute Python-Kenntnisse und hast Erfahrung mit Security-Tools wie Trivy, Grype, OWASP Dependency-Track oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.

  • Du kennst dich mit Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Software Supply Chain Security und Open Source Vulnerability Management aus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Sicherheitskonzepten wie RBAC, Network Policies, Pod Security Standards oder CIS Benchmarks.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in DevSecOps und CI/CD-Security mit und hast idealerweise bereits Security-Scans in automatisierte Build- und Deployment-Pipelines integriert.

Falls du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Benefits

  • Dein Weg zur Expertin/zum Experten: Unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden begleiten Dich bei Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung.
