title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be Zego’s senior in-house lawyer, owning legal matters across the business and working closely with senior stakeholders as Zego continues to grow. Reporting to the Group CFO, you will work alongside Compliance and the wider Legal and Regulatory Affairs (LRA) team.

It’s a varied, hands-on role with a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will be the go-to person for legal advice across the business: advising on key decisions, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, and instructing external counsel where needed. This is an individual contributor role with no line management.

A particular focus will be insurance law and regulation, which sits at the heart of Zego’s business, alongside a broad range of commercial and contractual matters. You’ll work closely with colleagues responsible for compliance, financial crime and risk, providing legal advice on the regulatory questions that arise, while those teams retain responsibility for their respective areas.

What you will be doing

  • Insurance distribution and capacity. Draft and negotiate binding authority agreements, co-insurance and cooperation agreements, claims handling agreements, reinsurance-related documents.

  • Insurance products. Work with Underwriting, Product and Claims on policy wordings, endorsements and coverage questions, including large losses.

  • Regulatory legal advice. Advise on the structuring of insurance arrangements, including binding authority agreements, insurer and distribution relationships, regulatory permissions and perimeter questions, and the legal and regulatory requirements that apply to Zego's insurance and lending activities.

  • Commercial. Draft and negotiate supplier, outsourcing, technology, partnership and data sharing agreements, including material outsourcing terms required by FCA and GFSC rules.

  • Corporate and governance. Support board and committee governance, intra-group agreements, financing and capital projects, and company secretarial work in the UK and Gibraltar.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Qualified to practise in England and Wales, with around 6+ years' PQE gained at a law firm, in-house, or both.

  • Comfortable working on your own with a high volume of varied matters and competing deadlines.

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Evals
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the team

Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people.

About the role

Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale.

This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks.

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions.

In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development.

In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with scientists to use them in a training or release decision.

What the role involves

  • Design evaluations with scientists and domain experts, translating intended capabilities into representative tasks, datasets and success criteria. Cover current applications and capabilities we want future models to acquire.

  • Curate evaluation data and calibrate task difficulty, so that evaluations are neither saturated nor out of reach and still separate models of different quality. Work with domain experts on sourcing, annotation and review, within data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy requirements.

  • Own the development and operation of the evaluation platform across training checkpoints, deployed models and external baselines. Support distributed execution, reproducible configurations, trace inspection and comparison of results, while managing runtime and cost.

  • Develop programmatic checks, outcome-based scoring and LLM-based graders. Calibrate automated judgments against expert reviews, investigate disagreements and test whether graders reward superficial answers or reject valid solutions.

  • Analyse model outputs and agent trajectories, including tool calls, environment state and task outcomes. Distinguish model failures from problems in the evaluation, quantify uncertainty and explain what changed between versions.

  • Maintain versioned tasks, datasets, graders and environments, with protected held-out tests and contamination checks. Expand coverage as models improve, retaining useful regression tests and adding harder tasks where existing tests no longer distinguish performance.

  • Prepare commerce benchmarks for public release on ProLLM, including public mirror sets and evaluation code, where the data can be shared.

  • Integrate evaluations into training and release workflows, with dashboards and regression checks that support concrete decisions. Work with portfolio teams to establish whether offline improvements correspond to better outcomes in online experiments.

  • Build tools and agents that help generate candidate tasks, run evaluations and investigate failures, validating their outputs before adoption. Review contributions and mentor engineers so teams can extend the suite consistently.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least five years of ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems.

  • Experience owning evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or model-quality systems that informed training or deployment decisions.

  • Strong Python and experience with PyTorch, Transformers or comparable ML libraries, alongside reliable production software development.

  • Practical knowledge of experimental design and statistics, including sampling, uncertainty, repeated trials and comparisons across model versions.

  • Experience running inference or evaluation workloads at scale and debugging failures across models, data, scoring code and infrastructure.

  • Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous results into defensible recommendations.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with language-model training or post-training.

  • Experience with agent or gaming environments.

  • Experience with human evaluation, LLM-as-judge calibration, recommendation metrics or online experimentation.

  • Contributions to evaluation frameworks, public benchmarks or research.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the evaluation platform and the evaluations that guide LCM’s research, training and deployment.

  • Access to proprietary domain data, GPU infrastructure and external models for comparison.

  • Direct collaboration with researchers, engineers and portfolio teams, with scope to publish methods and benchmarks, including through ProLLM, where the work can be shared.

  • Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems.

  • Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants.

  • A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role.

  • Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro.

If you want to build the evaluations that shape what a foundation model learns, we’d like to hear from you. Please include examples of evaluations or platforms you have built, how you established that their results were reliable, and the decisions those results informed.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are....

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have....

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Paid Social

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team. 

Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.

This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.

Responsibilities

Paid social strategy and investment (the main focus of the role)

  • Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.
  • Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.
  • Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.
  • Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.
  • Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.

title: Senior People Partner
descriptionHtml:
Senior People Partner

Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000

Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function.

THE MOMENT

Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago.

You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them.

This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one.

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT

In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty.

  • Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back.

  • People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding.

  • Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning.

  • CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to.

To be clear about the level: The CPO still designs the People strategy and the systems architecture. You own how it runs day to day, and you’re trusted to run a whole initiative, not just a case. That is a different job to People Partner, not a bigger version of the same one.

THE ROLE

You’ll sit in the People team reporting to the Chief People Officer. Three strands make up the job:

  • Casework: The employee relations situations with the most complexity or sensitivity land with you, start to finish.

  • Initiatives: When the CPO needs a piece of work owned (a policy rollout, a wellbeing programme, a piece of the reward or benefits agenda), you take it from design through to something that runs.

  • Operations: Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, screening and security clearances, and keeping Rippling accurate.

When the People Partner joins, they’ll report to the CPO. You won’t manage them formally, but you’ll lead their handover, you’ll be the person they come to first, and your judgement will set the standard for how this function operates day to day.

WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS

New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today.

Yours

  • The most complex and sensitive employee relations casework, end to end.

  • Full ownership of People initiatives, from design to embedding.

  • Acting as the CPO’s operational partner on ambiguous or cross-cutting problems.

  • Until the People Partner joins (planned for later in 2027):

    • Payroll and benefits administration, including the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling and Mintago.

    • Pre-onboarding, onboarding and probation.

    • Background screening in Zinc.

    • Security clearance coordination.

    • Rippling data quality, workflows and reporting.

    • Our working groups and committees.

  • Once the People Partner joins:

    • A structured handover of the operational core.

    • Day-to-day guidance for the People Partner.

Shared

  • Ashby, which Talent Acquisition owns. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on every hire until the People Partner joins, and on senior hires after that.

  • Mentoring and supporting the People Partner on their casework and initiatives, once they join.

Not yours

  • Recruitment delivery, which sits with Talent Acquisition.

  • The design of the People strategy, the operating model and the systems architecture, which sit with the CPO.

  • Formal line management of the People Partner, who will report to the CPO.

THE STACK

  • Rippling: Our single source of truth. Until the People Partner joins you’ll run it day to day, including the monthly payroll cycle, data quality and workflows, and you’ll use its reporting at a level that supports whole initiatives.

  • Zinc: Background screening. You’ll run checks for every new joiner until the People Partner joins, and stay close to the senior and sensitive hires after that.

  • Ashby: Owned by Talent Acquisition. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on the hires you’re responsible for.

  • Claude: A daily tool here. You’ll use it for casework preparation, drafting policy and communications, and pulling together the analysis behind an initiative.

  • Mintago: Our employee benefits and financial wellbeing platform (pensions, salary sacrifice and financial advice). You’ll administer it and keep enrolment accurate until the People Partner takes it on.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the hardest casework. You’ll run our most complex and sensitive employee relations cases end to end, with the CPO there to sense-check rather than take over.

  • Own initiatives, not tasks. You’ll take a People initiative from a rough brief to something that’s running and embedded, rather than handing it back once the interesting part is done.

  • Run the operational core. Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling, benefits administration including Mintago, onboarding, background screening and security clearances. Accurate, on time, and documented as you go.

  • Hand it over well. When the People Partner arrives, you’ll give them a working system and a clear handover, then stay the person they come to first and the judgement others in the function measure themselves against.

  • Partner with senior leaders. You’ll be credible with leaders on the most difficult conversations: complex change, capability, and situations without a clean playbook.

  • Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude daily to take time out of your own week, checking anything that touches a decision about a person and owning the outcome.

  • Improve what you find. You’ll spot the gaps in policy, process or practice before anyone else does, and bring the CPO a considered view on the fix, not just the problem.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS

  • You’re running the most complex ER cases with confidence, and the CPO isn’t being pulled into them.

  • At least one or two People initiatives have gone from a rough brief to something genuinely embedded, owned by you.

  • Payroll, benefits, onboarding and clearances run accurately and on time, and every process is documented well enough to hand over.

  • You’ve helped shape the People Partner hire, so the handover is ready when they land.

  • Senior leaders treat you as a credible operational partner, not an escalation point.

  • You’ve made and documented sensible calls in genuinely ambiguous situations, and they’ve held up.

  • The CPO can hand you an ambiguous problem and trust it gets shaped properly.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Deep employee relations experience. You’ve run complex disciplinaries, grievances and change situations yourself, and you know exactly when to escalate and when not to. CIPD qualification, or solid progress towards it, is welcome.

  • A track record of owning initiatives. You can point to work you took from a brief to something that actually ran, not just a project you contributed to.

  • Hands-on with the operational detail. You’ve owned or closely supported a payroll cycle, benefits administration and onboarding, and you’re comfortable being accountable for their accuracy while also carrying the senior work.

  • Credible with senior leaders. You can hold your own in a difficult conversation with someone under real pressure and be listened to.

  • Comfortable operating near-autonomously. You don’t need a playbook for everything. You make a sensible call, write it down, and check it with the CPO afterwards.

  • Ready to grow into people leadership. You won’t formally manage anyone at the start, but you’ll induct and guide the People Partner when they join, and you should want to lead a team as the structure catches up.

  • Discreet and organised at volume. Complex casework and live initiatives, often at the same time. You’ll need a system, and it can’t be your memory.

THE HONEST PART

This role sits in an odd space for now: senior in scope and judgement, without a team underneath it yet. Until the People Partner joins later in 2027, you’ll also be the whole operational team, so a payroll deadline and a complex grievance can land in the same week. That eases as the function grows, but it means the authority you carry day to day has to come from the quality of your work, not a job title.

You are not designing the People strategy or the systems architecture. The CPO does that. What you get instead is real ownership of the hardest cases and the initiatives that matter, a close working relationship with the CPO, and a genuine path toward leading the People Partner practice as it grows.

This probably isn’t for you if you want a formal team from day one, or if you’d rather leave payroll and onboarding to someone else. It probably is for you if you want to prove you can run this function well enough, top to bottom, that a team gets built around you.

If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Senior Product Engineer

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 2 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £120k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

How we do it

Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

The data is only half the story. As AI gets better at analysing large volumes of data, the hard part shifts to the product: helping customers explore and understand what the model finds, designing for trust, and turning insight into action.

You’ll shape how customers work with agentic AI, balancing the stability and reliability enterprises expect with the new, agent-driven experiences we’re building at the cutting edge. You’ll have real autonomy in how you approach it, working in a small, high-trust team with genuine influence over product, architecture and how engineering grows.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship high-quality frontend experiences across Deducta's platform.

  • Work directly with customers to understand their problems, and turn those insights into product decisions.

  • Build interfaces that make large datasets, dynamic metrics and AI-generated analysis clear and useful.

  • Design for the limits of AI, so customers know when to trust an answer and how to check it.

  • Push the boundaries of applied AI, both in the product and in how we build it.

  • Own problems end to end, from definition to deployment, making sound calls on architecture, usability, performance and maintainability along the way.

Success in this role means:

  • Customers go from data to decisions: Features you've shipped help customers explore AI-generated analysis and act on it, not just search through data.

  • Trustworthy AI experiences: Customers can see where an answer came from and when to check it, so their confidence in Deducta grows as they use it more.

  • A product foundation others build on: The components and patterns you've built are fast, consistent and reused across the product by the team.

Who you are

You're a senior product engineer who cares as much about the problem as the code, and takes ideas all the way to production. You don't need a background in enterprise data or procurement. We care about how you think and the quality of the products you've built.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, with experience building high-quality frontend applications.

  • Experience making complex data, information or workflows easy for people to understand and act on.

  • A clear view of what AI systems can and can't do, and how good product design accounts for outputs that aren't always right.

  • Sound judgement on architecture and product trade-offs, and the ability to explain the reasoning behind your decisions.

  • A track record of owning problems from investigation through to production.

  • High standards for testing, code quality and maintainability, and clear communication with engineers, customers and stakeholders.

  • A founder mindset: you see a problem and feel empowered to work out how to solve it.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical interview

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £120K • Offers Equity

At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra's EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. What You'll Do

Risk Management and Execution

  • Identify, track, and mitigate risks related to schedule, safety, logistics, weather, and geopolitical factors across tour locations
  • Develop contingency plans for schedule disruptions, maintenance needs, or changes in stop-level objectives
  • Monitor tour execution in real time and adjust plans as needed to maintain safety and achieve strategic goals
  • Maintain clear documentation and traceability of decisions, approvals, and changes throughout the tour

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide regular status updates to program and executive leadership on tour progress, risks, and outcomes
  • Capture and communicate lessons learned and stakeholder feedback from each tour stop
  • Support internal and external communications/marketing efforts related to the tour
  • Deliver a post-tour summary with key outcomes, metrics, and recommendations for future campaigns

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience (advanced degree a plus)
  • US Persons required
  • 8+ years in program or project management, ideally within aerospace, defense, or a related complex technical industry
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with tight schedules and significant logistical coordination
  • Experience working with international operations, export control considerations, and cross-border logistics
  • Strong organizational and risk management skills, with the ability to adapt plans quickly in dynamic environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, flight test, legal, and business teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with government and/or customer audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally, potentially for extended periods

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting flight test campaigns, demonstration tours, or airshow operations
  • Familiarity with European aviation regulatory environments and airspace coordination
  • Experience working with government or defense customers internationally
  • Prior experience with aircraft ferry/transport logistics

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

title: (Senior-) Projektingenieur:in für TGA / Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Seit 1993 ist peil und partner ingenieure GmbH eine feste Größe in der energieeffizienten, wirtschaftlichen und nachhaltigen Gebäudetechnik. Wir übernehmen vielfältige Ingenieurleistungen für Gebäude und Energiezentralen in unseren Standorten in Berlin, Braunschweig, Halle und Kiel. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung und einem dynamischen Team widmen wir uns deutschlandweit spannenden Projekten und arbeiten heute maßgeblich an der Dekarbonisierung des Gebäudesektors.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Planung und Projektierung von Anlagen und Raumautomationssystemen.
  • Du wirkst bei der fachgerechten Realisierung der Baumaßnahmen und bei der Projektabwicklung mit.
  • Du koordinierst Dich eng mit Bauherren, Fachplanenden und weiteren internen oder externen Projektbeteiligten für einen reibungslosen Projektablauf.
  • Du bist an den Projekten von der Bestandsaufnahme über die Entwurfs- und Ausführungszeichnungen bis hin zu den Revisionsplänen über alle HOAI-Phasen beteiligt.
  • Du führst regelmäßig Baustellenbegehungen durch, um den Fortschritt Deiner Projekte zu überwachen und stellst Du die Einhaltung der technischen und gesetzlichen Anforderungen sicher.
  • Du erstellst Automationsschemata und Funktionslisten nach VDI 6040.
  • Du bringst Deine innovativen Ideen zur Umsetzung hochwertiger, energie- und kosteneffizienter Raumautomation ein.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Versorgungstechnik, MSR-Technik, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung – alternativ Techniker:in in diesen Bereichen
  • Mind. 4 Jahre Erfahrungen in der Gebäudeautomation sowie Verständnis für Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- oder Klimaanlagen
  • Kenntnisse in Netzwerkprotokollen & Bussystemen der Gebäudeautomation.
  • Kenntnisse in Ausschreibungen sowie der Vergabe von Ingenieur- und Bauleistungen
  • Vertraut mit HOAI, VOB, VOL und relevanten Normen
  • Plus: Erfahrung mit TRIC, iTwo, Orca Ava, AutoCAD, Revit & BIM.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch & Kommunikationsstärke auf allen Ebenen.

Benefits

Weiterentwicklung: Du brennst für ein Thema? Durch gezielte und individuelle Entwicklungsgespräche stellen wir Dir die Mittel für professionell und persönliche Weiterentwicklung auf Fach-, Projekt- und Führungsebene zur Verfügung.

Work Life Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell sind selbstverständlich. Ebenfalls hast Du die Möglichkeit auf ein für Dich passendes Teilzeitmodell.

Moderne Work-Culture: Flache, dynamische Hierarchien ermöglichen Dir, Deine Ideen einzubringen und gemeinsam Deinen Arbeitsplatz zu gestalten.

Spannende Projekte: Von der grünen Schule bis zum komplexen Krankenhausbau bieten wir Dir eine vielseitige Palette an.

Corporate Benefits: Dich erwarten u.a. eine Firmenkreditkarte, Deutschlandticket, und weitere Benefits.

Dein Team: Du triffst auf eine vielfältige und motivierte Gruppe von Fachleuten. Offene Feedbackkultur auf Augenhöhe schaffen eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und Raum für Wachstum und gegenseitiges Lernen. In regelmäßigen Teamtreffen und Feiern hast Du die Möglichkeit, Deine Kolleg:innen auch fernab vom Schreibtisch kennenzulernen.

Deine Unterlagen kannst Du uns direkt über den Button "Jetzt bewerben" schnell, datenschutzkonform und vor allem absolut vertraulich zukommen lassen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Projektleiter Grundwassersanierung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rund 800 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter arbeiten in der SIERA Alliance an der Vision für eine bessere Zukunft in den Bereichen Umweltschutz und Klima, Wasser und Ökosysteme, Kreislaufwirtschaft, städtische Nachhaltigkeit und Infrastruktur sowie Impact-Technologie.

Zu der Gruppe gehört die Mull und Partner Ingenieurgesellschaft mbH Nord mit der Hauptniederlassung in Hannover. In der Gesellschaft arbeiten derzeit rund 120 Mitarbeitende in den Fachbereichen Bodenschutz und Abfall, Umwelt- und Geotechnik, Wasserwirtschaft, Geoinformation, Kampfmittel und Naturschutz.

Beschreibung :

Wir möchten durch maßgeschneiderte Ingenieurdienstleistung das kostbare Gut Wasser bestmöglich schützen. Dein Herz schlägt für den Bereich Wasser, du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und möchtest mit uns die Welt ein Stück besser gestalten?! Dann suchen wir Dich als Senior Projektleiter Grundwassersanierung (m/w/d) am Standort Hannover, Osnabrück oder Hamburg.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Erstellung von Detail- und Sanierungsuntersuchungen für den Bereich Grundwasser
  • Planung von Grundwassersanierungsmaßnahmen
  • Planung von in-situ Sanierungsmaßnahmen (ENA / ISCO)
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner beim Auftraggeber als auch bei der Fachbehörde
  • Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrungen im Bereich der Grundwassermodellierung
  • Du übernimmst die fachliche Leitung des Projekts und führst dieses zum Erfolg.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Hydrogeologie, Geologie, Umweltingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar.
  • Im Arbeitsbereich Hydrogeologie bringst du langjährige Praxiserfahrung mit.
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrungen in der Ausschreibung und Vergabe von Sanierungsmaßnahmen.
  • Du behältst auch in kniffligen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich der Bauleitung unter Berücksichtigung der VOB/C
  • Du hast Freude an der Führung von Projektteams und Arbeitsgruppen und bringst idealerweise erste Erfahrung darin mit
  • Natürlich bist du ein Teamplayer und eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit

Benefits

Was wir Euch bieten!

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgaben: Du arbeitest an vielseitigen und herausfordernden Projekten unterschiedlicher Größe mit und trägst damit aktiv zum Umwelt- und Klimaschutz bei. Außerdem erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien in einer Unternehmensgruppe in Familienbesitz.
  • Familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber: Du bist ein Familienmensch? Bei uns hast Du flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten ist je nach Aufgabe ebenfalls möglich.
  • Tolles Büro: Bei uns erwarten Dich attraktive Büroräume mit modernster Ausstattung in hervorragender Lage zu ÖPNV und Autobahnnetz. Notebook und Smartphone gehören zur Grundausstattung.
  • Entwicklungschancen: Wir bieten Dir eine umfassende Einarbeitung, Fortbildungen sowie ein Mentoringprogramm. Bei uns hast Du sehr gute, individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Echte Benefits: Attraktive Vorteile wie Preisnachlässe bei ‘Corporate Benefits‘ und unser Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter Programm.

title: Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) - Agentur für Handelsmarketing
descriptionHtml:
TEAMWFP ist eine Agentur für kreatives VkF-Marketing in Mönchengladbach. Seit 45 Jahren betreut die Agentur Unternehmen aus Handel und Finanzen in der Verkaufs- und Markenkommunikation: Prospekte, Mailings, Instore Design, Verpackungen und Kampagnen, für Kunden wie PENNY, Kaufland oder die Sparkassen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Beraterin oder ein erfahrener Berater als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde, mit eigenen Kunden und einem Beraterteam von fünf bis sechs Leuten.

Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du berätst viele Kunden aus Handel und Finanzen, ohne mehrere Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen und ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde und koordinierst jedes Projekt vom Briefing bis zur Produktionsreife.
  • Du vertrittst die Agentur in Abstimmungen beim Kunden und arbeitest dich inhaltlich in alle Projekte ein.
  • Du bereitest Briefings verständlich für dein Team auf und erarbeitest kommunikative Lösungen, allein oder mit der Kreation.
  • Du prüfst alle Werbemittel formal und inhaltlich, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und kalkulierst und überwachst die Kosten selbst.
  • Du übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben der Geschäftsführung und steuerst das Beraterteam mit.

Was du mitbringst

  • Eine Ausbildung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Marketingkommunikation oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing. Erfahrung zählt mehr als der Abschluss.
  • Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld oder in einer Marketingabteilung auf Kundenseite, Handelsmarketing ist ein Plus.
  • Fundiertes Marketingwissen, mit dem du Kunden strategisch berätst und Leistungen verkaufst.
  • Du greifst gern zum Hörer, behältst in vollen Phasen die Ruhe und bist sicher in Excel, Word und PowerPoint. Sehr gutes Deutsch ist Voraussetzung.

Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet

  • Ein Gehalt ab 4.000 € im Monat, je nach Erfahrung nach oben offen.
  • Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: In Beratung und Kreation sitzen erfahrene Leute am Tisch, Entscheidungen fallen schnell und direkt.
  • Viele Kunden und nie dasselbe: Vom Handel bis zur Bank übernimmt die Agentur fast jede Aufgabe, die ein Kunde stellt, und arbeitet bei den meisten Kunden nicht in festen Teams.
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht.
  • Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing.
  • Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar.

Ehrlich gesagt: Als Schnittstelle hängst du an vielen Leuten. Vom Kunden brauchst du Infos, von Konzept und Gestaltung pünktliche Ergebnisse, und phasenweise wird es stressig. Der Tipp aus dem Team: von Anfang an die eigenen Grenzen setzen.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defense capability.

About the Job

Senior Robotics Engineers independently drive delivery of vehicle perception and planning capability integrated in to our products. This includes systems analysis, sensor selection and integration, perception architecture and implementation, motion planning, health management, behaviour analysis, simulation and test infrastructure, and interfaces with lower- and higher-level systems. We expect Senior Robotics Engineers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership at the major subsystem or system level. Senior Software Engineers contribute as a technical lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and implement trusted safe navigation, collision avoidance, and situational awareness systems that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment
  • Design and implement scalable sub-systems including sensor processing, perception, tracking, motion planning, health management, anomaly detection, simulation, testing fixtures, and vehicle interfaces
  • Contribute to the design and development of existing software components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines
  • Utilize advanced techniques in computer vision, sensor fusion, and machine learning to enhance perception and planning capabilities of Anduril vehicles
  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of perception and planning algorithms through development and use of simulation and analysis of data from real-world experiments, including evolving the data analysis tooling.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers, to ensure effective system integration and testing
  • Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Experienced and proficient in C++ and/or Python software development
  • Familiarity with autonomous vehicle hardware and sensors such as radar, sonar, LIDAR, and cameras
  • Demonstrated knowledge of at least one of: computer vision, sensor fusion, SLAM, motion planning, machine learning
  • Experience in a senior perception or planning role for the delivery of a robotic system
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a sysem, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders to define and implement robust validation and verification strategies for perception and planning modules
  • Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with autonomous systems in the ground, air, maritime or space domains
  • Experience with simulation tools and frameworks, such as Gazebo, Unity, or Unreal Engine, for algorithm validation and testing
  • Knowledge of safety standards and certification processes for autonomous systems
  • Familiarity with System Engineering concepts

Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Internationale Kunden gewinnen. Marktanteile ausbauen. Energiewende industriell skalieren.

Unser Mandant ist eine weltweit tätige, mittelständisch geprägte Industriegruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, hoher Fertigungstiefe und einer starken internationalen Marktpräsenz. Die Gruppe steht seit Jahrzehnten für industrielle Qualität, technische Kompetenz, Verlässlichkeit und anspruchsvolle B2B-Lösungen in internationalen Märkten.

Innerhalb dieser Gruppe wird ein dynamisch wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich PV-Montagesysteme für Freiflächenanlagen und Solarparks konsequent weiter ausgebaut. Im Mittelpunkt stehen robuste, wirtschaftliche und skalierbare Systemlösungen für internationale Solarprojekte — getragen von eigener Produktionskompetenz, technischer Entwicklung, Metallverarbeitung, Verzinkungskompetenz und hoher Projektverbindlichkeit.

Für den weiteren internationalen Ausbau suchen wir eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur Produkte verkauft, sondern Märkte öffnet, Kunden gewinnt und ein wachsendes Geschäftsfeld sichtbar mit nach vorne bringt.

Aufgaben

Gesucht wird ausdrücklich keine klassische Vertriebskraft, die bestehende Kunden verwaltet.

Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die das internationale Projektgeschäft versteht, technisch-kommerziell argumentieren kann und den Anspruch hat, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven Markt neue Marktanteile zu gewinnen.

Ihr Fokus liegt auf der aktiven Gewinnung und Entwicklung von Kunden im Umfeld von:

  • Projektentwicklern
  • EPC-Unternehmen
  • Investoren
  • Generalunternehmern
  • technischen Entscheidern
  • industriellen Großkunden
  • internationalen Partnern im Solar- und Energieumfeld

Sie positionieren das Unternehmen als leistungsfähigen Systempartner für anspruchsvolle PV-Freiflächenprojekte und tragen unmittelbar dazu bei, das Geschäftsfeld international weiter auszubauen.

Ihre wesentlichen Aufgaben

  • Aktive Gewinnung neuer internationaler Kunden und Projektpartner im Bereich PV-Freiflächenanlagen, Solarparks und technischer Montagesysteme
  • Aufbau tragfähiger Beziehungen zu Projektentwicklern, EPCs, Investoren, Planern und weiteren relevanten Marktakteuren
  • Entwicklung bestehender Kundenpotenziale und systematische Erschließung neuer Zielmärkte
  • Durchführung technischer und kommerzieller Kundengespräche, Präsentationen, Angebotsverhandlungen und Abschlussgespräche
  • Beobachtung von Märkten, Wettbewerbern, Preisentwicklungen und Projektpipelines
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Technik, Engineering, Kalkulation, Projektmanagement, Produktion und Geschäftsführung
  • Einbringen von Markt- und Kundenwissen zur weiteren strategischen Entwicklung des Geschäftsfeldes
  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens bei internationalen Kunden, auf Messen und bei relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige erfolgreiche Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umfeld von PV-Montagesystemen, Solarparks, erneuerbaren Energien, Stahl-/Metallbau, technischer Infrastruktur, Bauzulieferindustrie oder industriellem Projektgeschäft
  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Vertriebsprozessen gegenüber Projektentwicklern, EPCs, Investoren, technischen Entscheidern oder industriellen Großkunden
  • Fähigkeit, technische Produkte überzeugend zu erklären und deren Nutzen in Bezug auf Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit, Lieferfähigkeit, Montagefreundlichkeit und Projektsicherheit darzustellen
  • Ausgeprägte Stärke in der Neukundengewinnung und Freude daran, Märkte aktiv zu bearbeiten
  • Professionelles, verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftsführern, Einkaufsverantwortlichen, technischen Entscheidern und internationalen Ansprechpartnern
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachkenntnisse, insbesondere Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch, sind von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und international orientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig an relevanten Unternehmens- und Produktionsstandorten präsent zu sein

Benefits

Das Besondere an dieser Position

Diese Aufgabe verbindet die Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines wachsenden Geschäftsfeldes mit der Stabilität und industriellen Stärke einer großen internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.

Sie übernehmen keine klassische Führungsrolle, aber eine ausgesprochen sichtbare und wirkungsvolle Vertriebsposition. Sie haben direkten Einfluss auf den internationalen Marktausbau, auf neue Kundenbeziehungen und auf die weitere Positionierung eines technisch starken Anbieters im europäischen und internationalen Solarmarkt.

Für erfahrene Vertriebsprofis aus dem Umfeld PV-Montagesysteme, Solarparks oder technischer B2B-Projektvertrieb bietet diese Position die Chance, nicht nur Teil eines bestehenden Systems zu sein, sondern ein wachsendes Geschäftsfeld aktiv mitzuprägen.

Unser Angebot

Geboten wird eine verantwortungsvolle internationale Vertriebsposition in einem zukunftsorientierten Wachstumsmarkt.

Sie arbeiten in einem industriell starken Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher technischer Substanz und der Rückendeckung einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe. Der Bürositz kann flexibel gestaltet werden; entscheidend sind internationale Kundenpräsenz, Marktnähe und die regelmäßige Abstimmung mit den relevanten Unternehmensbereichen.

Neben einem attraktiven Vergütungspaket und Dienstwagen erwarten Sie unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum, internationale Sichtbarkeit und eine Aufgabe mit klarer Wachstumsperspektive.

Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe der Referenznummer D9086. Absolute Diskretion sichern wir Ihnen zu.

Ihr Ansprechpartner

Wolfgang Dörrenbächer

Personalberatung Pillong ∙ Ebert-Roßbach GmbH

title: Senior Search Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

Hello! I'm Roberto Olmeda, leading the Search Discovery Team at commercetools. Search is fundamentally changing shape. Shoppers are moving from keywords to full sentences—and increasingly, the client querying our APIs isn’t a human at all, it’s an AI agent. My team builds the core retrieval layer behind product discovery for the world’s most demanding commerce brands. As we take semantic and hybrid search to general availability, we’re tackling hard engineering problems at every layer: from query understanding and vector indexing down to latency, measurable relevance, and the cost of a single query. We’re looking for a Senior Search Engineer to build across Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and our functional Scala backend—whether you already love functional programming or are excited to master it with us.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend
  • Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval
  • Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB
  • Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it
  • Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps
  • Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools
  • Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM
  • Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover
  • Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.
  • Fluent English for work in international teams
  • Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s
  • Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics
  • A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents
  • Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.
  • Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success 

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. 

For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Application
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, Application for our Engineering and Technology team. You own application security for Firmus AI Cloud and the internal software that runs it. Automation is how you scale that ownership. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own the security of that software: the public APIs, the services behind them, how tenants stay separated inside the application, and the AI assistants and agents we ship on top. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the CI/CD security gates that every production repository passes through: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and SBOM generation. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, and draft threat models.  
  • Ship the secure paved roads other teams build on: reusable libraries, service templates, and developer tooling. 
  • Write and review code in the services you protect, including the security-critical paths that tools miss. 

Security architecture and standards 

  • Set the application security standard and control for authentication, authorisation between services, tenant isolation at the application boundary, secret handling and logging. 
  • Lead threat modelling and secure design review. Define what an attacker can do and what must be true before it ships. 
  • Set the security requirements for the AI assistants and agents we ship e.g. prompt injection, context poisoning. 
  • Govern which tools and tool servers our AI agents and software engineers may reach, and how those integrations are scoped, allow-listed, and audited. 

Assurance and vulnerability management 

  • Own application security posture across our services: what is covered, what is open, what is accepted with a named owner and an expiry, and what is overdue. 
  • Prioritise fixes on exploitability and exposure alongside CVSS and hold them to the Firmus vulnerability SLAs. 
  • Drive remediation with the teams that own the code so issues close at the source. 
  • Extend SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the software delivery path as services and sites grow. Evidence that a control ran should be a query, not a spreadsheet exercise. 

Enablement and escalation 

  • Coach security champions inside each team so secure design decisions get made without waiting for you. 
  • Provide application-security expertise during incidents and convert recurring failure modes into gates, tests, standards, or developer tooling. 
  • Give engineering leadership a straight read on application risk and release readiness. Join customer conversations when the question is application security. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 7+ years in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus. 
  • Experience securing a public cloud or multi-tenant platform with a public API. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP API Security Top 10. Has threat modelled multi-tenant APIs in production: identity, authorisation between services, tenant isolation, and the ways a client abuses a published contract using STRIDE or an equivalent method, both for REST and gRPC. 
  • Has improved the security posture of software built by other engineering teams through standards, tooling, review, or secure-by-default patterns. 
  • Has owned CI/CD security gates in production (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, SBOM) and tuned them to deliver actionable findings with low false-positive rates that engineers trusted and acted upon. 
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript. 
  • Has replaced manual security work with automation: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, or regression tests that run without someone watching them. 
  • Hands-on with LLM-backed or agentic features: prompt injection, tool misuse, agent identity and delegated credentials, cross-tenant data leakage, and controls on generated code reaching production. Familiar with OWASP guidance for LLM and agentic applications. 
  • Deep practical experience with OAuth, OIDC, JWT, RBAC or ABAC, application-layer cryptography, token handling, and secrets in software. 
  • Has worked under SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 and can produce evidence that a control ran. 
  • Willing to join incident response for application and API security. 
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience securing AI agents, sandboxed code execution environments, or systems where AI-generated output can trigger automated actions. 
  • Has run a vulnerability disclosure programme. 
  • Security certifications with application-security depth, such as CSSLP or OSWE. 

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia
