title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
descriptionHtml:
As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use.

About machineMD

We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

  • Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

  • Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate.

  • Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

  • Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

  • Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

  • Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

  • Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

  • Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus.

  • Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

  • Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

  • Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit).

How You Work

  • Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

  • Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

  • Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand.

  • Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

  • Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

Working at machineMD

Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday.

We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we:

  • Own our choices (Radical Responsibility)

  • Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings)

  • Speak and listen with honesty (Candor)

  • Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements)

Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools.

Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk!

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please.

We’re excited to meet you!

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

  • Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

  • Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

  • Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

  • Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

  • Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

  • AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

  • Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

  • Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

  • Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

  • Fluency in German.

Nice to Haves:

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.

    • Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

  • Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

title: Solutions Engineer - London
descriptionHtml:

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Legora, you’ll act as a technical and strategic partner to our sales team, engineering team and prospective clients. You’ll help customers understand how Legora’s solutions solve their most complex technical challenges, lead technical discovery, create custom demonstrations, and support the end-to-end sales process.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with customers to drive value. Your work will directly influence Legora’s growth and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery discussions to understand customer pain points, use cases, and requirements.

  • Respond to technical questions, security concerns, RFI/RFP responses, and implementation feasibility discussions.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and technical liaison throughout the sales cycle from early engagement to contract negotiation.

  • Design and propose scalable technical solutions based on customer needs and Legora’s product capabilities.

  • Translate complex requirements into clear architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and proposal documentation.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a customer-facing technical role (preferably B2B).

  • Experienced with having technical delivery discussions, responding technical questions coming from clients.

  • Experience delivering technical presentations and demos to both technical and business decision-makers.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

  • French language proficiency is an advantage, though not a requirement for this role.

This is a full time, on-site position in London.

title: Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation who will play a pivotal role in the future of our company. Our Solutions Engineer will be responsible for the integration, validation, and operational readiness of Auterion-powered drone systems. You’ll collaborate closely with the production team, as well hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, and operations while ensuring that every platform transitions successfully from a physical airframe into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes drone technology and enjoys bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges
  • Perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 and/or other autopilot  ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up
  • Execute End-of-Line (EoL) software validation and functional testing to ensure production readiness and reliability
  • Conduct payload and camera load-seat testing, validating integration stability and operational performance under real-world conditions
  • Troubleshoot embedded system issues spanning firmware, communication interfaces, sensors, and hardware-software interactions
  • Work independently to diagnose integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams
  • Contribute to validation workflows for complete UAV systems, including components, integrated features, and operational flight configurations
  • Support full-stack drone integration activities across hardware, embedded firmware, and flight software layers
  • Solve complex integration and reliability challenges involving sensors, flight controllers, communication protocols, and power systems
  • Drive measurable impact on product quality, manufacturing throughput, and deployment readiness through improved validation and testing processes
  • Partner cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to accelerate batch validation and reduce EoL cycle times
  • Interface with external vendors and equipment providers to support testing infrastructure, hardware integration, and operational readiness
  • Participate in hands-on flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. in Aviation Technology, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional)
  • Hands-on experience working with Autopilot, Mission planning and navigation Software, including firmware flashing, configuration, and flight validation
  • Strong technical foundation in embedded systems, firmware debugging, and hardware-software integration
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and/or MAVLink communication protocols or equivalent Datalink protocols
  • Experience with UAV sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and flight controller configuration
  • Familiarity with Linux-based development and debugging environments
  • Experience with UAV flight testing, system validation, and troubleshooting in real-world operational environments
  • Understanding of drone manufacturing, QC processes, and End-of-Line testing methodologies is a plus
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with cross-functional engineering and operations teams
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments with evolving technical challenges
  • Passion for drone technology and a hands-on engineering mindset focused on building reliable flying systems
  • EU citizenship required  

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. 

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

title: Sr. Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
P-1626

Senior Product Designer

At Databricks, we design tools that make complex data and AI workflows intuitive and powerful. Our mission is to simplify how data is connected, understood, and activated so organizations can turn information into business outcomes. Designers at Databricks combine strong visual craft with systems thinking. They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.

We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You'll design for both technical and business users of data, making powerful capabilities feel clear, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise customers.

The impact you will have

  • Own your area end to end. Sharpen the problem, set the design direction, and carry the work from framing and interaction models through visual polish and shipped detail.
  • Set the quality bar. Make the critical design decisions in your area, review work from designers, PM, engineering, and AI tools, and have the hands-on skill to improve it yourself.
  • Advocate with evidence. Stay in regular contact with customers, choose research methods that fit the decision, and turn research into insights others can act on.
  • Show the experience got better. Define what success looks like for the key tasks users need to get done, and show the improvement through usability testing, research, and how people actually use what shipped.
  • Influence through the work. Move product and engineering decisions with prototypes, keep design reviews focused, and communicate clearly in writing and in person.
  • Prototype to explore and align. Use interactive prototypes as a primary thinking tool to explore ambiguous problems, reduce risk, and align the team on a direction.
  • Design directly in the codebase with coding agents. Use AI coding agents to ship well-scoped design changes alongside engineers, rather than handing off static mocks.
  • Define reusable UX principles. Create interaction patterns and frameworks other teams reuse, and drive consistency through a strong, cross-platform design system.
  • Raise the level of critique. Give and invite high-quality feedback, and help make clear decisions together with product and engineering.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of product design work experience.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your end-to-end design process, from inception to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large and complex design projects and balance the needs of diverse stakeholders.
  • A systems thinker who has the vision to design the big picture, and the tactical ability to break it down so that engineering can succeed in building it incrementally.
  • A deep understanding of business goals, customer needs, emerging AI capabilities, and the evolving data and technology landscape.
  • Self-directed and comfortable in ambiguity. You help shape product direction when the path isn't defined.
  • Beautiful visual and interaction work rooted in a data-driven, well-researched UX process.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, data/analytics products, AI/ML products, or enterprise software.
  • Experience designing products that bridge the gap between technical and business users.
  • The strongest candidates have demonstrated experience using modern development and AI-assisted coding tools to prototype ideas, understand implementation tradeoffs, and collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. The Opportunity

title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.
  • Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.
  • Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep technical reviews of our AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines, SIEM and logging, and vulnerability management tooling (e.g. Wiz), and fix what you find - prioritised by exposure, not by finding count.
  • Own PCI DSS and data protection architecture: payment page isolation, script monitoring, data encryption, and least-privilege access across multi-region environments - and turn those controls into evidence that stands up to assessors and regulators.
  • Lead cross-functional security initiatives across Payments Platform, Payments Engineering, and Group Security, and drive them to delivery - whether execution sits with partner teams or you have to write the code yourself.
  • Act as the technical arm of Vinted Pay's security accountable: maintain the risk register, prepare mitigation-or-acceptance decisions against centrally set thresholds, and represent Vinted Pay in the group's security governance.
  • Embed secure development into Payments engineering so security lands at design time rather than after deployment, and raise the security fluency of Vinted Pay engineers so risk-based decisions happen well without you in the room - security as a delivery enabler, not a gate.

About you 

  • Strong hands-on security engineering experience on a real engineering foundation - you have built or run large production systems, and you can threat-model a payment flow, find the attack path yourself, and drive or build the fix.
  • Experience in regulated payments or fintech - you have worked under PCI DSS and a financial regulator (FCA, Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, or equivalent) and know how their requirements become controls engineers actually run.
  • A staff- or principal-level track record - you have defined, led, and delivered major, company-wide technical initiatives, and you set security direction through software design on high-scale, distributed systems rather than from the outside.
  • The range to move across the four archetypes of staff engineering - tech lead, architect, solver, right hand - picking the one the domain needs together with the Director of Engineering, not the one you prefer.
  • A way of working that engineers respect: evidence over assertions, attack paths over checklists, guardrails over gates.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and translate technical risk into business consequence for senior audiences, internal and external.
  • Comfortable in our stack - Ruby on Rails, Go, MySQL, Temporal, AWS, SIEM and CSPM tooling - or eager to learn it, with a real interest in security and privacy as a field and the appetite to keep growing as an engineer and leader.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Advantage: experience building and running systems at massive scale (2+ million requests per minute), deep knowledge of observability tooling (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus), and a passion for introducing new practices.
  • Advantage: AWS security depth (IAM, KMS, multi-account and multi-region architecture), or hands-on CSPM (e.g. Wiz) and SIEM engineering.
  • Advantage: privacy engineering experience, or offensive security background or certifications (e.g. OSCP).

If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

title: Stage consultancy in de Zorg, onderwijs en sociaal domein
descriptionHtml:

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij je master-afstudeeronderzoek combineren met praktijkervaring bij een toonaangevend adviesbureau? En wil je bijdragen aan actuele ontwikkelingen in de zorg, het onderwijs of het sociaal domein? Lees dan verder.

Voor onze adviesgroep Zorg en Maatschappelijke Ontwikkeling (ZMO) zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en gedreven stagiair voor de periode februari tot en met juni 2027. Je werkt drie dagen per week mee aan adviesopdrachten en besteedt de overige twee dagen aan je afstudeeronderzoek.

Tijdens je stage werk je drie dagen samen met ervaren adviseurs en lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan lopende opdrachten. Zo maak je kennis met het adviesvak en ontwikkel je jouw onderzoeks- en adviesvaardigheden. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, gemeenten, zorgaanbieders en onderwijsinstellingen. We helpen hen bij uiteenlopende vraagstukken zoals de organisatie en betaalbaarheid van zorg, de toekomst van het onderwijs en passende ondersteuning voor inwoners. De rode draad in onze opdrachten is dat ze maatschappelijk urgent en bestuurlijk complex zijn.

Naast het meewerken aan adviesopdrachten is er ruimte om aan je scriptie te werken. Voor je afstudeeronderzoek draag je zelf een relevant onderwerp aan. Uiteraard denken wij graag met je mee om je onderzoek goed aan te laten sluiten bij onze praktijk, en hoe wij je bijvoorbeeld kunnen helpen met het werven van respondenten voor interviews, of het aanleveren van bestaande use-cases over jouw onderwerp.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ondersteunt en werkt mee bij onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten, bijvoorbeeld bij het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van interviews en werksessies, uitvoeren van kwalitatieve en kwantitatieve analyses, en het meeschrijven aan rapportages en artikelen.

  • Je sluit in overleg aan bij één van de drie teams binnen de afdeling ZMO: team zorg, onderwijs of sociaal domein.

Afhankelijk van het team waarin je terecht komt, werk je mee aan thema’s zoals:

Sociaal Domein:

  • Je onderzoekt hoe organisaties de Participatiewet en de Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw) toekomstbestendig kunnen uitvoeren.

  • Je adviseert over de strategische koers van het asiel- en inburgeringsbeleid en evalueert hoe de uitvoering bijdraagt aan de beleidsdoelen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe gemeenten meer grip kunnen krijgen op de kosten van de jeugdzorg en begeleidt hen bij het doorvoeren van verbeteringen.

  • Je ondersteunt gemeenten bij het inrichten en verbeteren van de toegang tot ondersteuning binnen het sociaal domein.

Zorg:

  • Je ondersteunt zorgorganisaties bij het versterken van hun weerbaarheid en het waarborgen van de zorgcontinuïteit, zodat noodzakelijke zorg bij verstoringen, zoals uitval van ICT of personeel, kan doorgaan.

  • Je adviseert zorgorganisaties over de inzet van digitale toepassingen en ondersteunt hen bij het verbeteren van de gegevensuitwisseling tussen zorgverleners.

  • Je werkt met bewoners, gemeenten en zorg- en welzijnsorganisaties aan zorgzame buurten, waarin mensen naar elkaar omzien en zorg en ondersteuning dichtbij beschikbaar zijn.

  • Je ondersteunt zorgorganisaties bij bedrijfskundige opgaven, zoals het verbeteren van de bedrijfsvoering, het beheersen van kosten en het afstemmen van capaciteit op de zorgvraag.

Onderwijs:

  • Je onderzoekt hoe het onderwijsaanbod in po, vo, mbo en ho bereikbaar en toekomstbestendig kan blijven en adviseert over de spreiding van scholen en opleidingen.

  • Je adviseert onderwijsregio’s en schoolbesturen over de aanpak van het lerarentekort en ondersteunt hen bij regionale samenwerking en het anders organiseren van onderwijs.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe onderwijsinstellingen hun organisatie en middelen kunnen afstemmen op toekomstige opgaven en begeleidt hen bij organisatieveranderingen, samenwerking en fusies.

  • Je adviseert over het versterken van basisvaardigheden en leven lang ontwikkelen en ondersteunt besturen en gemeenten bij het organiseren van begeleiding voor jongeren met een ondersteuningsbehoefte.

  • Je ondersteunt onderwijsinstellingen, overheden en bedrijven bij het opzetten van gezamenlijke innovatietrajecten en evalueert hoe deze bijdragen aan de beoogde doelen.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Dit bieden we jou

title: Stage de Master 2 : Comprendre les transformations structurales des hydrates de sels inorganiques pour le stockage d’énergie thermochimique - 5 à 6 mois
descriptionHtml:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacuna l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur.

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé.

Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement.

Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide.

• Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique.

• Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées.

• Vous quantifiez les fractions de phases par affinement de Rietveld (TOPAS, GSAS-II).

• Vous reliez structure et performance (fraction récupérée, vitesse de réaction, stabilité en cyclage).

• Vous rendez compte de vos résultats dans un mémoire et une présentation orale, avec une publication possible.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et faire dialoguer expérimentation, structure et performance sera essentielle pour réussir.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous préparez un diplôme Bac + 5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs) en science des matériaux, physique, chimie du solide ou génie des procédés.

Et idéalement :

· Des bases en cristallographie et en diffraction des rayons X

· Une première expérience en caractérisation des matériaux

· Junior accepté : oui

· Goût pour l’expérimental et l’analyse de données

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

title: Stagiair Learning & Development
descriptionHtml:
Stagiair Learning & Development

Ben jij klaar om jezelf te ontwikkelen en impact te maken?
Als stagiair bij ons Learning & Development (L&D) team krijg je de kans om jouw talenten in te zetten en mee te werken aan het succes van 6.000 collega’s. We zoeken een enthousiaste student die ons helpt om leren leuker, slimmer en toegankelijker te maken. Als L&D professionals helpen wij DPG Media voorop te blijven lopen. Dit doen we door een relevant open aanbod van trainingen, webinars en e-learnings aan te bieden op de online Academy Daarnaast ontwikkelen we strategische ontwikkelplannen op maat voor business units. Dit alles doen wij in lijn met de strategie van DPG Media.

Wat ga je doen?
Tijdens je stage draai je echt mee in het team. Natuurlijk zorgen wij voor goede begeleiding zodat jij je optimaal kunt ontwikkelen, maar we zijn minstens zo benieuwd naar jouw frisse blik. Je krijgt volop de ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen!

title: Stagiair(e) Backend AI Developer
descriptionHtml:
24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | hybride | softwareontwikkeling & AI | € 600,– obv 1 fte | wo bachelor of master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij bouwen aan slimme applicaties en AI-oplossingen die écht gebruikt worden? Bij Berenschot krijg je de kans om jouw technische kennis in te zetten voor innovatieve en maatschappelijke projecten. Als stagiair(e) binnen team Digital & Data werk je aan moderne applicaties, Python-backends en agentic AI-oplossingen die organisaties helpen om intelligenter en efficiënter te werken. Je draait direct mee in ons ontwikkelteam en krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en jezelf snel te ontwikkelen. Werk jij graag hands-on aan echte oplossingen en ben je niet bang om nieuwe dingen te leren? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

Dit ga je doen

Bij Berenschot ontwikkelen we digitale producten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Denk aan interne platforms, AI-gedreven workflows, dashboards, API-koppelingen en generatieve-AI-oplossingen voor publieke en maatschappelijke organisaties. Als stagiair(e) help je mee met het ontwikkelen van schaalbare backend-oplossingen en AI-functionaliteiten in onze Azure-cloudomgeving. Je werkt met ervaren collega’s in een Agile/DevOps-werkwijze en zorgt er samen met frontend developers voor dat applicaties en gebruikerservaringen naadloos op elkaar aansluiten.

Dit zijn (onder andere) je taken:

  • Backendservices en API’s ontwikkelen in Python met FastAPI.

  • Werken aan schaalbare applicaties en AI-systemen die zelfstandig tools kunnen gebruiken, informatie ophalen en workflows uitvoeren (agentic).

  • Bouwen aan cloudoplossingen binnen Azure.

  • Nieuwe ideeën snel omzetten naar werkende prototypes en toepassingen.

  • (Online) databronnen ontsluiten en koppelen om te komen tot bruikbare informatie.

Dit zijn voorbeelden van de toepassingen die je helpt bouwen of beheren:

  • Tooling voor datagedreven analyses die organisaties inzicht geven in hun ontwikkel- en groeipotentieel.

  • Een AI-chatbot die collega’s en klanten helpt om snel antwoorden te vinden op vragen over processen, kennis en documenten.

  • Een slimme offertetool die automatisch offertes opstelt, analyseert en beoordeelt.

Quote

"Bij Berenschot krijg je echt de ruimte om te leren, te experimenteren en te groeien. Je werkt direct mee aan AI-systemen die consultants dagelijks gebruiken en leert daarbij van ervaren engineers." – Stagiair bij Berenschot.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Team Digital & Data bestaat uit een groep nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste adviseurs en specialisten. De groep telt ongeveer 25 collega’s: data scientists, data-analisten en ontwikkelaars die met digitale tools adviesopdrachten ondersteunen. De opdrachten variëren van een aanvraagplatform voor zorginstellingen tot een tarievenanalyse voor de kinderopvang. Het team staat bekend om zijn informele en collegiale werksfeer waarin veel ruimte is voor nieuwe ideeën en eigen inbreng. Samenwerking en kennisdeling staan centraal in deze dynamische omgeving.


Dit neem je mee

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige stagiair(e):

  • Je volgt een wo bachelor of master in een technische richting.

  • Je hebt ervaring met Python. Heb je een GitHub-profiel link of portfolio? Dan zien we die graag terug in je sollicitatie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van REST APIs, bij voorkeur met FastAPI.

  • Je hebt basiskennis van asynchronous programming en good software design.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI, generatieve AI en agentic workflows (bijvoorbeeld. met OpenAI en LangChain); ervaring hiermee is een pre.

  • Je hebt interesse in cloudtechnologieën, met name Azure; ervaring hiermee is een pre.

  • Je beschiktover een uitstekend probleemoplossend vermogen en een nieuwsgierige, leergierige houding.

  • Je hebt heldere communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve instelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. De cultuur is informeel, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en initiatief.

Dit is wat we jou bieden:

  • Een parttime of fulltime stageplek van 4 tot 6 maanden.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltime basis).

  • Een laptop.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, thuiswerken is mogelijk.

  • Regelmatige feedback- en check-inmomenten met je stagebegeleider.

  • Een platte organisatie waarin je écht iets kunt betekenen.

  • Een gezellig team dat werk en plezier goed weet te combineren.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken.

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Job Heuvelmans beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier via Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter!

title: Stagiaire Chargé de mission – Accompagnement au changement & formation du SAS H/F
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe déploiement, formation et support de la plateforme numérique du Service d’Accès aux Soins (SAS), au sein de la Direction Territoires et Expérience clients (DTEX). Le SAS facilite l’accès à un professionnel de santé lorsque le médecin traitant n’est pas disponible, pour des besoins de soins urgents ou non programmés. Développée par l’ANS, la plateforme numérique nationale aide les professionnels participant au SAS à identifier l’offre de soins disponible et à orienter les patients vers une prise en charge adaptée. Vous contribuerez à améliorer l’appropriation de la plateforme dans les territoires, à structurer les formations et à accompagner plusieurs chantiers opérationnels et de pilotage.

🎯 Missions principales

Développer l’espace de formation et accompagner les usages

  • Recenser et organiser les supports existants : formations, webinaires, documents, outils et présentations.

  • Construire la feuille de route et le calendrier de création du nouvel espace de formation, puis produire ou adapter des supports visuels, documents, guides et vidéos selon les profils utilisateurs.

  • Concevoir des outils d’évaluation des formations, analyser les retours et proposer des ajustements pour faciliter l’adoption de la plateforme.

Accompagner les professionnels et contribuer au pilotage

  • Participer aux réunions, webinaires, ateliers et formations avec l’équipe et les acteurs territoriaux.

  • Finaliser l’accompagnement des organisations et établissements dans l’enregistrement des opérateurs de soins non programmés (OSNP) au RPPS+, notamment en construisant un processus et un outil de suivi.

  • Assister le Product Owner dans la mise en œuvre du système d’information décisionnel (SID) de la plateforme : suivi et coordination des travaux de développement au regard des besoins métiers.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en gestion de projet, communication, ingénierie pédagogique ou domaine équivalent.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous avez un intérêt pour la création de supports pédagogiques et visuels, la structuration de parcours de formation et la gestion de projet.

  • Vous êtes curieux·se, créatif·ve et capable d’analyser des situations complexes dans un environnement santé et numérique.

  • Vous appréciez le contact humain, savez écouter des interlocuteurs variés et comprendre leurs besoins pour proposer des réponses adaptées.

  • Vous êtes organisé·e et à l’aise pour coordonner plusieurs actions et en assurer le suivi.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Our Strategic Account Executives target and close new business with Datadog’s largest, most strategic customers and prospects. In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Prospect into large Fortune 1000 companies while running an efficient sales process
  • Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts
  • Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business
  • Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI
  • Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution
  • Have intuitive sense of necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation
  • Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities
  • Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

Who You Are: 

  • Someone with 5+ years closing experience (mix of field selling within mid-market and enterprise)
  • Driven and have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $100k+
  • Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own
  • Experienced in working for an innovative tech company (SaaS, IT infrastructure or similar preferred)
  • Experienced in selling into large Fortune 1000 companies with the ability to win new logos
  • Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

  • High income earning opportunities based on self performance
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous and competitive medical benefits package
  • Retirement savings match
  • Pet adoption and insurance program

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Strategic Initiatives Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, $1b+ revenues and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Role

SILs are Voodoo's internal consulting team, reporting to the Chief of Staff. You are dropped into the company's most important operational problems with a simple mandate: fix them. You work hands-on with leaders across gaming, apps, growth, and central functions — with the access of an insider and the toolkit of a top consultant.

What you will do

  • Improve internal processes — diagnose broken or slow processes, redesign them, and implement the fix (not just recommend it).

  • Help leaders improve their operations — embed with studio, publishing, or functional leaders to raise the performance of their teams: KPIs, organization, tooling, ways of working.

  • Run tactical projects — scoped 4–12 week projects: market analysis, cost reviews, post-mortems, integration work, tooling rollouts.

  • Fix internal issues of many types — ambiguous, cross-team problems nobody owns; you own them until they're solved.

What we're looking for

  • 3–6 years at a top strategy consulting firm (MBB, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Kearney, Advancy, EY-Parthenon), in M&A/transaction services, or in a high-performing BizOps/strategy team of a scale-up.

  • Structured problem-solver with strong analytics (advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL a strong plus).

  • Doer mentality: implements solutions, works autonomously, handles several workstreams.

  • Strong interpersonal skills — able to win the trust of leaders quickly without formal authority.

  • Top academic background (business or engineering).

  • Fluent English (French is a plus).

  • Passion for games/consumer apps a plus.

What we offer

  • Consultant-style variety with operator-style impact — and no travel or sales.

  • Direct exposure to Voodoo's leadership; fast track to operational leadership roles internally.

  • Competitive package.

Benefits

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Strategy & Operations

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k-£110k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Deducta is growing fast, and the work that keeps a company running well at this pace rarely belongs to one function. This role works directly with the Chief of Staff on the company's top priorities, turning them into plans, decisions and results. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

You'll have broad scope and real autonomy, moving between operating cadences, cross-functional projects, investor materials and analysis for the leadership team. You'll see how every part of the company works and help shape how it runs.

What you'll do

  • Company priorities: Turn the leadership team's priorities into clear plans with owners, milestones and measures, and keep them on track.

  • Operating cadences: Run and improve how we plan, set goals and review progress, from weekly leadership meetings to quarterly planning.

  • Cross-functional projects: Lead projects that span GTM, customer delivery and hiring, from scoping the problem through to results.

  • Board and investor materials: Prepare board decks, investor updates and the analysis behind them.

  • Analysis for leadership: Build the models, benchmarks and recommendations the leadership team uses to make decisions.

Success in this role means:

  • Priorities deliver: Company priorities have clear owners and plans, and progress is visible without chasing.

  • Cadences work: Planning and review cycles run on time and lead to decisions rather than status updates.

  • Projects land: Cross-functional projects finish with measurable results, and the processes they create keep working.

  • Trusted analysis: Leadership relies on your analysis and recommendations for its most important decisions.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency former management consultant with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, ideally having reached Manager. You'll combine structured problem solving with the drive to execute. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Top-tier consulting experience: Roughly three to four years at MBB or a top-tier strategy firm, with experience leading workstreams and working with senior clients.

  • Structured problem solving: You take an ambiguous problem, break it down and turn it into a clear plan with owners and milestones.

  • Analytical depth: You build models and analysis yourself, and turn them into clear recommendations.

  • Strong execution: You follow through on details, keep many workstreams moving at once, and build processes that run without you.

  • Executive communication: You write and present clearly to senior audiences, including boards and investors.

  • Range: You're comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on operations in the same week.

  • Nice to have: Startup or in-house strategy experience, or exposure to B2B software, data or AI.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • End-to-End Recruiting & Candidate Experience: Du verantwortest unsere Recruiting-Prozesse von der ersten Ansprache bis zur Einstellung. Du identifizierst passende Talente, prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst strukturierte Interviews und koordinierst die nächsten Schritte. Dabei sorgst du für eine professionelle, transparente und wertschätzende Candidate Experience, auch bei hohem Bewerbungsaufkommen.

  • Hiring Manager Partnership: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Gründern und Fachbereichen zusammen, definierst Anforderungen, erstellst passende Stellenanzeigen und stimmst Hiring-Zeitpläne ab. Du berätst zu Recruiting-Strategien, Marktbedingungen und Auswahlentscheidungen.

  • Offer Management, Onboarding & HR Support: Du begleitest Kandidaten durch die Angebotsphase, bereitest Vertragsunterlagen vor und koordinierst den Prozess bis zur Unterzeichnung. Du unterstützt das Onboarding und übernimmst bei Bedarf organisatorische HR-Aufgaben sowie die Betreuung von Kandidaten und Besuchern vor Ort.

  • Recruiting-Prozesse, Tools & KPIs: Du entwickelst effiziente, skalierbare Recruiting-Prozesse weiter und nutzt unser ATS, Automatisierung und KI-gestützte Tools. Du analysierst Kennzahlen wie Time-to-Hire, Pipeline Conversion und Offer Acceptance Rate, hältst Hiring Manager über Fortschritte auf dem Laufenden und leitest Verbesserungen ab.

  • Employer Branding & Recruiting Marketing: Gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing-Team stärkst du Cell Labs als Arbeitgebermarke, entwickelst überzeugende Recruiting-Inhalte und optimierst unsere Recruiting-Kanäle, um passende Talente auf uns aufmerksam zu machen.

  • Recruiting Events & Partnerschaften: Du entwickelst Events und Partnerschaften, die uns mit passenden Talenten verbinden, von Karrieremessen über Hochschulveranstaltungen bis zu kleinen Formaten bei uns im Office.

Was du mitbringst

  • Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im eigenständigen End-to-End Recruiting, idealerweise in einem schnelllebigen Startup, Scale-up oder internationalen, technologiegetriebenen Umfeld. Du kannst mehrere Recruiting-Prozesse parallel steuern und behältst auch bei hohem Bewerbungsaufkommen den Überblick.

  • Tech-Affinität: Du interessierst dich für komplexe Technologien und hast idealerweise bereits technische Positionen in Software, Engineering, Hardware oder anderen Tech-Bereichen besetzt. Du musst kein Engineer sein, solltest aber neugierig genug sein, technische Anforderungen wirklich zu verstehen.

  • Interviewkompetenz & Stakeholder Management: Du führst strukturierte, kompetenzbasierte Interviews, kannst Kandidaten fundiert einschätzen und gibst Hiring Managern klare Empfehlungen. Du kommunizierst souverän, hinterfragst Anforderungen konstruktiv und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen.

  • Prozesse, Daten & KI: Du arbeitest sicher mit modernen Recruiting-Tools und ATS-Systemen, kennst die relevanten Recruiting-KPIs und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien und KI-gestützte Lösungen auszuprobieren, um Recruiting effizienter und besser zu machen.

  • Arbeitsweise & Mindset: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und pragmatisch, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest auch bei wechselnden Prioritäten unkomplizierte Lösungen. Du bist empathisch, menschenorientiert und packst auch bei Aufgaben außerhalb deines eigentlichen Verantwortungsbereichs mit an.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Benefits

  • Recruiting mitgestalten: Du baust Recruiting in einem wachsenden Deep-Tech-Unternehmen aktiv mit auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Fachbereichen zusammen, entwickelst Prozesse weiter und siehst, welchen Einfluss deine Arbeit auf unser Wachstum hat.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du ein technisches Profil besser verstehen oder erleben willst, woran unsere Engineers arbeiten, sind sie nur ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.

  • Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Recruiting-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und hilfst dabei, ein Team aufzubauen, das Technologie entwickelt, die bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.

  • Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Recruiting-Herausforderung, die du eigenständig gelöst hast. Welche Position oder Zielgruppe war besonders anspruchsvoll, wie bist du vorgegangen und was war das Ergebnis? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Der Prozess: Wird noch final abgestimmt.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Recruiting und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

title: TCS and ECLSS Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Mission

We are developing, manufacturing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable spacecraft which will carry cargo to space stations and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced Certification Engineer to join our Thermal Control System & Environmental Control and Life Support System team. You will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and driving the certification and verification closure activities of the Nyx Thermal Control System (TCS) and Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) in support of vehicle qualification, NASA certification, and flight acceptance.

The role serves as the primary focal point between the TCS & ECLSS teams, System Engineering, Verification & Validation, Chief Engineering Office, AIT, Program, Safety Engineering, and external stakeholders. The Certification Engineer ensures that TCS and ECLSS requirements are properly allocated, verified, traceable, and closed with appropriate evidence, while maintaining alignment with NASA SSP requirements, Data Item Deliverables (DIDs), verification plans, and Safety Review Panel expectations.

The position requires a strong understanding of spacecraft systems engineering, thermal engineering, verification methodologies, qualification logic, and agency review processes to ensure that technical evidence across both subsystems is complete, credible, traceable, and accepted by the certification authorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Thermal & ECLSS Verification Closure Activities

  • Own the verification closure process for TCS and ECLSS, from subsystem level through spacecraft-level qualification.

  • Ensure TCS and ECLSS requirements are allocated to appropriate verification methods.

  • Coordinate the preparation, execution, and closure of verification events with analysts, product owners, subsystem engineers, system engineers, and test teams.

  • Maintain consistency between the TCS & ECLSS verification strategies and spacecraft-level verification planning.

  • Ensure analyses, test reports, inspection records, NCRs, requirement justifications, and review documentation are available to support certification closure.

  • Support the preparation of qualification, certification, and flight readiness reviews.

  • Ensure consistency of verification logic and evidence across TCS and ECLSS, particularly for requirements, interfaces, functions, or verification activities involving both subsystems.

Manage NASA Requirement Compliance and Verification Product

  • Act as the TCS & ECLSS focal point for NASA certification and verification activities.

  • Coordinate the closure of applicable NASA SSP requirements and associated verification products, including the DIDs.

  • Ensure consistency between analyses, test results, requirements, qualification rationale, and certification documentation across both subsystems.

  • Maintain alignment between NASA verification expectations and TEC verification approaches.

  • Coordinate with TCS and ECLSS technical owners to ensure certification evidence is technically robust and delivered according to program and customer milestones.

Lead Thermal & ECLSS Contributions to Safety Reviews

  • Prepare and coordinate TCS & ECLSS contributions to NASA Safety Reviews.

  • Ensure TCS and ECLSS hazards, controls, verification evidence, and closure rationale are fully documented.

  • Support and coordinate the development of safety review presentations and supporting technical packages.

  • Ensure consistency between hazard reports, verification evidence, and qualification activities.

  • Coordinate with Safety Engineering and subsystem technical owners to ensure certification evidence supporting hazard-control verification is identified and available.

Support Qualification and Test Campaigns

  • Ensure qualification, acceptance, development, and integrated test campaigns provide the evidence required for certification.

  • Identify verification gaps early and drive mitigation actions.

  • Support preparation of verification plans, qualification matrices, and closure notices.

  • Participate in major test reviews and assess certification impacts of anomalies and non-conformances.

  • Support requirement closure from TVAC, Thermal Balance, functional testing, and integrated spacecraft verification campaigns.

  • Drive the closure of actions and verification-related NCRs

 

Required Qualifications

Technical

  • MSc or equivalent degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of spacecraft thermal control system, ECLSS, and spacecraft development processes.

  • Experience with spacecraft verification and qualification methodologies.

  • Familiarity with NASA and/or ECSS verification standards, requirements management, verification matrices, and closure processes.

  • Understanding of thermal analyses, thermal testing, qualification logic, and evidence generation.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in spacecraft development, system engineering, verification, certification, or thermal engineering.

  • Experience supporting spacecraft design reviews and qualification campaigns.

  • Experience interfacing with external customers, agencies, or certification authorities.

  • Experience managing complex technical documentation and evidence packages.

Personal Skills

  • Strong organization, coordination, technical writing, and communication skills.

  • Ability to drive closure of multidisciplinary actions across engineering teams.

  • High level of rigor, traceability, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to challenge assumptions and ensure certification readiness.

  • Comfort presenting technical material to senior engineering leadership and external review boards.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?
