title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du ein Team regionaler Account Executives auf, das Kanzleien aktiv gewinnt – Outbound wie Inbound: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Deine Mission

Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Onsite-Gespräch mit dem Team in Berlin.

Dein Team

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

  • Outbound ist Kern: Einen wesentlichen Teil eurer Pipeline baut ihr selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr.

  • Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

  • Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

  • Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

  • Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

  • Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams: den MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien und die Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment.

  • Du baust mit deinem Team eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst die Aktivitätsquoten hoch.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast selbst Outbound gemacht und Teams darin geführt: Kaltakquise bei Inhaber:innen und Entscheider:innen schreckt dich nicht – sie ist dein Hebel.

  • Du bist ein Builder: Du hast schon einmal ein Team, einen Markt oder einen Prozess aufgebaut – idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Scale-up) – und baust Vertrauen auf, im Team wie bei Kanzleiinhaber:innen.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und Englisch auf C1-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

title: Tech Ops Lead
descriptionHtml:
Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte’s list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy. We are hiring the person to lead it.

The Role

This is a player-manager role, split roughly 50:50.

Half your week is leading our TechOps engineers: running 1:1s, setting standards, managing KPIs, coaching, and owning the service desk. You decide how technical problems get diagnosed and resolved at Hozah, and you hold the team to that standard.

The other half is hands-on engineering. When a client reports that revenue at a site has dropped 40% while every device shows healthy, you dig into the data, query the database, test the APIs and work out whether it is a bug, a misconfiguration or a camera problem. The systems are built in house, so there is no vendor to escalate to. TechOps own it through to resolution whether the problem lies in hardware, software or config and the fix is yours or a developer's. The software side is similar to L3 application support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the service desk and developing a small team of TechOps engineers.

  • Personally investigating the hardest faults across cameras, networks, kiosks and our backend platform.

  • Using SQL, API testing and log analysis to get to the root cause of operational problems.

  • Improving monitoring and alerting so we catch degradation before it becomes an incident.

  • Technically assisting on new site launches: network design, hardware spec and commissioning.

  • Working closely with our Estate Manager, our developers and the COO to improve the estate week on week.

What we’re looking for

  • You manage a technical team today, or have very recently: real direct reports and real performance conversations, while staying hands-on yourself.

  • You have run a busy operation with high ticket volumes, multiple sites and live incidents, and kept on top of it.

  • You are an adept service desk manager: you know what to prioritise, when and what to escalate, and how to direct the team’s workflow so the queue keeps moving.

  • Your instinct is to investigate first: querying data, testing APIs, reading logs. L3 application support backgrounds fit this role well.

  • You have solid networking fundamentals (IP addressing, DNS, VPNs). Deep enterprise networking not needed.

  • You stay calm during live incidents and organised when several things need attention at once.

What this role isn’t

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is operating a distributed technology estate.

  • A pure management job. Half the week is engineering work, and we want someone who likes it that way.

  • Heavily process-bound. We are a scale-up, so you will build the processes we need as we grow.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • £50-60k depending on experience.

  • 3 days a week in our Croydon office, 2 days from home, with occasional site visits around the UK.

  • You report directly to the COO and own the new TechOps function.

title: Technical Bid Manager (m/f/d)

Since our founding in Karlsruhe in 2020, we’ve expanded into an international team of 60+ experts. Based in Karlsruhe and Munich and backed by top-tier investors, we are chasing a bold vision.

About the role

Codesphere is entering complex, high-stakes regulated markets where winning a tender requires much more than project management. As our Technical Bid Manager, you own the end-to-end bid process and actively shape the proposal itself – translating complex requirements into a clear response strategy and turning technical expertise into a compelling, compliant, and credible offer.

This is not a coordination role. You understand the scope in depth, challenge requirements, develop solution concepts, and write substantial parts of the proposal yourself.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

title: Technical Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

title: UX Designer
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team members come from some of the best universities in the world and left some of the largest tech companies to build something truly remarkable.

Tasks

  • Build cocotb-based testbenches for RTL blocks ranging from complicated datapaths to multilevel interconnect, driven by property-based test generation rather than fixed directed vectors.Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to catch protocol violations directly in simulation, plus cover property statements to close functional-coverage gaps.
  • Cross-check RTL behavior against independent golden reference models (including formally-specified models) to catch divergence between spec intent and implementation
  • Drive functional coverage closure, reviewing coverage reports
  • Debug failures using waveform viewers and simulator transcripts, working from a failing assertion or model mismatch back to a root cause in the RTL, the testbench, or the model.
  • Document and track open verification findings (RTL bugs, model gaps, or verification-methodology limitations) with clear reproduction steps, so issues are shareable and actionable across the team.
  • Continuously improve the verification infrastructure itself (build flows, test harnesses, coverage tooling).

Requirements

  • Languages: System Verilog, System Verilog Assertions, Python.
  • Skills: RTL debugging, Property Based Verification, Git.
  • Good to have: Formal Verification exposure.

Master’s degree (or equivalent) and 2+ years of hands-on experience in a relevant role. Relocation required. Currently 4 days on-site, 1 day remote. Policy may change.

Benefits

  • A verification methodology you help shape, not just execute. The team builds its own property-based test harnesses, cross-checks RTL against formally-specified golden models, and wires up both SVA and native SystemVerilog covergroups. If you have opinions on how verification should be done, there’s real room to introduce them.

title: VP Sales, Europe

This role is part of our research squad. Alongside our core business in construction procurement, the squad explores new ways AI can change how buildings are planned and built. It works like a startup within the startup with a small team and a lot of room to shape something new.

One of the squad’s projects is about faster planning that leads to faster, better building on site, with AI assisting in the design process. We already have a strong foundation. Now we need someone with hands-on design experience to test our outputs against real projects and show us where we’re right and where we still have blind spots.

That’s where you come in. You give us frequent feedback and tell us directly what holds up and what doesn’t. If you can also write software, you can help build the harness directly. Your work goes straight into the product and helps prove our concept.

We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Working Student or Intern, you join the early team and support our mechanical engineers in building the physical body of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. You work on real hardware from day one: CAD, calculations, prototypes and tests. You learn fast from experienced engineers, and you take pride in getting the basics right.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • CAD & Drawings: Support the team with CAD models, assemblies and drawings for parts, fixtures and test rigs.

  • Engineering Calculations: Carry out calculations and simple simulation studies, and document assumptions and results clearly.

  • Prototyping & Testing: Build, measure and test prototypes and test rigs together with the workshop, and feed the results back into the design.

  • Parts & Documentation: Prepare parts for ordering, track deliveries and keep BOMs and design data up to date.

  • Research & Benchmarking: Investigate components, materials and manufacturing processes, and summarize your findings for design decisions.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders who want to learn how real hardware gets deployed: students who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

Must have

  • Studies: Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace or a related field.

  • Availability: As a working student, 16-20 hours per week during the semester; as an intern, 3-6 months full-time.

  • CAD: First hands-on experience with 3D CAD and technical drawings.

  • Mechanical Fundamentals: A good grounding in engineering mechanics, machine elements and strength of materials.

  • Hands-on Skills: Comfortable in the workshop - assembling, measuring and 3D printing.

  • Mindset: You are curious, take feedback well and own your tasks end to end. You enjoy startup pace and want to learn the rigor of industrial-grade engineering.

Nice to have

  • Student Teams: Experience from Formula Student, robotics competitions or similar.

  • FEA Basics: First experience with FEA and the habit of sanity-checking results by hand.

  • Manufacturing Awareness: Basic knowledge of CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing or injection molding.

  • Scripting: Basic Python or similar for calculations and data analysis.

  • Robotics Interest: Basic understanding of kinematics and actuators.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
